Work on end-to-end classification and forecasting use cases: problem framing, data preparation, model development, evaluation and basic deployment support (e.g. demand forecasting, churn prediction).
Explore and clean data; perform EDA to understand data and flag data quality issues.
Engineer features for tabular and time-series data.
Train, validate, and tune standard ML models (e.g. logistic regression, tree-based models, gradient boosting, simple neural nets, classical time-series models).
Evaluate models with appropriate metrics that have impact on business KPIs.
Build clear visualizations and concise reports to present model results and insights to business stakeholders.
Collaborate with data engineers and AI engineers to bring models into production (batch scoring, APIs, models monitoring, dashboards).
Document data sources, modeling assumptions, and experiment results in a reproducible way (notebooks, reports, wikis).
Business understanding and translating problems into technical goals by defining success metrics, auditing data feasibility, and aligning stakeholder expectations.
Pre-sales activities (at senior consultant level).

Commercial experience with various classical data science and Machine Learning (ML) models (e.g. decision trees, ensemble-based tree models, linear regression etc.).
Solid knowledge of customer analytics concepts or advanced forecasting.
Model hyperparameter tuning.
Model validation frameworks.
Experience with business requirements gathering, transforming them into technical plan, data processing, feature engineering, models evaluation.
Previous experience in an analytical role supporting business will be a plus.
Fluency in Python, basic working knowledge of SQL.
Knowledge of specific DS/ML libraries.
Solid experience in one of the cloud computing platforms (Databricks or GCP or Azure).

Understanding of Causal machine learning.
Experience in working with big data and distributed environments would be a plus.
Commercial experience proven by multiple successful projects in the areas of forecasting would be a big plus.
Experience with OOP in Python.
Experience with MLOps.
Familiarity with other languages R, Scala would be a plus.

Basic computer programming skills and familiarity with programming concepts.
Strong business acumen.

Ability to come up with creative solutions to address customer problems.

title: Supply Chain Senior Business Analyst
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Senior Business Analyst / Senior Consultant to support the end-to-end growth and delivery activities of our Supply Chain practice. The role will involve working across presales, RFP responses, client discovery, requirements analysis, functional solution design, business process consulting, and client-facing presentations.
The candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, helping clients capture their supply chain challenges, translate business needs into solution requirements, and support the design of scalable, value-driven supply chain solutions powered by data analytics & AI.
This role requires a strong understanding of supply chain processes, consulting skills, analytical thinking, and familiarity with supply chain planning and enterprise platforms such as o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, SAP IBP/APO/S/4HANA, or similar solutions. As well as business analysis and mapping tools e.g., Visio, Lucid charts, Python, SQL, ML/AI, etc- Transportation/Warehousing or both- Leading the practice and also hands on- more a business expert.
 
Tasks:
 
Presales, RFP and Practice Support:
Support end-to-end presales activities for Supply Chain transformation and technology engagements.
Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, solution narratives, effort estimates, assumptions, and delivery approaches.
Work with sales, practice leadership, solution architects, and delivery teams to develop compelling client proposals.
Create client-facing presentations, solution decks, offering materials, business case documents, and executive-level discussion materials.
Support the development of new supply chain service offerings, accelerators, frameworks, and reusable consulting assets.
Participate in client meetings, discovery workshops, demos, and solution walkthroughs.
 
 
 
Business Analysis and Consulting:
Lead or support requirements gathering sessions with client business stakeholders across supply chain functions.
Analyze current-state business processes, identify gaps, pain points, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, process flows, business rules, and solution specifications.
Conduct fit-gap analysis between business requirements and technology platform capabilities.
Support the definition of future-state processes, operating models, and solution designs.
Bridge communication between business users, product teams, technical teams, implementation partners, and leadership stakeholders.
 
Solutioning and Delivery Support:
Collaborate with solution architects and technical teams to design supply chain planning and execution solutions powered by data & analytics.
Support configuration discussions, functional design, integration requirements, data requirements, testing, and deployment planning.
Help define KPIs, dashboards, reports, and analytics requirements for supply chain visibility and decision-making.
Support UAT planning, test case development, defect triage, and business validation.
Ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives, industry best practices, and technology platform capabilities.
Provide domain expertise during implementation, transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 
Client and Stakeholder Management:
Lead client discussions with confidence and structure, especially around business processes, requirements, and solution options.
Build strong relationships with client stakeholders across business, IT, operations, and leadership teams.
Facilitate workshops, design sessions, process reviews, and executive readouts.
Communicate complex business and technology concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Manage competing stakeholder priorities and support decision-making through structured analysis and recommendations.
 
What We're Looking For:
 
10-15+ years of experience in business analysis, consulting, supply chain transformation, or technology implementation roles.
Ability to think end-to-end supply chain synchronization, rather than in specific area silos.
Strong experience working in supply chain domains such as planning, logistics & transportation, manufacturing, inventory, warehousing, demand forecasting, or order management.
Experience supporting or leading client-facing consulting engagements with digital and systems-complex data analytics nature.
Hands-on experience with requirements gathering, process mapping, fit-gap analysis, solution documentation, and stakeholder management.
Experience contributing to presales, proposals, RFP responses, solution presentations, or consulting offerings.
Prior experience working with cross-functional teams across business, IT, architecture, data, analytics, AI, and delivery functions.
Experience in supply chain digital transformation, planning transformation, ERP transformation, or analytics-led supply chain improvement programs.
Supply Chain Domain Knowledge.
 
The candidate should have strong knowledge across one or more of the following areas:
Demand Planning;
Supply Planning;
Inventory Optimization;
Production Planning and Scheduling;
Distribution and Replenishment Planning;
Logistics and Transportation Management;
Warehouse Management;
Network Planning and Supply Chain Design;
Supply Chain Control Tower and Visibility;
NPI (New product Introduction) and UPI (Under performing Inventory);
Technical and Platform Skills.
 
Key Skills and Competencies:
Strong supply chain business process understanding.
Excellent business analysis and consulting skills.
Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills.
Ability to translate business problems into technology-enabled solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop clear recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
Ability to work across presales, solutioning, and delivery phases.
Strong documentation and storytelling skills.
Commercial awareness and ability to contribute to proposals and business development.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
Attention to detail with strong ownership and accountability.

title: Account Executive
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client. 
 
  Role type:  Full time 
  Location:  Remote 
  Working days:  Monday–Saturday 
  Working with:  Founders and the customer success team 
 
 Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them. 
 About the role 
 Every week, founders and talent leads book time with us because hiring in India is broken for them. You take that meeting and you take it all the way to a signed subscription. 
 The pipeline is handed to you. The conversation is not. Thirty minutes with a founder is enough to either earn a customer or lose one, and the difference is almost always how well you understood their hiring problem before you started talking about ours. You'll learn the product deeply enough to search live on a call, quote real candidate supply for their roles, and answer the hard question — "why can't my recruiter just do this?" — without flinching. 
 This is a closing seat, not a coordinating one. You'll be judged on revenue you brought in this month, and you'll know exactly where you stand at all times. Some months that's a great feeling. Some months it isn't. 
 If you need a defined territory, a fixed script, and quarterly reviews to know how you're doing, this will feel uncomfortable. 
 What you'll actually do 
 On any given day you might be: 
 
 Taking booked demos with startup founders, HR leads and talent partners, and diagnosing their hiring problem before pitching anything 
 Showing exactly how our database and outbound campaigns fill the roles sitting open on their careers page 
 Writing follow-ups people actually reply to, and building the case internally for the person championing us 
 Working pricing, paperwork and procurement to done — not to "waiting on them" 
 Reviving deals that went cold, and killing the ones that were never real 
 Bringing objections and lost-deal patterns back to the founders and product team 
 Sitting in on early customer success conversations so what you sell is what gets delivered 
 
 You'll be measured on whether deals closed — well, and on time. Not on activity. 
 What we're looking for 
 
 2+ years selling B2B SaaS or services, with a number you owned and hit 
 You're curious on calls — you ask the second and third question instead of jumping to the demo 
 You can explain a product simply to a founder who has ten minutes and no patience 
 You chase things down. Nothing sits in your pipeline untouched for a week 
 You're straight with people — no overselling, because customer success has to live with what you promise 
 You want to understand recruiting deeply, not just sell software 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity and a Monday–Saturday pace 
 
 What you get 
 
 Warm, qualified demos from day one — you spend your time selling, not prospecting from zero 
 A product built on the largest white-collar talent database in India, with 1000+ companies as proof 
 Direct exposure to the founders and how decisions actually get made 
 A real look at how a profitable, venture-backed startup is built and run 
 Uncapped upside if you can close

title: Account Manager
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client. 
 
  Role type:  Full time 
  Location:  Remote 
  Working days:  Monday–Saturday 
  Working with:  Founders and the customer success team 
 
 Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them. 
 About the role 
 A company books a demo with us because their hiring is stuck. From that first call until they're a paying, active customer, they're yours. 
 You won't be prospecting from zero — inbound and our own outbound put founders and talent leads on your calendar every week. What happens after is entirely on you: run the demo, understand what they're actually hiring for, show them how the database and campaign tooling solve it, close the subscription, and make sure the account starts well rather than quietly going cold in month two. 
 That means you carry a number, and the number is visible. A week full of warm conversations that closed nothing is a bad week, and we'll both know it. In exchange you get a product companies already want, real demand coming in, and nobody scripting your calls. 
 If you want a clean job description with neat boundaries, this isn't for you. 
 What you'll actually do 
 On any given day you might be: 
 
 Running demos of platform.weekday.works with founders and talent leads, and reading what they actually need behind what they say they need 
 Pulling live searches during the call so a prospect sees their own hiring problem solved in front of them 
 Chasing the follow-up relentlessly — pricing, procurement, the person who went quiet after a great first call 
 Negotiating and closing subscription deals, and knowing which ones to walk away from 
 Handing accounts to customer success cleanly, and staying close enough that what you promised is what gets delivered 
 Telling us honestly why deals died — pricing, product, timing, or you — so we fix the real thing 
 Keeping your pipeline clean enough that your forecast means something 
 
 You'll be measured on closed subscriptions and how well those accounts hold up. Not on slides, not on calls logged. 
 What we're looking for 
 
 You've sold before and you've closed — B2B SaaS or services, ideally to founders and startup teams 
 You're sharp on a call: you listen more than you pitch, and you can push back on a prospect without losing them 
 You're relentless on follow-up. Deals don't die on your watch out of neglect 
 You run your own process and build your own judgment instead of waiting for a playbook 
 You're honest about your numbers, including the bad weeks 
 You know the Indian startup and hiring ecosystem well enough to hold a real conversation about it 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity and a Monday–Saturday pace 
 
 What you get 
 
 A product with real demand and real proof — 1000+ companies hire through Weekday 
 Full ownership of the closing motion, with the founders a message away 
 A front-row seat to how a venture-backed startup is built and run profitably 
 Direct influence on pricing, positioning and what we build next, because you're the one hearing the objections 
 Uncapped upside if you can close

title: Business Development Associate Intern
description:
This is a internal hiring not for our clients

Remote | 6-Month Paid Internship
10 AM – 7 PM | 6 days/weekPotential full-time conversion: up to ₹6 LPA
Build the skills that actually matter.
At Weekday AI, you won't be doing an internship where you spend six months watching someone else work.
As a Business Development Associate Intern, you'll be speaking to real companies, understanding their hiring challenges, introducing them to our product, and learning what it takes to turn a conversation into a business relationship.
You'll get a front-row seat to how a Y Combinator-backed startup thinks about customers, sales, growth, and revenue.
And you don't need to come in knowing sales.
If you're a strong communicator, curious, ambitious, and willing to learn, we'll teach you the rest.
About Weekday AI
Weekday AI is building a better way for companies to hire engineering talent.
Our platform helps companies discover high-quality, peer-recommended candidates using intelligent sourcing, automated outreach, and instant reference checks.
We're a lean, fast-moving startup where people get to take ownership early and see the impact of their work.
What You'll Do
You'll work closely with our Business Development team to:
Speak with prospective customers and understand their hiring needs.
Introduce companies to Weekday and explain how our product can help them.
Identify and engage with potential customers.
Build relationships with prospects and clients.
Work with internal teams to create a smooth customer experience.
Track your work and understand what drives successful business development.
What You'll Learn
This role is designed to help you build skills that compound throughout your career:
Communication — Learn to speak with different types of people and communicate with clarity and confidence.
Business thinking — Understand how companies identify problems, evaluate solutions, and make buying decisions.
Sales & persuasion — Learn how to understand customer needs and communicate the value of a solution.
Relationship building — Learn how to build professional relationships that go beyond a single conversation.
Ownership — Work on real business problems where your effort and results are visible.
These skills can become a strong foundation for careers in sales, business development, growth, account management, operations, and entrepreneurship.
Who We're Looking For
You don't need a perfect resume or previous sales experience.
We're looking for someone who:
Communicates clearly and confidently.
Enjoys talking to people.
Is curious and learns quickly.
Takes initiative and follows through.
Is comfortable working independently.
Wants to understand how businesses actually work.
Is currently pursuing or has recently completed a Bachelor's degree.
Prior sales experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
What matters most is your communication, curiosity, attitude, and willingness to learn.
Why Weekday?
Real customers. You'll interact with actual businesses.
Real responsibility. You'll contribute to work that directly supports the company's growth.
Real learning. You'll learn by doing, not through endless training sessions.
Real opportunity. Strong performance can lead to a full-time role with CTC of up to ₹6 LPA.
Our Interview Process
We keep the process practical and transparent and give you a chance to show us what you can do.

 Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them. 
 Read this before you apply 
 This is not a glamorous role. It's careful, high-volume, detail-obsessed work — and the models we're building are only as good as the data you produce. You'll spend your day looking at documents and drawing bounding boxes around the right things: marking exactly where a field, a block of text, a table, or a signature sits on the page, over and over, correctly. It's precise, repetitive work, and it's the foundation the whole annotation project stands on. One sloppy box teaches the model the wrong thing. 
 If you get satisfaction from doing something exactly right, at pace, without cutting corners — you'll do well here. If you need constant variety and get bored by repetition, this isn't for you. 
 What you'll actually do 
 On any given day you might be: 
 
 Looking at documents and drawing accurate bounding boxes around the regions that matter — fields, text blocks, tables, stamps, signatures, whatever the project calls for 
 Labelling and classifying each box correctly according to the annotation guidelines 
 Keeping your boxes tight and consistent — same standard on document one and document one thousand 
 Flagging edge cases, ambiguous documents, and gaps or contradictions in the guidelines instead of guessing 
 Reviewing and correcting your own (and sometimes others') annotations to keep quality high 
 Helping refine the labelling process so annotation gets faster and more consistent over time 
 
 You'll be measured on accuracy, consistency, and throughput — how much high-quality annotated data you produce, not hours logged. 
 What we're looking for 
 
 You're precise and patient — you can draw the same clean box the hundredth time as well as the first 
 You sweat the details; a box that's slightly off or a wrong label bothers you 
 You take ownership. When a batch is yours, it's done right — no follow-ups needed 
 You follow guidelines closely but speak up the moment something doesn't fit them 
 You're comfortable with repetitive, screen-heavy work and a Monday–Saturday pace 
 You care about the quality of your work even when nobody's checking every box 
 
 What you get 
 
 A front-row look at how a venture-backed startup is built and run profitably 
 A real understanding of what goes into the data behind AI models — the part most people never see 
 Real ownership of the ground truth the project depends on 
 A PPO if you perform 
 Hands-on experience with the tools and habits that make you genuinely useful anywhere

title: Founder's Office
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
Role type: Full time
Location: Remote
Working with: CEO and Cofounder
Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
 
About the role
You’ll work closely with the founders on some of the most important problems at the company.
There isn’t a fixed lane for this role. What you work on will depend on what the company needs at the time. That could mean figuring out why a product isn’t growing, launching a new product or market, improving an internal process, working with customers, researching a new opportunity, or taking on a project that simply doesn’t have an obvious owner yet.
This is a hands-on role. We’re not looking for someone whose job ends at analysing a problem and making a recommendation. You should be comfortable getting into the details and doing the work yourself.
As the company grows, the problems you work on will change. We expect the role to change with them.
What you’ll work on
Depending on the week, you might:
Take a new idea from a rough hypothesis to something we can actually test
Dig into a part of the business that isn’t working well, understand why, and fix it
Work on growth for an existing product, including talking to customers, improving positioning, running experiments, or helping close important deals
Research a new market, product, partnership, or business opportunity and decide whether it is worth pursuing
Build a process or internal tool where none exists today
Work with product and engineering to turn customer or business problems into product changes
Take ownership of projects that cut across teams and would otherwise fall between the cracks
Help the founders make decisions by getting to the underlying facts quickly
Some projects will last a few days. Others may become something you own for months.
What we’re looking for
You’re good at figuring things out. You can take a vaguely defined problem, ask the right questions, and get to a useful answer without needing a detailed brief.
You’re comfortable doing the work yourself. If something requires talking to customers, going through data, writing copy, building a spreadsheet, or putting together a quick script, you’ll do it.
You have good business judgement. You can distinguish between something that is interesting and something that actually matters.
You’re comfortable with numbers and technology. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data and use technology to make yourself more effective.
You communicate clearly. You can write well, explain what you’ve learned, and say when something isn’t working.
You take ownership. Once you take something on, the founders shouldn’t have to keep checking whether it is moving.
You care about details. A lot of this job involves noticing things other people miss and following through on them.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities will change and you won’t always have a playbook to follow.
We care less about whether you’ve had a “Founder’s Office” title before. You could come from startups, consulting, product, growth, operations, investing, or something else entirely. What matters is whether you can learn quickly and get useful things done.
What you get
You’ll work directly with the founders and get exposure to most parts of the company.
You’ll see how decisions get made, work on problems before they have dedicated teams around them, and have a lot of room to take ownership. If something you start becomes important enough, there’s a good chance you’ll continue to own it.
This role is a good fit for someone who eventually wants to build a company, run a business or product line, or become a generalist operator at an early-stage company.

title: Founder's Office (Growth & GTM)

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
About the role
This is a growth role, not a strategy role. You will sit next to the CEO and own one number: revenue growth for one of our core product lines. Everything you do — every piece of content, every cold email, every demo call — either moves that number or it doesn't.
You won't be handed a playbook, a team, or a warmed-up pipeline. You'll build the GTM engine yourself: figure out which channels work, build them, and scale the ones that do. Some weeks that means writing content and tuning SEO/AEO so buyers find us. Other weeks it means running demo calls back-to-back and following up aggressively until deals close. If you think of yourself as either "a marketer" or "a salesperson" but not both, this isn't for you.
What you'll actually do
On any given day you might be:
Running the full inside-sales motion — taking demo calls, handling objections, following up relentlessly, and closing
Building content that actually converts: landing pages, comparison pages, blog posts, and material designed to rank on search and get picked up by AI answer engines (AEO)
Setting up and running outbound systems — cold email, cold calls, LinkedIn, or whatever channel gets us in front of the right buyers
Writing scripts and light automations to scale yourself — scraping lead lists, wiring up email sequences, building dashboards so you know what's working
Testing a new growth channel, killing it fast if it doesn't work, and doubling down if it does
Reporting your numbers honestly to the founders, including the ugly ones

You've done growth before — content, SEO, cold email, cold calling, or any sales system you built and ran yourself — and you can show what it produced.
You take ownership. When the number is yours, it moves — no follow-ups needed.

You're comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no hand-holding, no fully-defined role. The role is what you make it.
What you get
Full ownership of a revenue line — you're not a cog in a GTM machine, you are the GTM machine
A daily working relationship with the CEO and Cofounder, and a front-row seat to how a profitable, venture-backed startup grows
The freedom to pick your channels and build your own systems — and the accountability that comes with it
The kind of zero-to-one growth experience that's worth far more than the title

title: Talent Management Executive – Weekday
description:
Talent Management Executive
Weekday (YC W21) · Bangalore, Hybrid · Full-time · 6 days work week
About Weekday
Weekday is an AI-powered hiring platform backed by Y Combinator, helping startups across India and the US find and hire great talent. We're a growing team, and we want our own people's experience to be as good as the one we help others build.
The role
We're looking for a hands-on people person to run the day-to-day of our people function and our Bangalore office. You'll get the operational details right every time. You'll also handle the human moments, like joining, exits, and farewells, with care and good judgement. You'll fix what's broken in our people processes and build simple systems that scale as we grow.
What you'll do
People operations: Own the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, documentation, records, leave and attendance, and exits.
Payroll: Own monthly payroll and compliance, including inputs, reconciliations, and employee queries. 
People moments: Make onboarding, offboarding, and farewells thoughtful member experiences, not just checklists.
Internal hiring: Interview candidates for roles we hire internally, and help keep our interview process fair and consistent.
Office experience: Keep the Bangalore office running smoothly, and make it a pleasant, welcoming place for anyone who works from it.
Process building: Spot gaps in our people processes and close them with clear, lightweight systems.
What we're looking for
0–3 years in HR operations, people ops, or a similar role
Exposure to payroll and statutory compliance in India (PF, ESI, PT, TDS) is a plus
Strong attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy
Warmth, discretion, and good judgement in sensitive conversations
Comfort assessing candidates; prior interviewing experience is a plus
An ownership mindset: you see a problem and fix it without waiting to be asked
Comfort with Google Workspace; bonus if you like automating repetitive work
Why join
You'll get real ownership early and room to grow into a broader people role as Weekday scales.

title: Talent Operations Associate Consultant
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client. 

Department:Recruiter Screening - Operations
Location: India (Remote)
Work Schedule: 9 hours /day, 6 days /week
Employment Type: 6-Month Contract (High performance converts to an Extension or Full-time)
 
🚀 Why Join Weekday?
At Weekday, we are building the future of startup hiring. High-growth tech companies and fast-paced startups rely on us to find exceptional talent, fast.
As a Talent Operations Associate Consultant, you will be on the front lines evaluating top-tier talent, conducting research on cutting-edge roles, and running the evaluation engine that connects great candidates with world-class tech companies.
If you are early in your career and looking for a fast-tracked growth opportunity into talent acquisition, startup operations, or people management, this is your launching pad.
 
💡 What You’ll Do (Your Impact)
Conduct High-Impact Candidate Screenings: Lead intro & evaluation calls with candidates to assess their technical/non-technical fit against client company requirements.
Deep-Dive Role Research: Research client roles upfront so you can lead engage-and-answer discussions and guide candidates authoritatively through the process.
Capture Rigorous Data & Evaluation: Collect comprehensive candidate insights covering structured rubric points to ensure candidates meet client interview standards.
Manage Candidate Experience & Feedback: Own candidate communication from end to end, managing feedback loops, status updates, and handoffs to Account Managers.
Master Talent Operations Tools: Leverage modern recruiting and operational software (Airtable, Slack, CRM tools) to deliver accurate reporting and maintain high quality standards.
Fast-Track POD Leadership: Step up into a POD Lead role—guiding a sub-team of 2–3 associates, driving daily operational targets, coaching team members, and helping scale your POD to maintain high screening standards. 
🎯 Who You Are
We are looking for self-starters who are eager to learn and execute with excellence. You will thrive in this role if you are:
An Early Career Professional or Fresh Graduate: You have 0–1 years of experience (Graduates in BBA, Psychology, Engineering, or related fields are highly encouraged to apply!).
An Exceptional Communicator: You possess fluent written and spoken English skills with the confidence to lead candidate calls professionally.
A Fast Learner & Research-Minded: You can quickly grasp job descriptions across technical and non-technical domains and synthesize information quickly.
Coachable & Action-Oriented: You absorb feedback rapidly, adapt to fast-changing environments, and enjoy hitting daily operational goals.
Aspiring Leader: You are eager to move beyond individual execution and take on pod leadership, team coaching, and operational performance tracking early in your career. 
Bonus points if you have experience with Airtable/Slack or a strong interest in startup hiring!
 
📈 What Your First 90 Days Look Like
First 15 Days (Onboard & Learn): Shadow live screening calls, master internal documentation tools, begin independently conducting 15–20 screening calls/day and progressively ramp up screening volume (target: 25–40 calls/day). 
Days 30–60 (Own & Lead): Run high-quality candidate screens independently while taking on POD Lead responsibilities—coaching a sub-team of 2–3 members, tracking daily metrics, and driving corrective actions to ensure target completion.
Towards 6 Months (Scale & Convert): Help build and mentor your POD team (scaling toward 5 structured PODs across the team) while positioning yourself for contract extension or full-time conversion.
🎁 What’s In It For You?
Direct Path to Full-Time: Outstanding performance directly opens doors for extension of contract or conversion to full-time.
Steep Learning Curve: Learn startup hiring, candidate evaluation, and operational analytics directly from experienced leaders.
Culture of Growth: Work in a high-energy environment where taking ownership is recognized and rewarded.
📋 The Hiring Process
We respect your time and keep our process fast and transparent:
Recruiter Screen (20 mins): Intro call to discuss your goals, background, and alignment.
Hiring Manager Screen & Live Mock Call (30–45 mins): Practical assessment to showcase your research mindset, communication clarity, and coachability with Meghana, who this role will be reporting to.
Culture Check: (20 mins): Alignment on values, motivation, and growth, with Sanjay, who is our Co-founder & COO.

Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

title: Senior Business Analyst, Credit & Analytics
description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.
We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.


Jeeves extends credit to thousands of businesses across Latin America and beyond, and the quality of those decisions depends on the quality of our data. Our Credit & Analytics team has a clear roadmap: reliable portfolio monitoring, better risk models, and more automated credit decisioning. All of it depends on first getting our data foundation right — connecting and maintaining external data sources and cleaning up customer data consents — and today that work competes with day-to-day execution for the same few people.
We're looking for a hands-on Senior Business Analyst to own that foundation and build on it. In your first months you'll lead the work to connect and validate external data (bureau, banking, open finance and tax data), clean up consent records so we can use that data reliably, and turn manual processes into repeatable ones. From there you'll use that data to shape credit policy: underwriting criteria, credit limit strategies, portfolio monitoring and early-warning signals that help us catch losses before they happen.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who likes to get into the data themselves. You'll partner closely with data science, engineering, product, collections and sales, and your work will directly shape how Jeeves makes credit decisions as we scale. It is not a people-management role today.
Location: This is a full-time remote position. #LI-REMOTE

description:

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. You'll sit close to everything that happens after a client is live. Much of this still runs on manual steps, spreadsheets, and human memory. Your job is to run it reliably — and then to make it so it doesn't need to be run manually again.

title: Underwriter, Brazil
description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.
We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.


Brazil is one of Jeeves's fastest-growing markets, and the number of companies applying for our corporate cards there keeps climbing. Every one of those applications needs a thoughtful credit decision, and every approved account needs to be watched over time. Today that work sits largely with one senior underwriter. We're adding an Underwriter to the team so we can keep decisions fast and sound as volume grows, and so the Brazil book is never dependent on a single person.
Alongside traditional credit analysis, our underwriters work closely with AI tools that help organize borrower data, draft parts of the analysis and surface questions worth asking. The judgment and the final call stay with you. We're continually moving more of our workflow onto AI, and you'll be part of shaping how that happens. If you're excited by the idea of building the next version of underwriting while practicing the fundamentals, this role is for you.
You'll work side by side with our senior underwriter in Brazil, analyzing new applications from startups and SMBs, preparing credit recommendations, and helping monitor the existing portfolio for early signs of stress. You'll learn how our scoring models work and when judgment needs to go beyond the model, and you'll build the kind of context on the book that lets you cover confidently when your teammate is out. You'll also work closely with our Sales and Account Management teams in Brazil, who rely on clear, timely answers.
This is a hands-on analyst role with real ownership of a growing share of the queue. You won't hold final approval authority on day one — you'll earn more of it as you build judgment and a track record — and there's a clear path to growing into a senior underwriting role as Brazil scales.
Location: This role is based out of São Paulo and is a full-time hybrid position where it is required to come into our office in São Paulo. #LI-HYBRID

title: Analyst, Banking Alliances
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

 

 About the Role 

We are looking for a driven and knowledgeable Sales Manager to lead Payment Gateway (PG) business growth across strategic high potential locations. The ideal candidate will have a strong grasp of the payments ecosystem, hands-on experience working with banks and financial institutions, and the ability to build and leverage government relationships to drive adoption and revenue. 

Key Responsibilities 

Payment Gateway Sales & Business Development 

• Own end-to-end sales of PG solutions to merchants, enterprises, and institutions in the assigned strategic location 

• Identify, prospect, and close high-value merchants across sectors such as retail, education, healthcare, and government 

• Drive acquisition of new accounts while growing revenue from existing merchant partnerships 

• Pitch and position PG products including payment links, UPI, cards, EMI, and BNPL solutions based on merchant needs 

Bank & Financial Institution Management 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with regional and cooperative banks, NBFCs, and nodal banking partners 

• Lead commercial negotiations including MDR, settlement cycles, credit limits, and partnership terms 

• Coordinate with bank partners for faster onboarding, issue resolution, and co-selling opportunities 

• Stay updated on RBI guidelines, banking circulars, and compliance requirements affecting PG operations 

Government & Institutional Relationships 

• Develop and manage relationships with state and local government bodies, PSUs, and municipalities for PG adoption in public services 

• Identify and pursue opportunities in government collections — utility payments, tax portals, welfare disbursements, and e-governance projects 

• Represent the company in government tenders, RFPs, and empanelment processes 

• Liaise with government officials and decision-makers to position the company as a preferred payments partner 

Commercial Negotiation & Deal Structuring 

• Lead pricing discussions and commercial structuring for large and strategic deals 

• Collaborate with internal product, risk, and finance teams to create customized proposals 

• Ensure deal profitability while maintaining competitive positioning in the market 

Market Intelligence & Reporting 

• Track competitor activity, pricing trends, and emerging merchant needs across assigned strategic locations 

• Provide regular pipeline reports, forecasts, and market insights to regional leadership 

• Represent ground-level feedback to product teams for localization and feature improvements 

What We're Looking For 

Must-Have Skills & Experience 

• 4–8 years of experience in Payment Gateway, Fintech, or Banking sales 

• Deep understanding of PG infrastructure — acquiring banks, payment networks, settlement flows, risk & compliance 

• Proven track record of commercial negotiation with banks or financial institutions 

• Experience managing or engaging with government bodies or PSUs for payments/fintech solutions 

• Strong hunter mentality with a consultative sales approach 

• Excellent communication, relationship management, and stakeholder influence skills 

Good to Have 

• Prior experience working in or extensively covering the assigned strategic location 

• Existing network of merchants, bank officials, or government contacts in Chandigarh, Lucknow, Chennai, Hyderabad, or Kolkata 

• Familiarity with RBI payment regulations, PCI-DSS, and digital payment policies 

• Understanding of GST, e-invoicing, or government payment use cases 

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
 
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

Forward-Deployed Engineer, Agent Studio

About Agent Studio

Agent Studio helps Razorpay merchants run AI agents across payments, checkout, disputes, subscriptions, reconciliation, risk, and customer workflows. We take the messy, undocumented work merchants do every day and turn it into reliable production agents.

The role

We're hiring a Forward-Deployed Engineer who is equal parts engineer, solution consultant, and merchant partner — the single technical owner of the merchant relationship. You'll sit directly with strategic merchants, run the discovery, find the real constraint behind the ask, design the solution, build the first working version, prove whether it moved the metric, and expand from there.

This is a deeply customer-facing role. You'll own the conversation — not hand it off. You'll walk into a room where the business owner, the ops lead, and the dashboard all tell different stories, and you'll be the one who reconciles them into a spec everyone agrees to ship. Then you'll go build it. You earn the customer's trust because you can do both — reshape the ask and write the code.

If you like being close to the problem, comfortable in front of customers, and can ship, this is for you.

What you'll own

Customer discovery & the relationship

  • Own merchant conversations end-to-end — discovery calls, workshops, solution reviews, and rollout check-ins. You're the merchant's trusted technical advisor.
  • Sit inside merchant workflows long enough to understand the real process, not the documented one. Ask who actually does the work and what happens when it fails.
  • Reconcile conflicting signals across business owners, operators, dashboards, CRM, and ticket queues into a clear problem statement.

Solution design & consulting

  • Name the business constraint behind the ask: checkout recovery, dispute win rate, RTO loss, SIP recovery, settlement delay, refund spikes, support load, or cashflow leakage.
  • Convert fuzzy merchant problems into crisp agent specs: success metric, data sources, tool calls, guardrails, human-in-the-loop points, and rollout plan.
  • Decide what the agent does on its own, what it recommends, and where a human must approve.
  • Write the spec clearly enough that product, engineering, legal, and the merchant all agree on what ships.

Hands-on build & integration

  • Build prototypes, connectors, MCP tool specs, eval fixtures, dashboards, and the glue code that gets an agent into production.
  • Debug integration failures across Razorpay systems, merchant systems, external tools, and model behavior.
  • Deploy across the constraints that real merchants have — auth, networking, data access, latency, cost per run, observability, and compliance — and keep them in the design from day one.

Proof, expansion & productization

  • Set quality gates and outcome metrics before rollout. Track production outcomes, not demo applause.
  • Measure whether the agent moved the target metric. If it didn't, diagnose and fix — or kill it with evidence.
  • Drive expansion through building: spot the next high-value use case, prototype it, and deepen the merchant's agent footprint over time.
  • Turn repeated field patterns into reusable Agent Studio capabilities — connectors, templates, eval packs, docs, platform requirements. You are the field voice that shapes what the platform builds next.

You may be a fit if you

  • Have 3+ years shipping production software, and are strong in Python or TypeScript.
  • Have worked directly with customers, enterprise stakeholders, or operators — and are comfortable owning the room and the technical relationship.
  • Have hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, auth, data pipelines, and production debugging.
  • Have practical LLM/agent experience: prompts, tool calling, RAG, evals, or workflow automation.
  • Prefer ambiguous, high-context problems over clean tickets.
  • Take ambiguous problems, define the structure, and drive them to resolution 
  • Write clearly — specs, implementation plans, and crisp follow-ups.

Strong pluses

  • Prior shape: solutions engineer, solution consultant, sales engineer, founding engineer, product engineer, applied AI engineer, or an operator who wrote code.
  • Payments, fintech, ecommerce, subscriptions, risk, reconciliation, settlement, or finance-ops experience.
  • Worked with MCP servers, agent skills, multi-agent workflows, eval harnesses, or LLM observability.
  • Enterprise integration experience: private connectors, VPC/on-prem constraints, SOC2/ISO reviews.

What this role is not

  • Not a pre-sales demo role where success is a slick walkthrough.
  • Not a pure implementation role where success is shipping whatever the merchant asked for.
  • Not a support role where success is closing tickets.
  • Not a research role where success is a clever agent that never reaches production.

About The Role

Ready to architect game-changing payment solutions for Malaysia & Singapore’s leading enterprises? 

As a Solution Consultant at Curlec, now part of the dynamic Razorpay group, you'll spearhead the technical vision and implementation of customized payment strategies. If you're a tech enthusiast with a knack for problem-solving and a passion for driving innovation in the fintech space, this is your chance to make a significant impact.

 

Responsibilities

  • Pre-sales Scoping 
    • Conduct in-depth technical discovery sessions with potential enterprise clients to understand their business objectives and technical landscape.
    • Develop and present tailored solution proposals, demonstrating the value and technical feasibility of Curlec's offerings.
  • Implementation & Onboarding 
    • Lead the technical onboarding of enterprise clients, ensuring seamless integration of customized Razorpay’s payment solutions with their existing systems.
    • Collaborate with technical teams to oversee the development and configuration of bespoke solutions. 
  • Project/Program Management - 
    • Manage project timelines and act as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise clients throughout the solution delivery process.
    • Facilitate clear communication between clients, Enterprise Sales, and internal Technical/Product teams.
  • Innovation & Optimisation - 
    • Evaluate Razorpay’s products against industry trends and client feedback to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
    • Work with the Product team to design and propose new features and solutions aligned with market demands.
  • Support & process improvement - 
    • Troubleshoot technical issues and collaborate with a global team to ensure timely resolution for enterprise clients.
    • Identify areas for process optimization and contribute to streamlining internal workflows.
  • AI & Productivity Enablement
    • Leverage AI tools to enhance proposal development, improve client communication, streamline documentation, and support more efficient solutioning during pre-sales and onboarding stages.

 

Requirements

  1. A minimum of 2-5 years of professional experience, with at least 2 years spent directly engaging with clients in a technical consulting or presales capacity, ideally within the fintech or payments industry.
  2. Deep technical acumen in modern software architectures, including microservices, RESTful APIs, etc
  3. A comprehensive understanding of security best practices, regulatory compliance frameworks relevant to financial services (including PCI DSS), and data privacy principles.
  4. Extensive knowledge of the end-to-end payment lifecycle, tokenization, and familiarity with various payment channels is a huge plus (e.g., cards, e-wallets, FPX).
  5. A proven track record of effectively eliciting and documenting detailed technical requirements from diverse stakeholders and translating them into clear architectural designs and specifications.
  6. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive mindset to identify and address potential challenges. 
  7. Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and 1  concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.   
  8. Demonstrated ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively within cross-functional teams, managing multiple tasks and deadlines effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  9. Must possess fluency in Malay to effectively engage with local clients and stakeholders. 
  10. Strong proficiency in Mandarin is highly desirable due to our diverse client base across Malaysia & Singapore .
  11. Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT or similar) and the ability to use them to enhance presentations, proposals, client communication, and day-to-day productivity.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Large amounts of autonomy and empowerment in your work
  • Opportunity to join an award winning startup that is now part of the Razorpay group, one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the world
  • Grow with us. Working in the intersection of Fintech and SaaS, you will have the opportunities to grow in this thriving sector

 

Location & Commitments

Permanent full-time role based at our office in Bangsar South

If you'd like to apply for this role, please contact us at hr@curlec.com.

Please attach your CV and tell us why you would be a great fit for our Team.

Technical Account Manager – Global / US accounts

Razorpay | Super Enterprise Account Success

Role Summary

The Technical Account Manager owns the technical relationship with Razorpay's most strategic global customers. You are accountable for both reactive excellence—owning high-priority incidents and escalations through to resolution—and proactive account health—identifying risks before they become incidents, driving remediation plans, and serving as the customer's trusted technical advisor.

This is not an escalation coordinator or ticket manager role. This is the technical owner of enterprise customer outcomes.

What You Will Own

Reactive Ownership

  • Own incidents end-to-end — coordinate Engineering, SRA, Product, Risk, Operations; establish ownership, timelines, next steps, and customer communication; drive through resolution, RCA, and preventive actions
  • Meet contractual SLAs and internal commitments without exception — escalate early based on business impact, not SLA proximity
  • Communicate complex technical incidents to customer engineering teams and C-level stakeholders during live outages with clarity and composure
  • Ensure no critical issue is lost between teams — you are the single point of technical accountability

Proactive Account Health

  • Build and maintain a technical account plan for every assigned customer — understand their payment architecture, integrations, transaction flows, critical business journeys, and technical dependencies
  • Monitor account health continuously — analyze ticket trends, API error patterns, recurring issues, integration failures, reliability signals, and operational anomalies to identify risks before they escalate
  • Drive technical health reviews — present findings, remediation plans, owners, and deadlines; partner with CSM/Account teams to incorporate technical health into QBRs and account strategy
  • Prepare customers for launches, peak traffic events, migrations, and major releases — conduct readiness assessments and proactive capacity planning
  • Reduce repeat incidents over time — your success is measured by fewer avoidable escalations, not higher ticket volume

Technical Depth

  • Troubleshoot API integrations — webhook delivery failures, authentication issues, payment lifecycle anomalies, duplicate-event handling, idempotency violations, latency spikes, refund/settlement discrepancies, and dispute workflows
  • Interpret logs, trace transaction states — diagnose integration architecture issues, and guide customers through production vs. test environment differences
  • Translate technical root causes into executive-level business impact and remediation plans

What You Bring

Experience

  • 3–5+ years in Enterprise Technical Account Management, Technical Customer Success, Enterprise Support, Solutions Architecture, Customer Engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles
  • Enterprise/global customer experience required — fintech/payments experience strongly preferred but not mandatory if you bring excellent API/SaaS experience
  • Track record of managing P1/P2 incidents at scale and driving cross-functional escalations in high-pressure environments
  • Strong API/integration understanding — REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous event processing, error handling, integration patterns, and production reliability concepts

Capabilities

  • Executive communication — written and verbal English at a level suitable for C-level stakeholders during live incidents
  • Strong RCA and structured problem-solving capabilities
  • Cross-functional influence without authority — comfortable challenging Engineering, Product, or SRE constructively when customer outcomes are at risk
  • Ability to operate effectively across US and India time zones — comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience

What Great Looks Like

Extreme ownership • Customer obsession without being customer-controlled • Bias for action • Calm under pressure • Data-driven decision making • Ability to simplify complexity • Strong judgement—knows when to escalate and when to solve • Executive presence • Technical curiosity • Structured problem-solving • Ability to identify risks before they become escalations • Strong follow-through • Challenges respectfully; influences without friction

Success Measures

  • All Incident response and resolution SLA adherence
  • Escalation ageing and time-to-close performance
  • Repeat incident reduction and RCA completion quality
  • Customer technical health score improvement
  • Proactive risk identification rate (issues flagged before customer-impacting)
  • Preventive action closure within committed timelines
  • NPS satisfaction (NPS) on incident management and technical guidance
  • QBR/account-health readiness and stakeholder alignment
  • Reduction in recurring technical issues over time

Overview of the role:

We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You'll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale, while owning problems end to end. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. We leverage the latest deep learning models alongside classical machine learning techniques to build innovative solutions.

As the heart of the InMobi Exchange, our team optimizes the company's core business functions and creates the strategic moat that sets us apart in the market. As an Applied Scientist, you will not just "use models"—you will formulate them, evaluate their assumptions, tailor them to our problem domain, and bring them to life in production. Many of our challenges have no off-the-shelf solutions; we require scientific creativity to bridge research and reality.

If you thrive on solving complex, high-impact problems and want to see your ideas shape the future of a global exchange, this is the place where your work will truly make a difference.

The impact you'll make:

  • Formulate, analyze, and implement algorithms that power real-time auctions, dynamic pricing, bid shaping, pacing, and traffic allocation across a massive-scale ad marketplace.
  • Design and experiment with methods in online learning, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, forecasting, game theory, and Bayesian modeling—in non-stationary, adversarial environments.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy your models in production and run real-world experiments with rapid feedback loops (measured in hours, not weeks).
  • Participate in scientific design reviews and contribute to raising the methodological bar of the team.
  • Contribute to the scientific community by publishing high-quality research, conducting internal seminars, and staying abreast of advances in machine learning, algorithms, and applied statistics.
  • Evaluate the long-term dynamics of deployed algorithms, incorporating feedback, exploitation-exploration trade-offs, and incentives within multi-agent systems.
  • Help identify new areas for innovation by translating business challenges into research questions and proposing novel, high-impact methodologies.
  • Translate mathematical ideas into practical, high-performance algorithms that operate at scale in production environments.
  • Explore and close the loop between model predictions and real-world outcomes, refining algorithms based on system behavior.

The experience we need:

  • A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline is strongly preferred. A degree is not a hard requirement—demonstrated research depth and production impact count.
  • 4–7 years of experience working on algorithmic or applied research problems, including significant production deployment experience. Candidates with more or less experience are welcome to apply—we hire across Applied Scientist II, Applied Scientist III, and Staff Applied Scientist levels.
  • Deep grounding in one or more of:
    • Statistical learning theory, mathematical optimization, discrete algorithms, probability theory, and information theory
    • Causal inference, decision theory, game theory, auction theory
    • Online learning, bandits, RL, Bayesian methods
  • Strong publication record (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, AISTATS, KDD, UAI, WSDM, EC, SODA, COLT) is a strong plus—even if not recent.
  • Proficient in scientific computing with Python, including packages such as NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Comfortable working with big data platforms like Apache Spark, distributed computing, and large-scale datasets.
  • A researcher's mindset: questions first, implementation later. You are thoughtful about assumptions and rigorous about validation.
  • End-to-end ownership: you can go from idea to production and thrive in applied settings.

Prior experience in ad tech, marketplaces, or dynamic pricing is helpful but not required.

Overview of the Role:

We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You’ll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. We leverage the latest deep learning models alongside classical machine learning techniques to build innovative solutions.

As the heart of the InMobi Exchange, our team optimizes the company’s core business functions and creates the strategic moat that sets us apart in the market. You will not just “use models”—you will formulate them, evaluate their assumptions, tailor them to our problem domain, and bring them to life in production. Many of our challenges have no off-the-shelf solutions; we require scientific creativity to bridge research and reality.

If you thrive on solving complex, high-impact problems and want to see your ideas shape the future of a global exchange, this is the place where your work will truly make a difference.

Location: This role is based on-site in our San Mateo, CA office

The Impact You'll Make:

In this role, you’ll operate at the intersection of cutting-edge research and massive-scale production, shaping algorithms that power a global advertising marketplace, making tens of trillions of real-time decisions every day. You’ll work in an environment where models are continuously tested, evaluated, and refined — with rapid learning loops measured in hours, not weeks. Collaborating with a team that values algorithmic depth and scientific rigor, you’ll have the opportunity to prototype, publish, and deploy work that drives measurable business impact.

  • Formulate, analyze, and implement algorithms that power real-time auctions, dynamic pricing, bid shaping, pacing, and traffic allocation across a massive-scale ad marketplace.
  • Design and experiment with methods in online learning, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, forecasting, game theory, and Bayesian modeling—in non-stationary, adversarial environments.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy your models in production and run real-world experiments with rapid feedback loops (measured in hours, not weeks).
  • Contribute to the scientific community by publishing high-quality research, conducting internal seminars, and staying abreast of advances in machine learning, algorithms, and applied statistics.
  • Evaluate the long-term dynamics of deployed algorithms, incorporating feedback, exploitation-exploration trade-offs, and incentives within multi-agent systems.
  • Identify new areas for innovation by translating business challenges into research questions and proposing novel, high-impact methodologies.
  • Translate mathematical ideas into practical, high-performance algorithms that operate at scale in production environments.
  • Explore and close the loop between model predictions and real-world outcomes, refining algorithms based on system behavior.

  • Ph.D. (preferred) or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 5.5–7 years of experience working on algorithmic or applied research problems, ideally with some production deployment experience.
  • Deep grounding in one or more of:
    • Statistical learning theory, optimization, probability theory, and information theory
    • Causal inference, decision theory, game theory
    • Online learning, bandits, RL, Bayesian methods
  • Strong publication record (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, AISTATS, KDD, UAI, WSDM, EC, SODA, COLT) is a strong plus—even if not recent.
  • Proficient in scientific computing with Python, including packages such as NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Comfortable working with big data platforms like Apache Spark, distributed computing, and large-scale datasets.
  • A researcher’s mindset: questions first, implementation later. You are thoughtful about assumptions and rigorous about validation.
  • End-to-end ownership: you can go from idea to production and thrive in applied settings.
  • Prior experience in ad tech, marketplaces, or dynamic pricing is helpful but not required.

  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

The base salary (fixed) for this role ranges from $148,200 USD to $216,500 USD (min to max of base salary pay range). This salary range is applicable for our offices located in California and New York*.

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.

Glance

Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

What is the role about?

Reporting to InMobi Advertising's VP, Revenue Operations & Chief of Staff, you will lead Revenue Operations — the operational engine of InMobi's Go-To-Market organization. You own three integrated pillars: Sales Technology, SalesOps, and Compensation. This role directly supports the global revenue organization, partnering with sales and services teams across every major global market.

You are accountable for ensuring the right people chase the right accounts, with the right tools, measured against the right goals. You will also lead AI transformation across the revenue organization, identifying where AI and automation create meaningful operational leverage and driving adoption end-to-end. The right candidate brings a bias for action, a 1:1 say/do ratio, and a demonstrated track record of holding teams accountable to their commitments.

What will you be doing?

RevOps Area of Ownership

  • Sales Technology: Own the end-to-end GTM technology stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Einstein, Fireflies, Slack), ensuring system integrity, data accuracy, and a single source of truth. Own vendor relationships, tech-stack audits, the technology budget, and new employee onboarding across all revenue systems.
  • SalesOps: Own the operating system of the sales organization – sales process design, territory planning and segmentation, quota modeling and allocation, pipeline management and forecasting, and velocity and churn/retention analytics.
  • Compensation: Own compensation policy design, quota structure, performance measurement, the GTM scorecard, and commission administration (accelerators, SPIFs, exceptions). Ensure on-time delivery of actualized performance data to HR for payroll and model incentive scenarios each quarter.

AI Transformation

  • Own the AI transformation roadmap for revenue operations: identify the highest-impact opportunities across all three pillars, and drive initiatives from proof-of-concept through full-scale implementation.
  • Lead adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows – intelligent lead scoring, automated deal analysis, pipeline forecasting, and customer health monitoring.
  • Drive AI fluency across the revenue organization through structured enablement and change management.

Operating Cadence

  • Annual: goal-framework design, territory planning, tech-stack audit, compensation policy refresh, vendor reviews, and budget.
  • Quarterly: run the Actualize → Plan → Deliver cycle across all three pillars – close prior quarter, finalize forecasts and incentive models, and deliver quotas, comp plans, and system builds before quarter start.
  • Weekly: pipeline reviews with sales leaders, activity reviews, hygiene enforcement, adoption monitoring, and support triage.

Team Leadership

  • Lead a multi-function team spanning Sales Technology, SalesOps, and Compensation. Build a high-performance culture where commitments are honored and outcomes take precedence over activity.
  • Set quarterly OKRs for all team members with clear accountability for deliverables and timelines. Report on outcomes with measurable business impact.
  • Be a leader within the Bangalore HQ office, leading cross functionally and using influence to drive outcomes.

What is expected from you?

  • 10–15 years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations within digital advertising, B2B SaaS, or technology.
  • Demonstrated success leading a multi-pillar revenue operations function spanning sales technology, sales operations, and compensation.
  • Experience owning the full revenue lifecycle: sales process design, territory planning, quota modeling, pipeline management, forecasting, velocity analytics, churn/retention, and compensation administration.
  • Track record leading AI or automation transformation initiatives within a revenue or go-to-market organization, from evaluation through adoption.
  • Deep working knowledge of Salesforce, HubSpot, Looker, and revenue intelligence platforms (Einstein, Gong, Clari, Fireflies).
  • Proven leadership of cross-functional teams at a global scale with documented business impact and a track record of holding teams to deliverables.

Skills & Attributes

  • Bias for action: You move decisively, prioritize execution, and course-correct as needed.
  • 1:1 say/do ratio: Your commitments are reliable. You deliver what you promise, when you promise it.
  • Accountability-driven: You set clear expectations and hold yourself and your team to them as an operating principle.
  • Solution-oriented: Every problem comes with a proposed path forward.
  • Analytical rigor with the ability to translate complex data into business decisions.
  • Strong project management discipline across multiple concurrent functional areas.
  • Excellent communication skills with an emphasis on clarity, directness, and follow-through.
  • Experience in high-growth, fast-paced technology environments. Familiarity with revenue recognition principles, financial planning, and tools such as Excel, SQL, or Tableau.

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
