About the Role 

Glance operates one of the world’s largest owned-and-operated mobile surfaces, reaching hundreds of millions of users across US, India, LATAM, Japan and Southeast Asia. 

As Director – Programmatic Monetization, you will own the programmatic business end-to-end — from revenue and yield to demand partnerships, auction strategy, new monetization capabilities and the team that drives them. 

This is a global leadership role with direct accountability for building the next phase of Glance’s programmatic monetization engine. 

What will you be doing?

  • Revenue & Growth: Own global programmatic revenue, growth strategy, annual plans and forecasts across markets. 
  • Global Demand Partnerships: Build and manage senior relationships with SSPs, exchanges and agencies, including commercial terms, strategic partnerships and supply commitments. 
  • Deals & Auction Packages: Drive growth of PMP, PG and curated auction packages, increasing their contribution to overall programmatic revenue. 
  • Programmatic Capabilities: Define and build new auction, bidding, yield and monetization capabilities that expand what Glance can monetize. 
  • Format Innovation: Identify, develop and scale new ad formats and placements across Glance’s surfaces while balancing monetization with user experience. 
  • AI-First Monetization: Establish AI as a core operating layer for the monetization function — using AI to forecast, detect anomalies, optimize yield, automate reporting and improve decision-making, while applying judgment on where AI adds real value. 
  • Policy & Platform Readiness: Ensure compliance with platform, privacy and industry policies, while driving Glance’s approval, onboarding and readiness across major demand platforms. 
  • Industry Representation: Represent Glance with global demand partners, industry forums and relevant advertising bodies, shaping conversations around programmatic, publisher monetization and emerging standards. 
  • Team & Organization: Build, structure and scale the programmatic monetization organization, establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms and strong functional depth. 

What is expected out of you?

  • 12+ years of experience in ad tech, with senior ownership of programmatic or publisher-side revenue at a large publisher, SSP, exchange, app developer or similar ecosystem. 
  • A proven track record of owning revenue metrics with experience building plans, forecasts and growth strategies. 
  • Deep hands-on understanding of the programmatic stack, including auction mechanics, bidding architecture, ad serving, measurement, identity and yield optimization. You should be able to go deep enough with engineering and partners to challenge assumptions and identify the real constraint. 
  • Strong publisher-side monetization expertise, including pricing, yield management, demand optimization and the trade-offs between revenue, fill, latency and user experience. 
  • Leverage AI to drive efficiency and performance — use AI models and tooling to forecast performance, identify anomalies, optimize yield, automate workflows and reduce manual reporting, while applying human judgment where it adds the most value. 
  • Experience operating across multiple global markets, with a strong understanding of how programmatic strategy, demand dynamics, pricing and user behavior differ by geography. US market experience is a strong plus. 
  • A demonstrated ability to build, lead and level up high-performing teams, with experience hiring strong talent, developing leaders and creating scalable operating structures. 
  • Strong commercial and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across product, engineering, sales, finance, legal and external partners. 
  • A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between long-term business strategy and the technical details of an auction happening today.

You could be designing a campaign one day, shooting an employee story the next, editing a reel, creating a handbook or experimenting with AI to find a better way to bring an idea to life.

  • Curious and highly tech-savvy, with an interest in AI and new creative tools. 
  • Comfortable using tools such as Claude, Canva, Photoshop and other AI/design platforms to experiment and create.

description:

Overview of the Role:

As our Administration and Workspace Lead, you’ll own the day-to-day administration and facilities operations of our San Mateo, CA office. You'll make sure employees have a safe, well-maintained workplace and office services they can count on, while keeping expenses, vendor documentation, and operational reporting accurate and within approved budgets.

You’ll be the primary local contact for all workplace matters, coordinating service providers and partnering closely with our global Workspace team, HR, IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and building management. This is a hands-on lead role that calls for independent judgment, proactive follow-through, and a strong service mindset.

If you take pride in creating a workplace where everything runs smoothly, and people feel taken care of from the moment they walk in, this role is for you.

Location: This position is based onsite in our San Mateo, California office.

The Impact You’ll Make:

Office Operations & Facilities

  • Lead daily office operations, conducting regular walkthroughs and maintaining an action tracker for repairs, employee requests, and service issues
  • Coordinate preventive maintenance and repairs with building management and qualified vendors, covering facilities, furniture, lighting, air conditioning, plumbing, pantry equipment, and other workplace assets
  • Keep workstations, meeting rooms, reception areas, and shared spaces ready for use, and coordinate room bookings and office arrangements for meetings and leadership visits
  • Maintain the visibility and condition of InMobi signage, logos, and approved branding throughout the office
  • Keep stationery, office supplies, and pantry items well stocked through inventory checks, reorder levels, and consumption tracking

Vendor & Landlord Management

  • Serve as the local point of contact for the landlord, building management, and vendors supporting cleaning, catering, maintenance, security, pest control, transportation, and other office services
  • Obtain and compare quotes, recommend the right service providers, and coordinate onboarding through the company’s approval and procurement processes
  • Ensure signed agreements are in place for every engaged vendor, and maintain accessible records of contracts, service scope, pricing, contact details, and supporting documents
  • Track lease and vendor contract obligations, renewal dates, notice periods, and service commitments, escalating upcoming decisions to Workspace leadership and Legal well in advance
  • Review vendor performance, address recurring service gaps, and arrange approved backup options to minimize disruption

Payments, Budgets & Expense Reporting

  • Coordinate timely payment of rent, maintenance charges, utilities, and approved vendor bills by securing accurate invoices and required approvals and following up with Finance
  • Maintain complete payment records for audit and reconciliation, including invoices, approvals, purchase orders where applicable, receipts, and payment acknowledgments
  • Prepare monthly office expense reports and forecasts, track spending against the approved budget, explain variances, and obtain approval before making additional commitments
  • Tag expenses clearly by location, purpose or occasion, category, and budget owner, and partner with HR and Finance to distinguish HR expenses from Workspace expenses
  • Reconcile office credit card transactions with receipts and business purposes, submit documentation on time, and follow up on missing or disputed transactions
  • Identify practical savings through vendor reviews, demand planning, and reduced waste, while maintaining agreed service standards

Meals, Pantry & Employee Experience

  • Manage employee breakfast and lunch arrangements, including headcount planning, vendor coordination, delivery schedules, food quality, and employee feedback
  • Coordinate dietary requirements and allergen information with meal providers, and ensure meals are handled and served appropriately
  • Keep drinking water, coffee machines, snacks, and pantry essentials available, replenished, and maintained, monitoring expiration dates to avoid unnecessary waste
  • Gather employee feedback on facilities and services, respond to concerns, and keep people updated until issues are resolved

Travel, Visitors & Events

  • Assist employees and visiting colleagues with approved hotel bookings, car services, and other local travel arrangements in line with company policy
  • Plan monthly employee engagement activities with HR and the Workspace team, reflecting local culture and employee interests within approved budgets
  • Coordinate local and international celebrations, office events, and leadership visits once the required admin and budget approvals are in place
  • Communicate approved regional holidays and relevant office service changes to employees by email, in coordination with HR

Safety, Security & Emergency Readiness

  • Maintain a safe and secure workplace through regular checks, prompt reporting of hazards, and coordination with building management, Security, and relevant internal teams
  • Coordinate fire drills, evacuation readiness, emergency contact lists, and employee awareness of emergency procedures, keeping exits and emergency access routes clear
  • Track inspections and servicing of fire safety equipment with building management and qualified providers, arranging refills or replacements when due and retaining service records
  • Keep a well-stocked first-aid kit available, check expiration dates regularly, arrange replenishment, and coordinate with designated trained responders when assistance is needed
  • Maintain an emergency escalation plan covering employee safety incidents, building issues, and major service disruptions, documenting incidents and tracking corrective actions
  • Provide after-hours emergency coordination, including weekends and holidays when required, under an agreed escalation and coverage arrangement, escalating promptly and coordinating backup support

Cleaning, Hygiene & Pest Management

  • Supervise routine housekeeping and weekly deep cleaning, using checklists that cover work areas, meeting rooms, restrooms, pantry areas, and shared spaces
  • Monitor hygiene standards, waste collection, and housekeeping quality, following up promptly on deficiencies and maintaining cleaning records
  • Coordinate pest-control inspections or service visits every two weeks, and arrange treatment or fumigation when qualified providers assess it as necessary, with appropriate approvals and employee communication
  • Schedule disruptive cleaning or treatment activities to minimize interruption, and follow the provider’s instructions for safe access and re-entry

Onboarding & Offboarding Support

  • Partner with HR to prepare welcome kits, workplace access, seating, and local office orientation for new hires
  • Work with IT and HR to coordinate laptop delivery and setup before each new hire’s start date, tracking readiness and escalating delays to the responsible team
  • Support HR with meeting room bookings and office arrangements for induction sessions
  • Coordinate with HR and IT to collect laptops, access cards, and other company assets from departing employees, maintaining handover records and obtaining confirmation from the responsible teams

Policy Compliance & Operational Reporting

  • Follow company policies and coordinate with relevant internal specialists and vendors to meet applicable local requirements for office operations
  • Maintain organized records of contracts, expenses, inventories, safety checks, and service schedules, handling employee and business information confidentially
  • Share regular updates with Workspace leadership on service performance, budgets, employee concerns, risks, and outstanding actions, recommending improvements and tracking their implementation

The Experience We Need:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification; an MBA or a qualification in hospitality, facilities management, or business administration is preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in office administration, workplace operations, facilities management, or hospitality
  • Experience independently managing office services and coordinating multiple vendors, with prior lead or supervisory experience preferred
  • Experience supporting a US corporate office, including working with local vendors and building management, is preferred
  • Hands-on experience with expense tracking, invoice documentation, budgets, contract administration, and employee service requests

Skills & Working Style

  • Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate clearly with employees, vendors, leadership, and global teams
  • Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, including the ability to maintain expense trackers, analyze spending, and prepare clear operational updates
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing requests without losing follow-through
  • Sound judgment in prioritizing urgent issues, making decisions within delegated authority, and escalating risks early
  • A professional, approachable service style, with discretion when handling confidential information
  • The ability to guide service providers, negotiate practical solutions, and hold vendors accountable for agreed standards
  • Availability for on-site office support and coordination across time zones, with flexibility for planned events and emergency coverage under agreed arrangements

At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks 

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location. 

The base salary (fixed) for this role ranges from $105,500 to $120,000 USD (min to max of base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*.

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles, in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.

A quick snapshot of our U.S. benefits:

  • Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)        
  • High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)       
  • 401(k) company match 
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays   
  • Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and compassionate work environment 
  • Flexible working hours to suit everyone 
  • Wellness stipend for a healthier you!      
  • Free lunch is provided in our offices daily   
  • Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals! 
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)   

If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Go for it!

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer      

InMobi is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.

  • Own weekly exec level revenue/ margin reporting for the portfolio of accounts.
  • Ability to take ownership and getting things done in the stipulated time.

  • 5-6 years of experience in a Digital Native / Startup companies, involved Data Analysis with actionable insights / Revenue Management

Title: Manager - Executive Assistant

Position Summary:

We are looking for a highly experienced and proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and strategic support to senior leadership. This is a high-visibility role that demands exceptional discretion, sharp organizational instincts, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment.

The ideal candidate will bring at least 7-8 years of EA experience, ideally supporting C-suite or senior leadership, and will be comfortable managing competing priorities while maintaining confidentiality at all times. Experience working directly with Founders and/or CEOs is a strong advantage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Calendar & Schedule Management

  • Own and manage complex, multi-time zone calendars for one or more senior leaders
  • Proactively anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts
  • Coordinate internal/external meetings, calls, and events across time zones and departments

2. Communication & Correspondence

  • Draft, review, and manage professional correspondence and memos on behalf of leadership
  • Act as primary point of contact — screening and triaging high-volume email and requests
  • Liaise confidently with internal stakeholders, external partners, clients, and senior executives

3. Administrative & Operational Support

  • Prepare, format, and organize reports, presentations, and business documents
  • Maintain organized filing systems for sensitive records and correspondence
  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers, tracking key deliverables and timelines
  • Manage contracts, invoices, and expense workflows through approval and signature processes

4. Travel & Logistics

  • Arrange comprehensive domestic and international travel — flights, hotels, visas, and itineraries
  • Prepare detailed trip briefings aligned with meeting objectives and business priorities

5. Project & Operations Support

  • Drive coordination across cross-functional projects and initiatives
  • Track action items and deliverables from leadership meetings
  • Prepare agendas, presentations, and board-level materials as required
  • Support budget tracking, invoicing, and expense reporting for the leadership office

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Prior experience in a corporate, professional services, or fast-paced business environment strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline
  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive, confidential information with discretion

With rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high impact, performance driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company’s Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.

At InMobi Advertising, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com

Role overview

We are looking for a Lead – Workspace Transportation to manage employee transportation for our Bangalore office. As the service expands, this role will own daily operations, vendor performance, route planning, employee communication, and cost control, with a strong focus on safety and reliable pickup and drop services.

The lead will be the primary contact for transportation matters and work closely with Workspace leadership, transport partners, Security, HR, Finance, and Procurement. The role requires hands-on operational ownership, sound judgment during disruptions, and a practical understanding of Bangalore traffic and employee commuting needs.

Key responsibilities

Daily operations and capacity planning

  • Oversee daily pickup and drop operations, including trip scheduling, vehicle allocation, driver readiness, dispatch, and completion tracking.
  • Plan service capacity using employee demand, office attendance, shift timings, new joiner requirements, and approved service coverage.
  • Coordinate route planning and pickup points to balance employee convenience, travel time, vehicle occupancy, and cost. Review routes regularly as demand changes.
  • Account for Bangalore traffic, rain, road closures, and peak-hour congestion when setting schedules. Arrange approved backup vehicles and vendors for disruptions.
  • Monitor live trips through the transport platform and vendor control teams. Respond promptly to delays, missed pickups, vehicle breakdowns, and last-minute changes.
  • Maintain clear operating procedures for bookings, cancellations, no-shows, route changes, exceptions, and escalation handovers.

Vendor and driver management

  • Manage transport partners against agreed service levels, fleet commitments, pricing, and response times. Conduct regular reviews and document corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with vendor supervisors and dispatch teams to ensure sufficient vehicles, qualified drivers, and operational support for each service window.
  • Assess proposed vendors with Procurement and relevant teams, compare quotations, and support commercial discussions and onboarding.
  • Monitor driver conduct, punctuality, route adherence, and complaints. Require vendors to address inappropriate behaviour and recurring performance issues.
  • Track vendor contracts, renewal dates, rate cards, and service commitments. Maintain an updated contact directory and escalation matrix.

Safety service quality and financial ownership

Employee safety and transport compliance

  • Coordinate verification of driver identity, licences, background checks, and required vehicle documents through approved company and vendor processes.
  • Track validity of applicable vehicle permits, insurance, fitness, pollution certificates, and other required records with vendors and the relevant internal teams.
  • Ensure vendors follow company-approved transport safety procedures, including applicable requirements for late-hour travel and women employee safety.
  • Monitor the availability and functioning of required vehicle safety features, tracking systems, emergency contacts, and communication arrangements.
  • Coordinate periodic vehicle and service checks with vendors. Escalate unsafe vehicles or drivers promptly and arrange replacements before service resumes.
  • Handle employee location, contact, and trip data confidentially, with access and sharing limited to approved business needs.

Escalations and emergency response

  • Act as the primary operational escalation contact for employee transport concerns and coordinate timely resolution with vendors and internal teams.
  • Maintain response procedures for accidents, breakdowns, safety concerns, severe weather, and service disruptions. Coordinate with Security and emergency services when needed.
  • Keep employees informed of delays and alternative arrangements through approved channels, with clear updates until the issue is resolved.
  • Prepare contingency plans for vehicle shortages, vendor outages, and driver availability issues, including approved alternate providers.
  • Document incidents, investigate causes with the responsible teams, and track preventive actions. Escalate material safety or service failures to Workspace leadership.
  • Provide support during critical service windows and after-hours emergencies under an agreed coverage arrangement, with documented backup and handovers.

Budgets billing and cost control

  • Prepare transportation budgets and demand forecasts. Monitor monthly spending and highlight variances or additional funding needs before commitments are made.
  • Validate vendor invoices against completed trips, approved rate cards, kilometres or hours where applicable, and authorised additional charges.
  • Maintain supporting trip records, approvals, purchase orders where applicable, invoices, and reconciliation reports for payment and audit.
  • Work with Finance and Procurement to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure approved payments are processed within agreed timelines.
  • Improve vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, reduce avoidable empty runs and no-shows, and assess savings without compromising safety or agreed service standards.

Employee experience reporting and candidate requirements

Employee communication and continuous improvement

  • Explain transport eligibility, booking processes, pickup schedules, cancellations, and service changes clearly to employees.
  • Coordinate with HR and Workspace teams to support new joiner transport onboarding and changes in employee commuting requirements.
  • Collect employee feedback, track complaints to closure, and identify recurring issues requiring route changes or vendor action.
  • Maintain an operational dashboard covering punctuality, completed and missed trips, occupancy, complaints, incidents, vendor performance, and costs.
  • Share regular updates with Workspace leadership and recommend service improvements supported by operational data. Establish measurable service targets with leadership and vendors.

Education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A qualification in operations, logistics, supply chain, hospitality, or business administration is preferred.
  • Preferably five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate employee transportation, fleet operations, or transport vendor management, including experience independently leading operations.
  • Experience managing multiple transport vendors, service escalations, route planning, billing validation, and operational reporting.
  • Strong understanding of Bangalore commuting patterns and practical experience managing services during traffic congestion and operational disruptions.
  • Experience using employee transport management platforms such as RouteMatic or similar systems is preferred.

Skills and working approach

  • Strong English communication and stakeholder coordination. Working knowledge of Kannada or Hindi is helpful for local vendor coordination.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including expense trackers, data reconciliation, and service dashboards; working knowledge of Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to prioritise live operational issues, make decisions within delegated authority, and escalate risks early.
  • Strong negotiation, attention to detail, and follow-through, with a service mindset and a firm approach to safety and vendor accountability.
  • Ability to guide vendor supervisors and transport coordinators, maintain clear handovers, and support onsite operations across required service windows.

Measures of success

  • Pickup and drop punctuality and trip fulfilment against agreed service targets.
  • Timely resolution of employee concerns and fewer recurring vendor failures.
  • Complete and current driver and vehicle verification records, with safety actions tracked to closure.
  • Accurate billing reconciliation, timely monthly reporting, and spending within approved budgets.
  • Improved vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, supported by a tested contingency and escalation plan.

Overview of the Role:

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to develop and optimize our ad science models, open-source LLMs, and the underlying infrastructure that powers them — with a constant eye toward performance and cost.

AI and ML sit at the core of InMobi's business, and our science teams are tackling some of the field's most interesting problems: creative optimization, user personalization, targeting, yield management, traffic shaping, and more. We're moving fast and deep into architectural research, generative AI adoption, compute scaling on the latest accelerators (GPUs/TPUs), and advances in reinforcement learning.

You'll join a team of experienced researchers and engineers who have been pushing the boundaries of ad science research for over a decade, working closely with data and platform engineering to build solutions that scale and serve the needs of every science team across the organization. This is a chance to shape the infrastructure and models behind ad intelligence operating at truly massive scale.

The Impact You'll Make:

  • Build and support training pipelines and model implementations that maximize experimentation velocity
  • Adapt open-source LLM infrastructure like DeepSpeed and OpenRLHF to meet InMobi-specific post-training needs
  • Optimize online and batch inference for low latency and cost efficiency
  • Build monitoring and evaluation solutions that keep our infrastructure reliable and our models behaving as expected
  • Leverage the breadth of data features across our product portfolio to strengthen our data pipelines and unlock new features for training and inference
  • Explore new platforms and ecosystems (e.g., JAX on TPUs) to help diversify our compute
  • Collaborate closely with Applied Scientists on active research, contributing directly to experiment design and modeling

  • Master's degree in machine learning or a related field required; a PhD is a plus
  • At least 3 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, building state-of-the-art machine learning/deep learning systems at extreme scale
  • Expertise in large-scale distributed data systems, including high-performance relational and key-value stores, orchestrators like Airflow, and data transformations in Spark
  • Expertise in Python; familiarity with Java (especially in high-performance serving systems) is a plus
  • Expertise in PyTorch or a similar ecosystem
  • Experience with accelerator-based inference systems such as Triton, and optimization backends like ONNX and TensorRT
  • Experience with cloud platforms and container orchestration using Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of deep recommender systems, including two-tower and attention-based architectures, is a plus

  • Understanding of the ads ecosystem (OpenRTB, SSPs, DSPs, ad exchanges, MMPs) is a plus

GTM Strategy and Product Marketing

Sales Planning and Strategic Solutioning

  • Design visually compelling, story-driven presentations for customers, agencies, Sales teams, and leadership audiences. 
  • Establish best practices and quality standards for all customer-facing deliverables across the Sales Planning team. 

Sales Enablement 

  • Build scalable sales enablement programs that improve seller productivity, solution confidence, and win rates. 
  • Equip Sales teams with best-in-class market insights, competitive intelligence, messaging frameworks, customer stories, and objection-handling tools. 
  • Partner with regional Sales leaders to identify enablement gaps and proactively develop solutions aligned to revenue priorities. 
  • Work with centralized Marketing execution teams to bring GTM strategies to life through vertical narratives, tentpole collateral, case studies, demand and supply collateral, and industry events. 

AI Transformation 

  • Lead the adoption of AI across the Sales Planning function and define an AI-first operating model for the team. 
  • Build scalable AI workflows that automate research, proposal generation, content development, presentation creation, and knowledge reuse. 
  • Develop prompt libraries, AI playbooks, and reusable frameworks that improve quality, consistency, and productivity. 
  • Evaluate and deploy tools such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Gamma, Canva AI, and other emerging platforms. 
  • Coach the broader Sales Planning and Sales organization on prompt engineering, responsible AI use, and high-impact business applications.

  • Mentor and coach Sales Planning professionals in storytelling, PMM fundamentals, client solutioning, AI adoption, and executive communication. 
  • Establish scalable processes, templates, operating rhythms, and measurement frameworks across the function. 
  • Balance long-term strategic planning with hands-on involvement in high-priority customer opportunities.

Experience 

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Strategic Presales, Sales Enablement, GTM, Partner Marketing, or Agency Strategy roles within AdTech, MarTech, Digital Advertising, or related industries. 
  • Strong Product Marketing skill set with demonstrated ownership of messaging, positioning, GTM strategy, product launches, market intelligence, and sales enablement. 
  • Deep understanding of digital advertising, brand marketing, media planning, advertiser and agency needs, and the broader AdTech ecosystem. 
  • Experience working with global Sales organizations and cross-functional teams across multiple regions. 

Product Marketing, Storytelling, and Content 

  • Exceptional storytelling ability, with a strong command of narrative development, messaging frameworks, and customer-centric positioning. 
  • Proven ability to create GTM strategies, product launch narratives, vertical stories, use-case frameworks, and sales enablement programs.

  • Advanced presentation design skills, with a strong focus on visual storytelling, structure, clarity, and executive impact. 
  • Excellent presentation and delivery skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior internal and external audiences. 

AI and Innovation 

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Generative AI platforms such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Gamma, Canva AI, and similar technologies. 
  • Proven experience building AI workflows, prompt libraries, automation frameworks, or AI-powered business processes. 
  • Excellent prompt-building and prompt-engineering skills, with the ability to generate consistently high-quality business outputs. 
  • A track record of introducing new tools and ways of working that improve team productivity and output quality. 

Strategic Leadership and Collaboration 

  • Strong commercial and strategic acumen, with the ability to translate market signals and advertising data into actionable GTM strategies. 
  • Proven ability to influence decision-making without direct authority and collaborate effectively across matrixed global teams. 
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive presence, with the ability to align Product, Sales, Marketing, and leadership teams. 
  • Demonstrated mentoring and coaching capability, with a commitment to raising the quality bar across the organization. 

Execution and Personal Attributes

Overview of the Role:

The Global Enterprise Marketing team operates across brands, channels, events, and geographies, and moves fast. We're looking for a sharp, organized Marketing Events & Operations Coordinator to be the connective tissue that keeps it all running during our highest-stakes, most visible moments.

This role reports to the Head of Experiential Marketing and supports the broader cross-functional enterprise marketing team across InMobi and Glance, our two distinct businesses. You'll be the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks on our highest-stakes initiatives: milestones are hit, partners are orchestrated, and events get executed with excellence, all while keenly tracking budgets and business results.

The highest priority focus for this role is supporting InMobi Group events in the USA and abroad, including end-to-end coordination across a range of industry events as well as more curated custom activations and experiences, both in-person and virtual. A secondary area of responsibility includes broader marketing operations support, including project coordination, vendor management, budgeting and expense administration, and navigating internal Legal, Finance, and Procurement processes.

This early career role is for someone with 1–3 years of professional experience that has prepared them to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing organization during an accelerated phase of growth. The right candidate takes initiative, is highly organized, resourceful, and naturally curious about the finer details that go into making modern marketing events and organizations successful. They find fulfillment bringing structure to complex projects and coordinating across multiple stakeholders, time zones, and environments without losing momentum.

Location: This role is based on-site in our New York, New York office, with travel up to 50% of the time, both domestic and international.

Event Operations

  • Support the planning and execution of a range of marketing events, including industry conferences and trade shows, partner events, and custom curated experiences designed to delight our most discerning prospects, customers, partners, and internal leadership
  • Build and track cross-functional event plans and milestones, ensuring critical timelines are met while constantly seeking opportunities to standardize and improve processes
  • Coordinate end-to-end event logistics including contract deliverables, lead capture, venue management, hospitality, branding, giveaways, exhibits, product demos, shipping, group housing, meeting schedules, on-site staffing, equipment, and support services
  • Partner with marketing, business, and third-party stakeholders to coordinate pre-event, onsite, and post-event planning, promotion, and measurement
  • Schedule and coordinate internal and partner meetings, including agenda prep, note-taking, and follow-up on action items
  • Coordinate with creative, content, communications, sales, product, and other internal teams to ensure event assets and messaging are produced accurately and on time
  • Provide onsite event support when required, including vendor coordination, setup, registration, troubleshooting, and other executional needs
  • Support post-event wrap-up, including vendor closeout, invoice reconciliation, internal debriefs, ROI, and documentation of learnings and next steps

Vendor Management & Finance Operations

  • Own the end-to-end vendor onboarding process, collecting required documentation, submitting onboarding requests, and ensuring new vendors are set up in company systems before work begins
  • Manage the full contract lifecycle for marketing vendors and partners: initiating requests, routing for review and approvals, tracking signatures, and maintaining a central contracts log
  • Process invoices and expense reports accurately and on time, ensuring vendors are paid according to agreed terms
  • Liaise with Finance and Legal to resolve onboarding or payment issues and keep projects moving
  • Maintain organized records of all vendor agreements, POs, and payment history

General Marketing Operations

  • Provide project coordination and operational support for cross-functional marketing initiatives in close collaboration with peers and marketing management
  • Maintain standard marketing calendars, repositories, project trackers, documentation, templates, and shared resources
  • Identify recurring administrative friction and suggest ways to simplify, automate, and standardize processes
  • Coordinate inputs and deliverables across marketing teams and other internal stakeholders
  • Support marketing budget administration and help maintain accurate records of planned, committed, and actual spend
  • Assist with agency and vendor administration across the broader marketing organization

  • Provide ad hoc operational and project support to the marketing organization as priorities evolve

  • 1–3 years of experience in events, marketing operations, or related roles within a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor relationships, contracts, and invoicing processes
  • Strong project management skills; you track the details, own the follow-up, and don't need to be reminded twice
  • Comfortable working across time zones and coordinating with global teams

Who are we and What do we do? 

InMobi is a global provider of enterprise platform for marketers.  At 20+ offices across the globe, InMobi employs over 1000 personnel constituting 25 nationalities. Acclaimed for its culture, InMobi has consecutively featured on the Great Places to Work (GPTW) list, with a consistent hold in the Top 50 position for the past two years.  InMobi has also regularly featured on world disruptor lists – MIT Technology Review’s 2013 50 Disruptive Companies; Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies for 2016, 2018; CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list of 2018, here InMobi was selected amongst a pool of more than 980 forward-thinking and ambitiou private companies across the globe, we now share this space with the likes of SpaceX, Airbnb, Uber and so on.

 We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise up to challenges, the cutting edge products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that. 
 

What can we promise? 

We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your engineering skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a very reliable, scalable, secure and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on cutting-edge technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader. 

Modern work environment, flexible schedule and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. Internal opportunities to move roles and try out bridge assignments with different teams.  Food for your soul – free meals all days of the week, gym or Yoga class to flex those biceps, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.

InMobi's Supply and Monetization Platform is one of the world's leading ad serving platforms serving 260bn ad requests a day and handling 2.5+ billion users. Our products help advertisers serve ads optimally, optimize relevance of ads to make the advertiser maximize his ROI, and monitor progress of different advertising campaigns.   • Drive architectural decisions, lead technical discussions, and contribute to platform roadmap.

Overview of the Role:

The Senior Account Manager is part of the Direct & Programmatic Demand team, embedded within a revenue pod alongside a dedicated Sales Manager, and working closely with agencies and advertisers across the Americas. Reporting to the VP, Ad Sales, this role will own new customer onboarding, delivering success for their campaigns and new upsell/cross-sell opportunities — while leading internal coordination with sales planning, operations, creative solutions, insights, measurement partnerships, supply partnerships, and tech teams.

Client-facing and regionally embedded, the Lead AM is a primary point of contact for the agency, owns the health of the account post-sale, and is directly responsible for identifying and closing upsell opportunities — that build on the success of the campaigns they run.

Location: This role is open to candidates based in Chicago, IL. Some travel may be required for client meetings and events as needed. 

The Impact You'll Make: 

  • Onboard new advertiser customers in your Revenue pod onto InMobi and Glance ad systems and infrastructure
  • Own the end-to-end delivery and KPI optimization of every deal sold by Sales Manager partners — coordinating research, creative, attribution, ad operations, and any other specialist teams required to execute what was sold.
  • Act as the client's day-to-day point of contact post-sale, managing quarterly account retention and growth plans, revenue and margin management, and overall account health.
  • Own upsell and cross-sell goals for your managed accounts — and track all upsell activities in Salesforce.
  • Partner with your Sales Managers to co-own the account's long-term strategy, bringing proactive, data-driven recommendations and account intelligence that support the pod's overall revenue growth targets.
  • Lead campaign analysis and reviews; provide consultative guidance to clients in weekly or bi-weekly check-ins and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
  • Manage the full solution lifecycle for campaigns individually and across partner teams — pre-sale media planning support, client onboarding, campaign delivery, in-flight optimization, and post-campaign reporting and deliverables.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, revenue strategy, technical account management (TAM), product marketing, ad operations, creative, insights, agency development, and demand partner teams to ensure successful execution and fast resolution of client issues.
  • Work with Technical Account Management and Ops teams to troubleshoot campaign issues, and liaise directly with third-party partners such as DSPs, DMPs, and measurement vendors.
  • Escalate at-risk accounts early — pacing issues, unresolved service problems, or stakeholder changes at the client  
  • Prioritize your week around what each account in your book needs — a renewal conversation, a QBR, resolving a client issue 
  • Surface marketplace feedback and client insights to inform InMobi's broader product and go-to-market strategy 

 How You're Measured:

This role is goaled on two connected outcomes: 

  • Pod revenue growth — shared accountability with your Sales Manager partners for the overall revenue performance of the accounts in your pod
  • Individual revenue contribution — a dedicated, separately tracked upsell target generated from the deals you manage, logged and measured in Salesforce

The Experience We Need:

  • 8+ years of overall client success or account management experience, including at least 4 years in digital and/or programmatic advertising.
  • A proven track record of owning post-sale account health and driving measurable retention and growth within existing client accounts, including experience carrying or contributing to an upsell/renewal target.
  • Strong ownership instincts and proactive communication — comfortable operating as one half of a tight, paired pod (AM + Seller) rather than managing an undifferentiated account list.
  • Strong account management and client success experience, including managing complex agency and brand relationships and co-owning account strategy with a sales partner
  • Hands-on experience with major DSPs and platforms such as The Trade Desk (TTD), DV360, and Amazon DSP is a strong plus

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Salesforce Administrator to join our Revenue Operations team. In this role, you will own the day-to-day configuration, support, and continuous improvement of our Salesforce instance. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to scale processes, eliminate technical debt, and unlock operational productivity.

As our go-to expert for declarative development, you will solve complex business problems through clean configuration, robust automation, and strict data hygiene, while collaborating with developers and architects on advanced initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration and Security

  • Access Control: Manage users, profiles, roles, permission sets/groups, public groups, queues, and sharing rules.
  • Security Architecture: Maintain Org-Wide Defaults (OWD), record-level security, and field-level security (FLS).
  • Core CRM Maintenance: Administer Sales/Service Cloud components including standard/custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, and validation rules.
  • UI Customization: Manage Lightning App Builder, Lightning record pages, and dynamic forms.
  • Org Health: Monitor storage limits, login history, and security health checks.

Automation and Configuration

  • Advanced Flow Builder: Design, build, and optimize screen flows, record-triggered flows, scheduled flows, and autolaunched flows.
  • Legacy Migration: Lead the migration of legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builders to high-performing Flows.
  • Business Logic: Configure approval processes, email alerts, custom notifications, assignment rules, complex formulas, and roll-up summaries.

Reporting, Analytics and Data Management

  • Operational Insights: Build and maintain high-impact reports, dashboards, custom report types, and list views for leadership and cross-functional Ops teams.
  • Data Hygiene: Perform mass data operations (imports, updates, deletions) using Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and Workbench.
  • Data Governance: Lead deduplication efforts, validation rules enforcement, and ongoing data quality audits.

Release Management and Stakeholder Support

  • Environment Strategy: Manage sandbox refreshes, staging environments, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Deployment Execution: Deploy changes via Change Sets or modern deployment tooling.
  • L2 Support: Triage and resolve tier-2 platform support tickets within defined SLAs.
  • Enablement and Docs: Conduct end-user training, build SOPs in Confluence, and translate business requirements into technical documentation.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience: 3–4 years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience within a mid-to-large scale instance.
  • Core Cloud Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud (Service Cloud is a plus).
  • Flow Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Flow Builder, including deep debugging and optimization skills.
  • Data and Security Tooling: Mastery of the Salesforce security model and hands-on experience with Data Loaderand bulk data operations.
  • Analytics Capabilities: Strong reporting skills, including matrix/joined reports, custom report types, and bucket fields.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to translate technical configurations into clear business value.

Required Certifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

Advanced Certifications and Technical Skills

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder certification.
  • Exposure to Salesforce CPQ, Billing, or Revenue Cloud.
  • Read-level proficiency with Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC); basic knowledge of SOQL/SOSL.
  • Familiarity with AppExchange packages (e.g., DocuSign, LeanData, Gong, Outreach, DemandTools).

Domain and Methodology Experience

  • Ad Tech Industry Expertise: Familiarity with programmatic advertising concepts (DSP/SSP, ad exchanges), IO-to-cash workflows, advertiser/publisher account structures, and digital advertising billing models.
  • Agentforce / AI Innovation: Hands-on exposure or a strong technical interest in Salesforce Agentforce (Agent Builder, topics, actions, prompt templates) and AI-driven autonomous agents.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum frameworks using Jira and Confluence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

 

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

Yes, then I would not keep Shooting & Production as a key responsibility. It makes the role sound like you are hiring a videographer + editor. Keep the JD very strongly focused on editing, and mention shooting as a good-to-have.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Video Editor with a strong creative eye and expert-level editing skills. Someone who can take raw footage and turn it into sharp, engaging, high-quality content across formats and platforms.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone with a strong sense of storytelling, pace, music, typography, visual design, and attention to detail. You should be equally comfortable editing a high-energy event film, leadership interview, podcast, keynote, brand film, or short-form social video.

You should be able to take complete ownership of an edit, from understanding the brief and working through raw footage to delivering a polished final output.

Key Responsibilities

Expert Video Editing

  • Edit raw footage into polished, high-quality long-form and short-form videos.

  • Work across brand films, leadership videos, interviews, podcasts, events, keynotes, employer brand content, social content, and internal communications.

  • Bring a strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, transitions, music, sound design, typography, and visual flow.

  • Take complete ownership of edits from the first cut to final delivery.

  • Work with different types and volumes of raw footage and independently identify the strongest narrative.

Short-form & Social Content

  • Turn long-form content into engaging clips for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and other platforms.

  • Identify strong moments, hooks, and soundbites from raw footage.

  • Understand current content and editing trends and bring fresh ideas into the work.

  • Create captions, supers, graphics, transitions, and other elements required for social-first content.

Motion Graphics & Design

  • Create motion graphics, animated typography, titles, lower thirds, intros, outros, and transitions.

  • Work confidently with After Effects for animation and motion design.

  • Handle basic thumbnail and supporting visual design when required.

Event & Fast-Turnaround Content

  • Edit event content including highlights, speaker clips, attendee bytes, session videos, and aftermovies.

  • Be comfortable working on quick turnaround timelines, including content that may need to go live on the same day.

  • Manage multiple edits simultaneously while maintaining quality and consistency.

Content & Asset Management

  • Organise raw footage, project files, exports, versions, and archives.

  • Maintain proper backups and ensure files can be easily accessed by the wider team.

  • Source appropriate stock footage, music, sound effects, and other creative assets when required.

What We’re Looking For

  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects.

  • Good working knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator.

  • Strong understanding of colour correction and grading, audio mixing, sound design, codecs, formats, and export settings.

  • Excellent sense of storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and music.

  • Strong understanding of both long-form storytelling and fast-paced social-first editing.

  • Ability to independently take an edit from raw footage to final delivery.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work within brand guidelines.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and tight timelines.

  • Up to date with new video formats, editing techniques, social trends, AI-enabled editing tools, and creative workflows.

  • Comfortable receiving feedback and quickly translating it into the edit.

Good to Have

  • Experience shooting interviews, events, podcasts, leadership content, or social content.

  • Understanding of cameras, lighting, framing, audio, microphones, and basic production setups.

  • Experience working on event shoots or fast-paced on-ground content.

  • Experience working with brands, agencies, production houses, media companies, or creative teams.

Portfolio Requirement

A strong video editing portfolio or showreel is mandatory.

We would especially like to see work across brand films, event films or aftermovies, leadership/interview content, short-form social videos, motion graphics, and long-form content.

More than just technical proficiency, we are looking for someone whose work demonstrates strong creative judgement, storytelling ability, and a high bar for craft and finish.

This keeps the message very clear: we are hiring an expert editor first. If they can shoot too, that’s an advantage, but it isn’t what defines the role.

About the Team 

The InMobi Business Development/CSM team is the secret sauce in transforming publisher partnerships into revenue powerhouses. This team is the cornerstone of the broader InMobi SSP (Supply Side Platform) function that creates partnerships with global and regional publishers. The Business Development team is essentially customer-facing, working with game developers, media owners, social networks, and other publishers operating on mobile platforms. In a rapidly growing market, the Business Development team combines exceptional strategic sales and negotiation skills, with a deep understanding of industry trends, market analysis, competitor insights and a passion for uncovering new opportunities and converting these into revenue. 

About the Role            

InMobi is seeking for a dynamic and results-oriented Senior Business Development Manager to join our team in Vietnam. As a Senior BD Manager, your key focus will be on building and expanding our partnerships within the gaming industry. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of the mobile gaming landscape in VIetnam, excellent relationship-building skills, and a proven track record of driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing partnerships with game developers, publishers, and other key players in the Vietnamese gaming market.

You will also spend considerable time interacting with internal product, sales, and marketing stakeholders to explore new avenues of supply and revenue growth, thereby effectively creating an action plan that syncs perfectly with our broader business objectives.

In this role, you will report to the Head of Gaming Partnerships—Asia Pacific (APAC), who is based at our headquarters in Bangalore, India.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • New publisher onboarding: Identify and onboard key gaming partners in Vietnam that align with InMobi's strategic objectives. Develop and deepen existing publisher partnerships through innovative solutions beyond yield optimization
  • Competitive intelligence: Analyze market trends and customer performance to generate industry insights and identify growth opportunities
  • Structure joint business plans for key accounts, focusing on transforming growth curves through a deep understanding of client objectives and challenges
  • Relationship Building: Cultivate and maintain C-level relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for partners.
  • Be the customer champion to the internal teams driving for outcomes on behalf of the customer.
  • Prepare and deliver transformational pitches and presentations to drive business growth.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to identify next big bets and innovative solutions for the gaming industry.
  • Develop case studies of successful campaigns and participate in industry events to showcase InMobi's expertise.
  • Provide regular reports on business performance, market trends, and competitive landscape.
  • Procure any required collateral from customer teams for any ad-sales pitches (case studies, media-kits, demographic split of users, daily active user count etc.

What we require of you

  • Experience: 5-8 years of experience in the mobile gaming industry, mobile advertising, or digital marketing. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical. MBA is preferred but not necessary
  • Language: Fluency in both English and Vietnamese to effectively communicate with local and international stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of the Vietnamese mobile gaming market and its unique characteristics.
  • Comfortable handling & anchoring high level conversations regarding internal InMobi products & supply-side metrics
  • Experience in growing and maintaining complex, high-value managed accounts through a consultative approach.
  • In-depth knowledge of mobile gaming advertising products across various formats (e.g., in-app, video, display).
  • Outstanding in teamwork with strong organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and decision-making in the absence of perfect information
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and presentation skills.

This role offers a rare and exciting opportunity to shape the emerging gaming market in Vietnam. The individual will not only play a pivotal role in establishing partnerships and driving growth but also contribute to building a team by selecting key collaborators. All of this is backed by the stability and confidence of joining a globally recognized company with a proven platform and successful business model.

Location: Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi

Overview of the role:

As a Senior Client Growth Manager - Performance, you will join our rapidly expanding Performance team in the Americas region — a group at the forefront of innovation within the mobile in-app advertising ecosystem. In a fast-moving and ever-evolving landscape, this team delivers differentiated, high-impact performance solutions powered by market-leading SKAN capabilities, one of the world's largest in-app mobile exchanges, and uniquely advantaged inventory through global telco and OEM partnerships.

At InMobi, our culture is our true north. It empowers us to think boldly, solve complex challenges, and unlock meaningful growth opportunities for our clients and our business. InMobians are passionate, driven, creative, and ownership-minded — and we are deeply results-focused. Your work in this role will be highly visible, with direct impact across the organization. You'll collaborate with an ambitious, high-caliber peer group that is invested in your success, while benefiting from a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development through both internal and external resources.

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping client growth strategy within one of the most dynamic and strategically important areas of digital advertising.

The impact you'll make:

  • Own and deepen client relationships with the goal of becoming a top strategic partner, driving maximum campaign ROI by understanding advertiser objectives, KPIs, and operational nuances (technical integrations, creative strategy, supply dynamics, delivery optimizations).
  • Lead in-depth campaign analysis and performance reviews; provide consultative, data-driven guidance in weekly and bi-weekly discussions, and confidently drive Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Track account-level revenue and delivery priorities on a weekly basis, contributing insights to CXO-level reporting and strategic planning conversations.
  • Drive quarterly account retention, revenue, and margin targets, while identifying opportunities for upsell and cross-sell to expand the overall book of business. Partner closely with Sales on strategic account planning and execution.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (traders, ad operations, and cross-functional partners) to optimize day-to-day campaign performance and implement high-impact strategic improvements.
  • Work alongside Sales Engineering to coordinate with third-party partners such as MMPs, viewability providers, data platforms (DMPs), and attribution solutions.
  • Serve as an in-market product expert, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to provide feedback, drive adoption, and elevate AM-region execution standards.

The experience we need:

  • 4-6 years of professional experience, including 2–3+ years within the programmatic, demand-side advertising space — ideally in performance or growth marketing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles with a track record of delivering measurable business outcomes. Experience working with DSPs and/or MMPs is strongly preferred.
  • Strategic mindset with a strong focus on revenue growth and retention; demonstrated success in driving account expansion and long-term client partnerships is highly valued.
  • Proficiency with standard business tools, including Salesforce, Microsoft Office Suite, and reporting/visualization platforms such as Power BI and Tableau.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients and campaigns simultaneously with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and disciplined time management.
  • Comfort collaborating with global teams across time zones and planning work accordingly.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required; background in advertising, marketing, business, or STEM fields is a plus.

What we build…

At InMobi, we’re building products that are redefining industries. Our ecosystem spans: 

  • InMobi Advertising – Powering data-driven mobile marketing for the world’s leading brands
  • Glance – A revolutionary Gen AI-powered lockscreen & TV content platform transforming how millions discover and engage with content.
  • 1Weather – One of the world’s leading weather platforms, delivering precise, reliable, and real-time weather forecasts

With deep expertise in AI, mobile, consumer technology, and digital innovation, we are home to some of the brightest minds in the industry. 

What sets us apart?

Not just what we build. How we build it. At InMobi, we balance our hunger for cutting-edge tech with a deep focus on our people - their growth, well-being, and potential.

At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location. 

The base salary (fixed) pay for this role ranges from $105,750 to $130,250 USD (min to max of base salary pay range). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location and region of the role in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of a stock grant known as ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan). To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we believe that our employees should have the ability to own a part of the organization. Furthermore, as you contribute to the growth of the company, additional stock may be issued in recognition of your contribution over time.

A quick snapshot of our benefits:

  • Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)        
  • High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)       
  • 401(k) company match 
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays

InMobi is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses, including independently operated consumer platform Glance, InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. The InMobi Group is the umbrella under which this ecosystem of businesses comes together. It spans:

  • Consumer brands: Glance, an intelligent shopping agent, and 1Weather, a hyperlocal weather application.
  • Enterprise platforms: InMobi Advertising, which provides media buyers and owners with the tools, data, and expertise to grow their business on mobile and beyond.

Each business serves its own audiences and has its own identity. At group level, InMobi is the common thread: the company, the technology, and the point of view behind them. This role helps shape how that group is presented and understood.

What is the role about?

The Senior Manager, Corporate Marketing is a group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. “Group level” means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. The incumbent is responsible for turning the group narrative into the flagship events and content through which the group is seen and heard.

The role is primarily B2B in focus. The incumbent’s purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders.

The incumbent will be the senior operator in the Corporate Marketing team: a leader who plans, builds, and delivers. The role works closely with the entire Corporate Marketing team and with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and across teams around the world, including leadership, engineering, product, design, talent, finance, and regional marketing functions. The incumbent owns the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the flagship events that carry the group narrative and the content and creative that bring it to life.

 

 

 

Target Audiences

  • Talent: experienced professionals, engineers, and early-career candidates considering InMobi.
  • Investors and the financial community: stakeholders who assess InMobi’s strategy, leadership, and long-term potential.
  • Technology community: engineers, data scientists, and product leaders who follow the work of leading technology teams.
  • Industry thought leaders: analysts, journalists, and influential voices who shape perception of the category.

What will you be doing ?

Group Narrative and Messaging

  • Translate the group narrative into clear messaging, proof points, and content frameworks that every corporate programme draws on.
  • Ensure that events and content speak in one consistent group voice, across businesses and regions.
  • Partner with the wider Corporate Marketing team, including social media and community, so that what is said on stage, in print, and in the room is carried through consistently across channels.

Corporate Events and Flagship Platforms

  • Own the strategy, planning, and delivery of large-scale corporate events, including flagship group events, leadership forums, industry summits, and employee-facing moments.
  • Ensure each event brings the businesses together on one stage and gives audiences a single, coherent view of the group.
  • Manage event agencies, vendors, and budgets, and coordinate delivery across time zones and markets.
  • Extend the life of every event through content, social amplification, and follow-up with the audiences it was designed for.

Content and Creative

  • Set the editorial direction for corporate content, including long-form articles, leadership perspectives, thought-leadership pieces, case studies, and video.
  • Direct the writers, designers, and video producers who create corporate content, and maintain quality standards across everything published under the group name.
  • Develop reusable content assets, such as the corporate story and event collateral, that regional and business teams can adopt.

Global Collaboration

  • Work with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams and with regional, talent, finance, and engineering teams across the world to maintain a consistent group presence while reflecting local relevance.
  • Act as the point of coordination for corporate marketing programmes across stakeholders, setting clear timelines, owners, and approvals.

Team and Partner Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of marketers, content creators, designers, and producers.
  • Set priorities, workflows, and quality standards for the programmes the team delivers.
  • Manage agency and external partnerships across events, content, creative, and production.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define KPIs across event reach and outcomes, content performance, and brand sentiment.
  • Use analytics and audience feedback to refine programmes and report to senior leadership.

What is expected out of you?

  • 10–12 years of experience in corporate marketing, communications, content, or brand, within technology, media, or high-growth environments, including at least 3 years leading people or large programmes.
  • Strong B2B experience, preferably in technology, SaaS, adtech, or martech, with a record of building influence among professional and technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and delivering large-scale corporate events or flagship platforms, from concept to outcome.
  • Excellent writing and editorial skills, with a clear, intelligent, and credible voice.
  • Experience in video and visual storytelling, and in directing creative and content teams.
  • Experience working with stakeholders across regions and time zones, including senior leadership.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, and budgets.
  • Strategic thinking combined with strong execution.
  • Curiosity, courage, initiative, and accountability: the ability to act without waiting for perfect conditions and to learn quickly when an attempt does not succeed.

 

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
