Overview of the Role:

Every strong quarter starts with a plan people believe in. In this role, you'll build that plan for InMobi's North America Demand business.

Reporting to the Director – Global Revenue Operations, you'll provide revenue operations support across our programmatic and performance solutions sales teams, as well as our growth management and development teams. You'll own forecasting, territory and quota design, and named account list management for each of them, shaping both how we read the business and how every team goes after it.

Sales leadership will count on you as their analytical and operational partner. You'll give them an accurate, current read on where the business stands, and goals and territories their teams can act on with confidence. When the numbers move, you'll be the one who can explain why and recommend what comes next.

This role is a great fit for someone analytical and organized who is comfortable partnering directly with sales leadership, up to the C-suite. If you enjoy being the person leaders turn to for clarity, you'll find meaningful scope, visibility, and impact here.

Location: This role is based in our New York, NY, office and requires regular in-office presence. Occasional travel may be required for client meetings, industry events, etc.

The Impact You'll Make:

Forecast, Plan & Measure

  • Own the recurring forecasting cadence for North America Agency & In-House sales, as well as Performance Solutions sales and account management across North America. This includes weekly and monthly forecasts, quarterly business plans, and the variance analysis needed to reconcile plan against actuals.
  • Build and maintain forecast models across key revenue metrics for each business, surfacing risk and opportunity early enough for leadership to respond.
  • Support the quarterly planning cycle end to end for each business: closing the prior quarter, finalizing the next quarter's forecast, and delivering targets ahead of the quarter start.

Goal Setting & Territory Support

  • Lead territory, quota, and target setting for North America Agency Sales, Account Management, Client Development, Agency Development, and Performance Solutions teams, grounded in account potential, market maturity, and team capacity.
  • Ensure quarterly quotas are set and delivered ahead of the quarter start, and that performance against quota is measured, transparent to every individual, and delivered ahead of payroll deadlines.
  • Own the development and maintenance of named account lists for each team, using account potential, historical performance, and market data to determine coverage, ownership, and prioritization, and refresh assignments on a regular cadence.
  • Partner with Finance and sales leadership to translate annual and quarterly plans into clear goals for each team and region.

Deep Knowledge of the Business

  • Maintain a current, working understanding of the North America Agency, Brand, and Performance business, including key strategic priorities, revenue composition, and areas of risk and opportunity.
  • Turn that knowledge into proactive recommendations when performance moves away from plan.
  • Own core sales operations processes across these teams, including pipeline governance and reporting standards, applying the same definitions and data integrity checks used across the broader Revenue Operations organization.

Partnership with Sales Leadership

  • Serve as the primary revenue operations partner to North America leadership.
  • Apply one consistent operating standard across every team you support (one planning cadence, one goal-setting process, one source of truth) while staying attuned to the dynamics specific to each business.
  • Represent these businesses in cross-functional forums with Finance, Product, and the broader Revenue Operations organization.

Individual Operating Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to your own workflows to increase efficiency, freeing up more of your time for analysis and partnership rather than manual reporting.

The Experience We Need:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, Business Operations, or a related field
  • Experience leading end-to-end revenue planning and forecasting for a sales organization
  • Hands-on experience with territory design and named account list development
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), BI tools (Excel, Tableau, Rill), and financial or forecast modeling
  • Proven stakeholder management experience, including direct communication with senior sales leaders across more than one region
  • Analytical rigor, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Background in the digital advertising or programmatic advertising industry
  • An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus, but not required

Skills & Attributes That Will Set You Apart

  • Business acumen: You can explain why a number moved based on a real understanding of the underlying business.
  • Rigor: You produce forecasts and goals that are backed by data and delivered on schedule.
  • Communication: You raise concerns and flag gaps to senior stakeholders directly, with data to support your position.
  • Cross-regional depth: You build a working knowledge of the North America and EMEA markets, specific enough to defend the goals and territories set for each.
  • Process discipline: You write SOPs and follow them consistently.
  • Applied use of AI: You identify where automation and AI can increase your efficiency and apply them to your own workflow.

Why InMobi?

You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results. 

At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks 

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

The base (fixed) salary for this role ranges from $169,000 to $234,000 USD (min to max of base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. 

*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of Employee Stock Options (ESOPs). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.

A quick snapshot of our U.S. benefits:

  • Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)        
  • High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)       
  • 401(k) company match 
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays   
  • Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and a compassionate work environment 
  • Flexible working hours to suit everyone 
  • Wellness stipend for a healthier you!      
  • Free lunch provided in our offices daily

Overview of the Role:

The programmatic demand flowing into InMobi Exchange (IX) runs through a global network of platform partners. In this role, you'll help leadership understand, plan for, and grow that demand.

Reporting to the Director, Global Revenue Operations, you'll provide sales operations support to InMobi's global Demand Platform relationships within IX: the business partnerships and integrations with third-party Demand Side Platforms (DSPs) and reseller partners that bring programmatic demand into the InMobi platform. You'll own forecasting, partner planning, and partner account management for this demand.

Exchange leadership will rely on you as their analytical and operational partner. You'll give them an accurate, current read on DSP and reseller performance, along with goals and partner plans they can act on with confidence. When performance shifts, you'll be the one who can explain why and recommend what comes next.

This role is a great fit for someone analytical and organized who is comfortable operating across a global set of platform partners. If you enjoy turning partner data into clear direction for leadership, you'll find meaningful scope, visibility, and impact here.

Location: This role is based in our New York, NY, office and requires regular in-office presence. Occasional travel may be required for client meetings, industry events, etc.

The Impact You'll Make:

Forecast, Plan & Measure

  • Own the recurring forecasting cadence for demand routed into the InMobi platform through DSPs and reseller partners. This includes weekly and monthly forecasts, quarterly business plans, and the variance analysis needed to reconcile plan against actuals.
  • Build and maintain forecast models across key demand-platform metrics, including active DSPs, bid rate, and win rate, surfacing risk and opportunity early enough for leadership to respond.
  • Support the quarterly planning cycle end to end: closing the prior quarter, finalizing the next quarter's forecast, and delivering targets ahead of the quarter start.

Goal Setting & Partner Planning

  • Lead partner planning and target setting across the global DSP and reseller portfolio, grounded in partner potential, integration maturity, and platform capacity.
  • Own the development and maintenance of the named partner list, using partner potential, historical performance, and platform data to determine coverage, ownership, and prioritization, and refresh the list on a regular cadence.
  • Partner with Finance and Demand Platform leadership to translate annual and quarterly plans into clear goals for the DSP and reseller portfolio.

Deep Knowledge of the Demand Platform Business

  • Maintain a current, working understanding of the global demand platform business, including its key strategic priorities, revenue composition across DSP and reseller partners, and areas of risk and opportunity.
  • Turn that knowledge into proactive recommendations when performance moves away from plan.
  • Own core sales operations processes for the Exchange business, including pipeline governance and reporting standards, applying the same definitions and data integrity checks across all partners.

Partnership with Demand Platform Leadership

  • Serve as the primary sales operations partner to Exchange & Demand Platform Management (DPM) leadership.
  • Apply one consistent operating standard across the global DSP and reseller portfolio (one planning cadence, one goal-setting process, one source of truth) while staying attuned to the dynamics specific to each partner.
  • Represent the demand platform business in cross-functional forums with Finance, Product, and the broader Revenue Operations organization.

Individual Operating Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to your own workflows to increase efficiency, freeing up more of your time for analysis and partnership rather than manual reporting.

The Experience We Need:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, Business Operations, or a related field
  • Experience leading end-to-end revenue planning and forecasting for a global platform or partnerships business
  • Hands-on experience with partner planning and named partner list development for a global platform business
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), BI tools (Excel, Tableau, Rill), and financial or forecast modeling
  • Proven stakeholder management experience, including direct communication with senior platform-partnership leaders
  • Analytical rigor, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Background in the digital advertising or programmatic advertising industry
  • An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus, but not required

Skills & Attributes That Will Set You Apart

  • Business acumen: You can explain why a number moved based on a real understanding of the underlying business.
  • Rigor: You produce forecasts and goals that are backed by data and delivered on schedule.
  • Communication: You raise concerns and flag gaps to senior stakeholders directly, with data to support your position.
  • Global perspective: You apply the same standards across DSP and reseller partners while accounting for the differences between them.
  • Process discipline: You write SOPs and follow them consistently.
  • Applied use of AI: You identify where automation and AI can increase your efficiency and apply them to your own workflow.

You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results.

  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility

You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

title: Senior Sales Manager - Johannesburg, South Africa
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Role Overview

Microsoft and InMobi have entered into a strategic partnership. As per this, InMobi Advertising will be the exclusive partner for Microsoft Advertising's search & display inventory. Microsoft Search Advertising empowers the largest advertisers around the world to reach their maximum potential through paid search engine marketing on the Microsoft Bing Ads platform. InMobi will be responsible for complete business management/transaction across Microsoft Advertising. 

As a Regional Lead in South Africa you are expected to drive new client acquisition and grow incremental revenue against a targeted list of high potential agencies and advertisers through continuous engagement. You are expected to continually build and maintain a pipeline of clients and agencies to be onboarded to the Microsoft Advertising platform. Collaborate with internal Account Managers and Strategy teams to develop quality customer plans targeted at revenue growth and customer satisfaction. Cultivating strategic client relationships, revenue generation and delivering customized search solutions will be key to your core function. Your success will be measured by specific key performance indicators focused on driving new customer acquisition, product adoption, emphasizing customer experience and optimizing opportunities.  

What is expected out of you?

In the first quarter:

  • Understand the Microsoft Advertising Ecosystem in South Africa and collaborate with internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage your current relationships in the advertising ecosystem to drive revenue conversations as well as open up new relationships in the industry
  • You will be expected to build a healthy predictable pipeline of clients to initiate and successfully close partnership and onboarding discussions.
  • Consistently create high value revenue-generating opportunities that will work towards delivering quota expectations.
  • Lead regular, impactful engagements with key clients.
  • Coordinate with the required teams to help achieve targets.

Second Quarter Onwards:

  • Master and grow the activities initiated in the first quarter
  • Grow Bing’s share of wallet by continuing to onboard new clients and agencies
  • Strengthen relationships with key client and agency stakeholders like (budget decision makers, media planners and senior leadership)
  • Collaborate with internal account managers and client poc's to ensure opportunities are leveraged effectively
  • Continually strengthen your Search Industry expertise, take personal accountability for your career and personal development;
  • Complete required and recommended trainings and apply what you learn to further your growth in role and career progression

Role requirement & expectation: 

  • 12 years of work experience with 5+ years of online media sales/digital advertising experience
  • Strong network of clientele in the South African marketplace, specifically Johannesburg and an understanding of the key digital players (Brands, agencies etc.)
  • Experience and ability to build a client base from scratch.
  • Experience in lead generation, networking, and ad-agency relationship management.
  • Experienced Digital media solution seller and talented in storytelling and delivering engaging presentations across all levels of leadership
  • Ability to handle and manage key/strategic client relationships and revenue
  • Ensure a strong metrics focused approach is applied in business planning and execution
  • Proven ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions
  • Proven track record of exceptional performance, high productivity, communications skills, and meeting deadlines. Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals or targets
  • Passion for technology as an enabler for company growth
  • Effectively navigate through ambiguity and complexities related to client management
  • Practice freedom with responsibility, entrepreneurial mindset and thought leadership.
  • Possess excellent communication skills providing transparency and enabling information radiators
  • Travel to meet and strengthen partnerships with new and existing clients.

Preferred:

  • Search Engine Marketing Experience
  • Understanding of the Digital Ecosystem
  • Ad Sales Experience

Location:

Johannesburg

title: Senior Sales Manager – US West, Independents & Client Direct
location: San Mateo, CA or Los Angeles, CA
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Overview of the Role:

InMobi is seeking a driven, relationship-first Senior Sales Manager to quarterback a defined book of business across the US West region (covers the West Coast, Pacific Northwest, Mountain, and Texas) focused on Independent Agencies and Advertiser In-house teams. Embedded within a revenue pod alongside a dedicated Account Manager, and reporting to the VP, Ad Sales - North America, you will be the face of InMobi to every agency in your book — building trust, opening doors, and closing revenue across both Programmatic Marketplace (PMP) deals and Direct IOs. 

This is a hunting and farming role in equal measure: you'll be expected to arrive with established relationships across the agencies and direct advertisers that you're hired to cover, and to put those relationships to work immediately — growing existing accounts while consistently generating net-new business from new customers. You will be responsible for identifying new hunting opportunities from net new customers in your territory, thus constantly expanding your target account list.

Together with your paired Account Manager, you'll co-own your pod's long-term account strategy, one relationship, one pipeline, one shared goal of sustained growth. 

Location: We welcome applicants based in either San Mateo, CA (SF/Bay Area) or Los Angeles, CA for this role

The Impact You'll Make:

  • Quarterback your book of business end-to-end — owning the agency and advertiser in-house relationship, the pipeline, and the revenue outcome across every account in your patch in the West region 
  • Serve as the face of InMobi to independent agencies and advertiser in-house teams in the West region: build genuine relationships through consistent presence, entertainment, and strategic engagement that goes beyond the transaction  
  • Maintain accurate, current industry intelligence to identify book expansion opportunities
  • Drive net-new business as a core focus, primarily by hunting new agencies as well as in-house clients
  • Build, advise, and grow relationships with media account teams at agencies to ensure long-term success and adoption of InMobi's suite of products (including Glance CTV, Glance mobile, InMobi Exchange solutions). Maximize face time with clients, which will involve travel to the agency territory offices.
  • Bring a strategic point of view to every account: build territory and account plans that identify where InMobi can win, and pursue them proactively rather than reactively  
  • Lead responses to advertiser/agency RFPs, ensuring clear, consistent, and comprehensive representation of InMobi's solutions and capabilities to develop custom, differentiated proposals that win competitive RFPs
  • Partner closely with your Account Manager to co-own long-term account strategy — bringing the relationship and pipeline view, while trusting your AM's data-driven recommendations on where existing accounts have room to grow
  • Represent InMobi at industry events, upfronts, and client entertainment, strengthening InMobi's presence and reputation across the agency community
  • Maintain accurate, disciplined forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce, reflecting realistic net-new and renewal mix against the SIP plan, and keeping account intelligence (org changes, competitive risk, budget cycles) current for the POD

 How You're Measured:

This role is goaled on two connected outcomes, per the SIP planning framework: 

  • Pod revenue growth — shared accountability with your Account Manager for the overall retention, renewal, and revenue performance of the accounts in your book, tracked through year-over-year (YoY) growth across both deal-based revenue and Managed Service IOs
  • Net-new business contribution — Ability to generate net new business from new agencies and in-house teams 

The Experience We Need:

  • 8+ years of advertising sales experience, with a track record of selling into independent agencies and in-house teams across programmatic and/or managed service advertising.
  • Established, verifiable relationships with independent agencies and/or client in-house teams in the US West region, validated through the interview process.
  • A demonstrated history of exceeding revenue targets, with meaningful contributions from net-new business (new logos or new campaigns), not renewals alone.
  • Strong command of both PMP/programmatic deal structures and Managed Service IO selling, with the versatility to move fluidly between the two.
  • Natural relationship-building instincts: someone who genuinely enjoys client entertainment, agency events, and being a visible, trusted presence in the market.
  • A consultative, strategic sales style — comfortable building account plans, developing custom solutions with internal partners, and leading complex RFP processes.
  • Strong collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with Account Management, Client Solutions, Sales Planning, Marketing, and Product teams.
  • Comfort with disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in Salesforce.
  • A bias for action in fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environments, with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 

Why InMobi?

You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results. 

At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks 

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

Position Summary:

We are looking for a Staff Applied Science Manager to lead and grow a team of talented data scientists who have direct impact on our company metrics. The performance of our models and experiments is seen astonishingly quickly – the learning loop is not measured in weeks or days, but hours and minutes. We live in what might be the fastest model-learning playgrounds in the world, with an infrastructure that enables model deployment at both scale and speed.

In this role, you will combine deep technical credibility with strong people leadership. You will build and mentor a high-performing team of data scientists, set technical direction, and drive disciplined program execution across multiple concurrent workstreams. You will sit alongside engineering colleagues who enable our models to deploy, and with a growing variable set of hundreds of potential features, you will lead a highly fertile environment for building, experimenting, refining and achieving real, fast impact.

Who Are You?

  • You bring deep expertise and experience in Ad Tech, AI/ML, and Data Science at scale, along with a track record of leading and developing data science talent. Familiarity with big data processing and cloud computing is critical to succeed in this environment.
  • In addition to a strong mathematical foundation (Statistics, Probability Theory, Algorithms, Foundations of Machine Learning), you are fluent in data science languages and tools such as Python or Apache Spark, and can guide your team in designing scalable solutions, building proofs-of-concept, and evaluating them offline and online.
  • You have a demonstrated ability to manage people – hiring, coaching, and growing data scientists at different stages of their careers – as well as manage programs: planning roadmaps, sequencing priorities, managing dependencies, and ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery across a portfolio of initiatives.
  • You are passionate about investigating and learning from data, and about creating an environment where your team is driven to ask interesting and provocative questions and put real models into production that drive real business value.
  • You are comfortable balancing hands-on technical involvement with the responsibilities of people management and cross-functional program leadership.
  • We are open to diverse academic backgrounds. Our team includes engineers, mathematicians, computer scientists, physicists, economists and social scientists – a rock-star applied science leader can come from any academic field.

What Will You Do?

  • Lead and grow a team of data scientists working on one or more data science efforts for InMobi DSP, a gold mine that is being explored for riches. This spans project ideation and conceptualization, solution design, measurement and iteration, coaching, deployment, and post-deployment management.
  • Own program execution across your team's portfolio: define roadmaps, sequence priorities, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure initiatives are delivered on time and with high quality.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop data scientists – setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a strong bench of technical talent.
  • Remain hands-on where it matters: guide the design, development, and testing of product experiments, and stay close enough to the data and models to unblock your team and make sound technical calls.
  • Drive stakeholder management as the interface with internal stakeholders such as Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and Business teams, translating business needs into technical roadmaps and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly.
  • Champion thought leadership for the team. We encourage and support team members to write blogs, commentary, and case studies published on the InMobi blog, and to speak at industry conferences representing InMobi's work.
  • Help your team connect model design to business context and end-user needs, and ensure model impact is consistently tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Foster a multi-functional collaboration model, working closely with engineering, product, business, campaign management, and creative development teams, and helping your team draw on the strengths of this diverse group.
  • Create the space for your team to experiment with multiple algorithms and learn from what works and what doesn't – reviewing performance, asking why, and adapting techniques to fit the problem at hand, in an environment built for speed.
  • Encourage creativity in model design across your team. Model design is not one-size-fits-all; you will guide your team in building layered models and feedback mechanisms for tougher problems in a dynamic environment.
  • Represent your team's contributions in the company's broader efforts to innovate and demonstrate thought leadership through products, research papers, and conferences.

Required Skills:

  • Master's in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research or Economics, Analytics, or Data Science. Or a Bachelor's from a reputed college with additional relevant experience.
  • 10-14 years of work experience in a quantitative field, including model building and validation experience, with at least 2-3 years in a people management or team leadership capacity (direct reports, mentoring, or technical team leadership).
  • Proven experience managing programs or portfolios of data science initiatives – setting roadmaps, prioritizing across competing demands, tracking milestones, and driving delivery in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ad tech related industry experience is a strong plus. You would have applied algorithms and techniques from Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Statistics or other domains to solve real-world problems and understand the practical issues of using these algorithms on large datasets.
  • Comfortable with software programming and statistical platforms such as R, Python etc., including visualization tools.
  • Comfortable with the big data ecosystem and Apache Spark. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud/Vertex AI is a bonus.
  • Strong track record of hiring, coaching, and retaining data science talent, and of fostering a culture of curiosity, rigor, and accountability within a team.
  • Familiarity with the challenges of the identity-less world, particularly for iOS and Android.
  • Excellent technical and business communication skills, with the ability to present technical ideas simply to business counterparts and to represent your team's work to senior stakeholders.
  • High degree of curiosity, sound judgment in prioritization, and the ability to rapidly learn new areas.

What is the team like?

The GTM (Go-To-Market) Engineering team at InMobi builds and scales the systems that power revenue operations and customer engagement. The team owns a comprehensive Salesforce ecosystem—including Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce—along with Experience Cloud (Customer Community), enabling seamless workflows for Sales, Account Management, and Business teams. A key focus area is building intelligent agents and automations using Agentforce, integrated across Salesforce, Slack, and community platforms. These agents drive productivity, automate workflows, and enable real-time, context-aware actions for internal teams and customer-facing use cases. The team also leverages Slack as a collaboration and execution layer, tightly integrated with Salesforce to trigger workflows, surface insights, and enable faster decision-making. On the backend, the team develops and maintains a scalable middleware platform using Apache Camel and Java, powering event-driven integrations and reliable data exchange across systems. The architecture blends CRM, data platforms, agent-based automation, and distributed systems—focusing on extensibility, real-time processing, and high impact business outcomes. This is a high-impact engineering team operating at the intersection of CRM, AI-driven agents, integrations, and modern enterprise platforms.

Skillset: Agentforce (Agent Development), Salesforce (Advanced), Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Experience Cloud, Data Cloud,  Slack, CI/CD (Copado/GitHub), Event-Driven Architecture, Integration Patterns (Apache Camel), Java, Automation & Workflow Design, Performance Optimization, Python

Role Overview

As an Architect/Staff Engineer I at InMobi, you will be a mentor, technical leader driving the design, development, and delivery of Agentic AI solutions on Salesforce platform. You will serve as the bridge between our CRM infrastructure and AI-driven product experiences - shaping how InMobi's go-to-market and revenue systems evolve and uplift in an era of autonomous workflows and intelligent automation. You'll work closely with product team, RevOps, Data and product engineering to build scalable, distributed, enterprise-grade solutions that power InMobi's growth.

What you'll do

Salesforce platform engineering

  • Design, build, and deploy scalable Salesforce-centric solutions supporting InMobi's revenue and growth operations - including Agentforce / AI-driven orchestration, prompt templating, Data Cloud integration, complex Apex, LWC, and integration layers.
  • Design high-scale integrations with enterprise-grade architectures leveraging Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), and REST/SOAP APIs to enable real-time data flows across the business.
  • Build features enabling seamless integration between Salesforce structured/unstructured data and downstream AI agents for faster insights and decision-making.
  • Deploy and monitor Salesforce-integrated products with an emphasis on agent observability, telemetry, and auditability.
  • Develop best-in-class data health monitoring and context enrichment pipelines to ensure CRM data used by agents is reliable, governed, and audit-ready.

Agentic AI & intelligent automation

  • Lead technical solutioning for full-lifecycle projects focused on how Salesforce will power autonomous workflows, co-pilots, and multi-agent systems - contributing to a "data-first, agent-aware" architecture strategy.
  • Partner with product management and business stakeholders to prioritize CRM data products that drive autonomous decision-making, context-rich recommendations, and discoverable data services for next-gen AI agents and LLM-based systems.

Distributed systems & backend

  • Architect and scale distributed systems that interact with Salesforce for real-time data synchronization, leveraging Kafka, Spark, or similar streaming technologies.
  • Write clean, testable, and high-performance backend middleware in Java that bridges CRM and cloud services at scale.

Engineering excellence

  • Champion DevOps best practices including Salesforce DX, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and automated testing frameworks.
  • Mentor engineering teams, set technical standards, and enforce code quality and best practices across squads.
  • Contribute to InMobi's platform reliability with a focus on fault tolerance, performance optimization, and scalability.

 

What you'll bring

Required qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise software development with a focus on scalable, fault-tolerant, CRM-integrated architectures.
  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience with Agentforce, Data Cloud, and cloud platforms (GCP or Azure) and their connectivity to Salesforce.
  • Deep expertise in Salesforce architecture: Apex, LWC, Salesforce Shield, CRM data modelling, and high-volume data processing patterns.
  • Proven experience with advanced Salesforce integrations including Platform Events, CDC, and complex REST/SOAP API integrations.
  • Experience writing optimized SOQL/SOSL and managing large datasets within Salesforce multi-tenant environments.
  • Experience writing clean, testable backend code in Java or Python for middleware services (Apache Camel, MuleSoft) bridging CRM and external cloud services.
  • Mastery of Salesforce DX, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Copado), and AI automated testing and deployment frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce data security including Data Mask, encryption, and governance in the context of agent auditability and compliance.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and how tools like Kafka or Spark interact with Salesforce for real-time data synchronization.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at ad-tech or high-scale B2B SaaS companies.
  • Track record of building and delivering Agentic AI solutions for enterprise systems - including sophisticated Salesforce UIs and high-performance backend services.
  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud, Order Management System (OMS), Revenue Cloud, or related platforms.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, agent observability tooling, or RAG pipeline design.

What is the InMobi family like?   

We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise to challenges, the innovative products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that.   

What can we promise?   

We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your ML and AI skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a reliable, scalable, secure, and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on innovative technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader.  

Modern work environment, flexible schedule, and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. What is the team like?  

At InMobi Enterprise team, we are transforming the way finance, sales, marketing, people, and legal functions operate. We’re driving transformative work across Sales, Marketing, People, and Finance with ML and Agentic AI—and we’re looking for passionate innovators to join us!

What you will be doing

We are looking for a Data Scientist who can operate at the intersection of classical machine learning, GenAI and modern agentic AI systems with a strong engineering appetite. You will build and deploy intelligent AI/ML systems that will help transform the business process across the core. This role blends deep ML craftsmanship with forward-looking innovation in autonomous/agentic systems.

 

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead the experimentation, design and build of agentic AI systems that autonomously observe model performance, trigger experiments, tune hyperparameters, improve ranking policies, or orchestrate ML workflows with minimal human intervention.
  • Apply LLMs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented architectures, and multimodal generative models for semantic understanding, content classification, and user preference modeling.
  • Design intelligent agents that can automate repetitive decision-making tasks—e.g., candidate generation tuning, feature selection, or context-aware content curation.
  • Support POCs/ Pilots projects to explore and validate innovative technologies and solutions in ML/AI space.
  • Build and operate machine learning models on diverse, high-volume data sources for forecasting, classification and prediction.
  • Develop rapid experimentation workflows to validate hypotheses and measure real-world business impact.
  • Design pipelines for data preparation, model training, evaluation, and deployment in collaboration with engineering counterparts.
  • Define best practices for monitoring ML model performance using statistical techniques; identifying drifts, failure modes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute to ML/AI thought leadership—blogs, case studies, internal tech talks, and industry conferences.
  • Thrive in a multi-functional, highly collaborative team environment with engineering, product, business, and creative teams.
  • Interface with stakeholders across Product, Business, Data, and Infrastructure to align ML initiatives with strategic priorities.
  • Document designs, development processes, and best practices to promote knowledge sharing and operational efficiency.

What do we expect from you?

We are seeking candidates with deep expertise in ML and hands-on experience building GenAI and Agentic AI systems.

Skillset: AI/ML Engineering, Python, LLM, RAG, Agentic AI, MCP, REST API

You should have experience with:

  • Design, build, and deploy building LLM-powered applications, chatbots, and multi-agent systems to improve efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making.
  • Implement and customize GenAI and multi-agent systems using AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar.
  • Create, refine, and maintain prompt templates, chains, and workflows.
  • Integrate vector databases (MilvusDB, FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, etc.) for semantic search and memory.
  • Classical ML and deep learning techniques across NLP, clustering, and time series.
  • Proficient in deploying ML workflows/models in production system. Continuous monitoring, evaluation, and retraining of models to ensure sustained performance. Ensuring model explainability, accuracy, compliance.
  • Big data processing (Spark, distributed data systems) and cloud computing.
  • Designing end-to-end ML solutions—from prototype to production.
  • Stay updated with emerging AI/ML technologies and recommend relevant innovations for the finance domain.
  • Drive in design reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
  • Collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders, including technical teams and business leaders.
  • Adapting to fast-paced environments and evolving priorities with high energy and autonomy.

We value curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a strong bias toward experimentation and production impact.

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Analytics, or related fields. PhD is a plus.
  • 8+ years of industry experience in ML/Data Science, with deep proficiency in Python and one or more frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn.
  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, regression, tree-based models, clustering, and time series.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, retrieval systems, generative models, or agentic/autonomous ML systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience building Agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, n8n or ReACT-style agents.
  • Expertise with algorithms in NLP, Time Series, and Deep Learning, applied on real-world datasets.
  • Strong experience with the big data ecosystem (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP/Vertex AI).
  • Experience with Model Context Protocols (MCPs) — building or integrating MCP tools, servers, or capabilities.

description:

Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Who are we and What do we do?

InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies.

What’s the InMobi family like?

Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results-focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.

What do we promise?

We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.

What will you be doing?

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Manager to build and lead the ML function for Accelerate. You will own the entire ML stack - from defining the roadmap to hiring the team to shipping models into production. This is not a role where you inherit an existing ML system; you will architect and build the foundational ML capabilities that become the platform's core competitive moat: cross-channel intelligence that autonomously optimizes marketing spend. 

You will report to the engineering leadership and work closely with product, data engineering, and the existing platform engineering team. 

What You'll Build 

Cross-Channel Budget Allocation Engine Build optimization models that allocate a brand's total marketing budget across channels to maximize aggregate ROAS. Account for channel-specific dynamics: auction mechanics, audience overlap, frequency caps, diminishing returns curves. Move from static allocation to continuous rebalancing based on real-time performance signals. 

Bid Optimization & Pacing Develop bid strategy models that work across platforms with different auction types. Build spend pacing algorithms that distribute budget optimally across time (dayparting, day-of-week, seasonality). Model the response curves (spend vs. conversions) per channel and campaign type. 

Multi-Touch Attribution Build cross-channel attribution models that go beyond last-click to understand the true incremental value of each channel and touchpoint. Design incrementality testing frameworks to validate attribution models and feed insights back into budget allocation and bid optimization. 

Performance Forecasting Predict campaign performance (impressions, clicks, conversions, ROAS) before and during campaign execution. Build anomaly detection to flag underperforming campaigns or unusual spend patterns in real-time. 

Audience Intelligence Build audience segmentation and lookalike modeling that works across channel boundaries. Identify high-value audience segments and optimize targeting recommendations based on historical cross-channel conversion data. 

Creative Performance Prediction Predict creative asset performance before launch, identify creative fatigue signals, and connect creative attributes (copy, visuals, CTA type) to performance outcomes. 

What We're Looking For 

  • 8+ years in ML/Data Science, with at least 1 year in a tech lead or management role building and shipping ML systems in production
  • Strong ML breadth with depth in at least one of: optimization algorithms, recommender systems, time-series forecasting, causal inference, reinforcement learning, or auction/marketplace ML
  • Hands-on technical leader: You can architect ML systems, review model code, and mentor engineers - not just manage roadmaps
  • Production ML experience: You've taken models from research to production, dealt with data quality issues, and understand the gap between offline metrics and business impact
  • Ads/MarTech domain experience is a strong plus: bid optimization, budget allocation, attribution, audience targeting, or media mix modeling at an ad platform, DSP, or marketing platform 

Why This Role 

  • Greenfield ML with real data: The platform already has production data flowing from major ad platforms. You're not waiting for data - you're building the intelligence layer on top of a live system
  • Clear business impact: Every model you build has a direct line to ROAS improvement for brands. The feedback loop between model and revenue is short
  • The problem is genuinely hard: Cross-channel marketing optimization is a multi-objective, partially-observable, adversarial optimization problem. The ad platforms themselves are black boxes. Building intelligence across them is an unsolved problem at the industry level
  • Full ownership: You define the ML strategy, hire the team, choose the tools, and ship the models. No inherited tech debt in the ML layer
  • Scale potential: InMobi is one of the largest independent ad-tech companies globally. Accelerate is a strategic bet with executive sponsorship

At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

title: AM/ Manager - Risk & Decision Science
description:
About the Team

Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit and built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys, Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of 10-100-1000 journey and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
As a Financial Services team, we always look at the bottom line. And the bottom line is - in this team, you should expect to have fun as you learn and grow.
 
About the Role
 
Lending is going to be our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale. Herein also lies potentially our biggest challenge for Meesho users: How do we assess risk of borrowers without any credit history? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
The Person will be responsible for driving the Policy, DS and analytics behind all these questions, from creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and owning policy decisions.
In the early phases, your role will focus on refining initially implemented policy by Analyzing and Designing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, alternate data. Creating Scorecards and models for approval. 
Designing experiments to test cohort behavior and experimental policies.
Automate reporting and tracking of the portfolio on multiple levels , Ops performance measures, key performance indicators and associated drivers.

title: AM/M - Risk Analytics - User Lending
description:
About the Team
Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here's your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit, built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys. Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of a 10-100-1000 journey, and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
About the Role
Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL). 
User Lending is now our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey. We have 274Mn ATU, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale - our being a captive audience means both Growth and Risk are an outcome of underwriting, which is owned by the Risk team.
Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
This person will be responsible for driving the analytics behind these questions for User Lending - creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and recommending policy decisions, across a well-established BNPL portfolio and a Personal Loans portfolio that is still scaling.
Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.

title: Data Scientist III (Team- Valmo)
description:
About us
Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers.
Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company.
Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/
About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.

title: Director – Sales, Meesho AI Services (MAS) | North India
description:
About MAS
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
About the Role
This role is for a sales leader who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about selling AI-led offerings, and can operate at the intersection of AI, services, and enterprise problem-solving. You'll own the NCR region end-to-end — not just the last mile.
This is not a role where you wait for a handed-off, qualified deal. Our internal team owns top-of-funnel prospecting, but you're expected to get your hands dirty across the first and middle mile too — opening doors yourself when a target account needs it, staying close to discovery and org-mapping on your region's marquee deals, and not just parachuting in for the close. You're the face of MAS in North India: building trust with CXOs and BU heads, running the room in high-stakes conversations, owning the commercial close, and building the regional team and playbook as you go.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for the same reason: sellers never get deep enough into an account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. Closing that gap — real discovery, real stakeholder mapping, real champions inside the account — is as much a part of this role as the close itself.

title: Engineering Manager -Backend
description:
About Meesho 
 
Mission and Vision 
 
Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, driven by the mission to democratize internet commerce for everyone (DICE). Our vision is to enable 100 million small businesses and entrepreneurs in India to succeed online, making online commerce accessible to all. This core purpose guides us in empowering sellers across the country and bringing a diverse range of products to first-time internet shoppers. By leveraging technology and a unique zero commission model, Meesho has opened the doors of e-commerce to millions who were previously underserved. 
 
Technological Scale & Innovation
 
 At Meesho, technology is at the heart of our success. We have invested in a scalable infrastructure and innovative solutions to meet the demands of a vast user base and complex marketplace. Some key highlights include: 
 
Massive Scale: Our backend systems handle millions of orders per day from across India, reaching about 5% of all Indian households, all with near-zero downtime to date. Achieving this level of reliability and performance in a hyper-growth environment is a testament to our engineering excellence. 
 
 Marketplace Reach: Over 1.75 million sellers are registered on Meesho’s platform, supported by our state-of-the-art tech infrastructure and pan-India logistics network. This wide reach — covering virtually every serviceable pin code in the country — presents unique engineering challenges in areas like search, personalization, and payments at scale.
 
 Scalable Architecture: We continually innovate our architecture for growth.. Our quest to serve a billion Indian users has helped us evolve our technologies from a monolith to microservices to now a high scale federated architecture. This evolution allows us to build and deploy features rapidly while maintaining stability for a fast-growing user base. 
 
Cutting-edge Tech Stack: Our platform is built using modern, open-source technologies on the cloud while ensuring high efficiency. We strategically choose proven tools (for example, Java and Golang for services, Kafka for messaging, Dragonfly and Redis for caching, ScyllaDB, MySQL and Mongo for Data) and leverage GCP infrastructure to ensure high performance, reliability, and flexibility. By focusing on the right tools for the right problems, we innovate pragmatically rather than chasing every new tech hype, which helps us solve real-world problems effectively. 
 
Engineering Culture & Challenges 
 
Engineering at Meesho is driven by a bold and inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe that building great products goes hand-in-hand with building a great team. Key aspects of our engineering culture include: 
 
Long Term Thinking: We believe in thinking for tomorrow while building for today, this approach has helped us not only to handle and evolve for scale but also focus on extensibility and stability by investing in the platform
 
Lightspeed: We prioritize rapid iteration and delivery. Engineers are encouraged to ship fast and refine continuously, as we value in order to learn and adapt quickly. 
 
Continuous Improvement: We view failures and bugs as opportunities to improve. A blameless post-mortem culture ensures that mistakes become lessons, fostering an environment where learning from failure drives resilience and innovation.
 
 Ownership Mindset: Every engineer is empowered to act like an owner. We instill a “Founder’s Mindset,” encouraging engineers to take end-to-end ownership of projects and drive them with an entrepreneurial spirit. This means our teams proactively identify problems and champion solutions, just as a founder would for their own product. 
 
Engineering at Meesho is more than just writing code – it's about solving complex, impactful problems at an unprecedented scale. Our engineers tackle challenging use cases (from enabling real-time logistics across India to optimizing a vast product catalog for the next billion users), making a tangible impact on millions of entrepreneurs and customers. We maintain a
professional, yet passionate work environment where the drive to innovate is balanced with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. 
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for Engineering Manager well-versed with emerging technologies to join our team.
 As an Engineering Manager, you will ensure consistency and quality by shaping the right strategies. You will keep an eye on all engineering projects and ensure all duties are fulfilled . You will analyse other employees’ tasks and carry on collaborations effectively. You will also transform newbies into experts and build reports on the progress of all projects.

title: Manager – GTM & Sales Strategy, Meesho AI Services (MAS)
description:
About the Team
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
About the Role
This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.
You own the middle mile of the deal: the stretch between a qualified conversation and a close-ready opportunity. That means deep client discovery, mapping who really decides, understanding how a client's teams actually work today, and making sure the deal never goes cold on your watch — following up, keeping momentum, and setting up the closer to walk into the room fully briefed. Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.

description:

You will optimize our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by designing secure-by-default guardrails for both human developers and AI coding agents. Your mission is to ensure near-zero vulnerabilities from application and data security failures reach production. A significant portion of your focus will involve advanced Red Teaming, utilizing LLMs to improve Meesho's security posture, and architecting defenses for our autonomous AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, and jailbreaking attacks.

description:

As we scale, the complexity of our network increases exponentially. ValMo operates at the intersection of technology, operations, and partner ecosystems — where execution precision and systems thinking are critical to prevent cascading (domino) failures across the network.
About the Role
The Control Tower is where the stability, reliability, and cost-efficiency of ValMo's pan-India network is owned end-to-end. This is a deliberately generalist role in Fulfilment & Experience - your mandate is defined by an outcome, not a fixed function.
Put simply: you are the person we point at the highest-leverage problem threatening the network, and you figure it out from first principles.

We have a unique tech culture where engineers are seen as problem solvers. The engineering org is divided into multiple pods and each pod is aligned to a particular business theme. It is a culture driven by logical debates & arguments rather than authority.
 
At Meesho, you get to solve hard technical problems at scale as well as have a significant impact on the lives of millions of entrepreneurs. You are expected to contribute to the Solutioning of product problems as well as challenge existing solutions.

title: Director, Digital Experience
description:
We're looking for a Director, Digital Experience to lead how customers discover, evaluate, and engage with Freshworks through our website. You'll shape the web experience roadmap, lead designers and program managers, and partner with engineering to deliver better customer journeys and measurable business results.   You're a program manager at heart who stays close to the execution. You'll run Scrum across design and engineering, turn competing priorities into clear plans, and help the team deliver with speed and quality. You'll treat the website as a product, balancing launches and publishing needs with continuous improvements to its effectiveness.  
 
 What You'll Do  
 
 Web Experience and Roadmap    Set the web roadmap and decide what to tackle next. Use customer needs and performance data to weigh improvements, redesigns, migrations, and localized experiences.   Review designs with content and engineering partners. Make sure pages are easy to use and reflect the brand, with accessibility and conversion considered during design.   Agree on web priorities with Web Revenue, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Marketing Operations. Turn campaign and product plans into work the team can deliver.     Program Delivery and Scrum    Own request intake. Before work enters a sprint, confirm the problem, required content and assets, acceptance criteria, and the person who can approve it. Check template reuse, CMS constraints, and technical feasibility with engineering before committing.   Run sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, reviews, and retrospectives with design and engineering. Keep commitments visible, remove blockers, and follow up on changes agreed in retrospectives.   Track work through design, content development, QA, and launch. Flag dependencies or capacity problems early, explain the trade-offs, and get decisions from the right people.     Team Leadership    Manage the designers and program managers. Set goals, give regular coaching and performance feedback, and keep workloads realistic.   Stay involved in major projects and help design, engineering, and marketing resolve problems that slow delivery.     Web Operations and Continuous Improvement    Run CMS and publishing operations. Keep content models, templates, and review steps documented so people know what they can publish and who needs to approve it.   Agree on who signs off on each release and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT). Decide which issues block launch and which can follow. Check accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and tracking with engineering, then verify critical journeys on the live site.   Choose experiments with conversion and analytics partners, review the results, and then use them to decide what to do next. Track delivery time and rework alongside website performance.   Partner with design and engineering to test AI-assisted workflows that improve planning, creative exploration, and delivery.   Use automation and AI tools when they save time or reduce mistakes. Keep human review and data safeguards in place.   

  Experience owning a company website or leading web programs in enterprise B2B SaaS, including work that spans design, engineering, and marketing.   Experience managing designers and program managers, including regular coaching, performance feedback, and workload planning.   Ability to turn unclear requests into workable plans and spot dependencies before they cause delays.   Experience building and improving workflows in Airtable or comparable work-management platforms; Airtable experience preferred.   Experience running Scrum or a similar agile process with designers and engineers. You can explain what you changed when the process wasn't helping the team deliver.   Good design judgment and the ability to give useful feedback. Experience using customer data and test results to decide whether a web change worked.   Hands-on experience with CMS content models, publishing and web UAT. You can work through production or quality problems with engineering and understand web integrations, accessibility, and page performance   Clear communication with technical teams and senior stakeholders, especially when scope, timing, or resourcing needs to change.   

  Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tuesday - Thursday) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.    The annual  base salary range  for this position is $210,000 - $265,000. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.   Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available.
