title: Senior Engineering Manager - Billing Platform
description:
About the Billing Platform 
The Billing Platform is a foundational platform that powers how Freshworks manages and 
monetizes its products and customer relationships. 
The platform currently owns three critical capabilities: 
● Subscription Management – managing customer subscriptions, plans, products, and 
their lifecycle. 
● Entitlements – determining what customers are entitled to access and use based on 
their subscriptions and commercial agreements. 
● Metering – capturing and processing product usage to support usage-based billing 
and evolving monetization models. 
These capabilities sit at the intersection of technology, product, pricing, finance, and 
customer experience and are consumed across multiple Freshworks products. 
As Freshworks continues to expand its product portfolio and evolve its monetization models, 
the Billing Platform will play a critical role in enabling new business models while ensuring 
scale, reliability, accuracy, and a great customer experience. 
The Opportunity 
We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the engineering organization 
responsible for Subscription Management, Entitlements, and Metering. 
This role goes beyond managing engineering execution. You will shape the technology 
strategy, platform architecture, roadmap, engineering organization, and cross-functional 
partnerships that enable Freshworks' monetization journey.  We are looking for a leader who is equally comfortable discussing distributed systems and 
architecture with engineers, business models with Product and Finance, and strategic 
priorities with senior leadership. 
Most importantly, you should enjoy stepping outside the boundaries of engineering—meeting 
stakeholders from Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success, and other business 
functions, understanding their problems, and turning those problems into scalable 
technology solutions. 
What You'll Do 
1. Lead Billing Platform Engineering 
● Own the engineering strategy and technical direction for Subscription Management, 
Entitlements, and Metering. 
● Build highly scalable, reliable, secure, and extensible platform capabilities. 
● Drive architecture across distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, event-driven 
systems, and integrations. 
● Design platforms that can support multiple products, subscription models, pricing 
structures, and evolving monetization strategies. 
● Establish strong engineering practices around reliability, observability, security, 
performance, and operational excellence. 
2. Shape the Platform Strategy & Roadmap 
● Partner closely with Product and business stakeholders to shape the Billing Platform 
roadmap. 
● Translate business requirements and commercial models into scalable technology 
solutions. 
● Identify opportunities to build reusable platform capabilities rather than 
product-specific solutions. 
● Balance business priorities with platform modernization, technical debt, scalability, 
reliability, and long-term engineering investments. 
● Anticipate future business and monetization needs and ensure the platform is ready 
to support them. 
3. Partner with Business & Non-Engineering Stakeholders 
This role requires strong engagement beyond engineering. 
● Build trusted relationships with Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success, 
Operations, and other business teams. 
● Understand the business and commercial models behind subscription and 
usage-based offerings. 
● Participate actively in business discussions and explain technical implications in 
simple terms.  ● Translate complex business problems into technology strategies and platform 
capabilities. 
● Challenge requirements constructively when necessary and help stakeholders arrive 
at better solutions. 
● Represent the Billing Platform in cross-functional and strategic initiatives. 
We are looking for a leader who is curious about the business, enjoys meeting people 
outside engineering, and wants to understand the problem behind the 
requirement—not just implement the requirement. 
4. Drive Execution & Business Outcomes 
● Lead end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional platform initiatives. 
● Establish clear goals, milestones, ownership, and execution mechanisms. 
● Proactively manage risks, dependencies, capacity, and organizational constraints. 
● Drive predictable delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. 
● Measure and improve platform health, engineering effectiveness, reliability, and 
business impact. 
5. Build High-Performing Engineering Teams 
● Build, lead, and scale high-performing engineering teams. 
● Develop Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and emerging technical leaders. 
● Create a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous 
improvement. 
● Hire and retain strong engineering talent. 
● Coach engineers and leaders to take broader ownership and operate with increasing 
autonomy. 
● Build organizational capabilities that scale beyond the immediate team. 
6. Drive Engineering Excellence & AI Adoption 
● Raise the bar on engineering productivity, quality, automation, and developer 
experience. 
● Encourage modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development. 
● Explore AI and agentic workflows to improve development, testing, deployment, 
operations, and engineering productivity. 
● Establish meaningful engineering metrics around quality, reliability, delivery, and 
productivity. 
What We're Looking For 
Technical Leadership 
● 15+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience building 
and scaling large-scale platforms.  ● 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
● Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, databases, 
event-driven architectures, and cloud-native systems. 
● Experience building shared platforms or services consumed by multiple products or 
teams. 
● Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, security, observability, and operational 
excellence. 
● Experience with billing, subscriptions, payments, commerce, entitlements, 
metering, or monetization platforms is helpful. 
Business & Product Orientation 
● Ability to connect technology decisions with business and revenue outcomes. 
● Strong product and business mindset with the ability to translate business processes 
into scalable technology. 
● Comfortable working closely with Product, Finance, Pricing, Sales, Customer 
Success, and other non-engineering stakeholders. 
● Ability to influence business and product decisions through technology expertise. 
● Genuine curiosity about how the business works and how technology can create 
leverage. 
People Leadership 
● Proven experience building and leading high-performing engineering organizations. 
● Experience managing Engineering Managers and/or senior technical leaders is 
helpful. 
● Strong track record of hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining engineering talent. 
● Ability to create clarity and drive execution in ambiguous and complex environments. 
● Passion for building autonomous teams and developing the next generation of 
engineering leaders. 
Leadership & Influence 
● Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
● Ability to influence senior technical and business leaders across organizational 
boundaries. 
● Strong judgment in balancing business urgency with engineering quality and 
long-term platform investments. 
● Ability to simplify complex technical and business problems for diverse audiences. 
● Collaborative leadership style with the ability to challenge constructively and build 
strong relationships. 
The Leadership Profile We're Looking For 
You are someone who: 
● Thinks in platforms, not projects.  ● Understands both technology and business. 
● Enjoys solving complex problems with Product and business stakeholders. 
● Can move seamlessly between architecture, strategy, execution, and people 
leadership. 
● Creates clarity in ambiguous situations. 
● Challenges assumptions while building strong relationships. 
● Builds teams that can operate autonomously and scale. 
● Balances long-term platform thinking with near-term business outcomes. 
● Has deep technical judgment without needing to be the primary hands-on contributor. 
● Is passionate about building platforms, people, and organizational

title: Commercial Sales Director
description:
Freshworks is seeking an experienced Commercial Sales Director to lead a team of Commercial Account Executives driving new business revenue within our Commercial customer segment (250-500 employees).  Reporting directly to Mark Ripley, VP of Sales of Mid-Market and Commercial, this leader will manage a team of individual contributor sales representatives, with direct responsibility for day-to-day execution, coaching, and performance against pipeline conversion, forecast accuracy, and revenue targets.  This is a front-line sales leadership position requiring someone who has directly managed and developed individual contributor reps in a SaaS sales environment, and who thrives in a hands-on, in-the-field coaching role.  The ideal candidate combines strong sales fundamentals with hands-on coaching ability. They can set clear expectations, develop AEs’ skills, manage day-to-day execution, and partner across the organization to help the Commercial segment scale.      What You'll Do     Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Executives, establishing a high bar for performance, accountability, and execution.    Execute Freshworks’ Commercial sales strategy within your team, aligned with broader North America and company growth objectives.    Own revenue performance for your team, including pipeline generation, forecasting, deal execution, productivity, and quota attainment.    Actively participate in and support deals including joining customer calls, reviewing proposals, and helping reps navigate objections and close business.    Establish strong pipeline inspection and forecasting discipline within your team, providing clear and accurate visibility into performance, risks, and opportunities.    Recruit, hire, onboard, and retain top sales talent as your team grows.    Partner closely with Marketing, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and other functions to support your team’s execution.    Drive consistent use of sales process, methodology, and tools (e.g., Salesforce) across the team.    Provide ongoing coaching and skill development to reps at all experience levels, from ramping new hires to seasoned individual contributors.    Foster a positive, high-energy team culture that supports collaboration, accountability, and growth.    Represent your team within the broader Commercial sales leadership organization and contribute to territory planning, headcount planning, and go-to-market execution.   

   8+ years of progressive sales and sales leadership experience, ideally within enterprise or commercial SaaS organizations.    3–5 years of sales leadership/management experience, directly managing individual contributor sales representatives.    Demonstrated success building, coaching, and leading a high-performing sales team.    Deep understanding of SaaS sales cycles, including prospecting, discovery, demo, procurement, negotiation and closing.    Proven track record of consistently delivering against revenue targets, both personally as an individual contributor and as a people leader.    Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting, and sales productivity metrics.    Demonstrated ability to coach reps of varying experience levels while creating a culture of accountability and high performance.    Strong communication skills and presence, comfortable engaging with customers and internal stakeholders.    Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, balancing team management with hands-on deal support.    Experience with CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce).    Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment is highly desirable.       Success in this role means building a high-performing, motivated Commercial sales team that consistently meets or exceeds quota.  You will develop reps into stronger sellers, create consistency in pipeline and forecasting accuracy, and build a repeatable sales motion that scales with the team’s growth.  Most importantly, you will build a team culture where reps want to stay, grow, and do their best work — turning individual talent into a durable competitive advantage for Freshworks.

title: Vice President, Corporate Legal & Compliance
description:
This position will report directly to the Chief Legal Officer and will be responsible for handling a wide range of corporate and securities matters related to the growth, operation and further development of this global publicly traded corporation. The role will be the primary legal support to the SEC reporting, tax, treasury, insurance, investor relations, finance and stock plan administration functions of the Company.  This role requires a person to possess a strong securities and corporate governance background, and an analytical and detail-oriented growth mindset, coupled with strong communication skills.  This role will also serve as a leader in enterprise risk management and information security compliance, working closely with business leaders on business continuity processes, compliance programs and related disclosures.  This role will also help lead the global HR compliance projects of the company in partnership with regional HR legal specialists.  This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual with a strong background in corporate law that has demonstrated the ability to expand to the wide breadth of areas of an in-house legal team to contribute to our organization's success.    ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:    Advise on a broad range of securities laws and corporate governance matters to ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies generally applicable to Freshworks’ business.    Responsible for the preparation and/or review of periodic reports, earnings materials, proxy statements and other filings required by the SEC and Nasdaq, including 10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, proxy statements, S-8s, Forms 4 and other Section 16 filings and stock based compensation plans.  Responsible for the administration of policies and procedures to ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley, Nasdaq regulations, SEC regulations (e.g., insider trading, Reg. FD, etc.) and other regulatory requirements.  Manage the planning and execution of the virtual annual stockholder meeting.  Includes responsibility for outreach to proxy advisory services to regularly update corporate data and support investor relations on communications and investor relations matters, including stockholder feedback and tracking for Board of Directors.    Advising on insider trading and Section 16 issues for directors, officers and other insiders. Responsible for review of Rule 10b5-1 plans and coordination with stock administration and external brokers on same.  Work cross-functionally to assist in preparing Board of Directors and committee meeting materials.  Responsible for maintaining corporate minute books and records for both parent and subsidiary entities.    Support subsidiary governance and legal entity management operations globally, including legal entity formation, merger and dissolution processes, and ongoing compliance with local legal requirements (e.g., UK Anti-Modern Slavery Act).  Includes close collaboration with tax department on legal entity structuring and intercompany arrangements and finance department on annual filings for subsidiaries.  Assist with, and manage, corporate governance matters, including overall corporate compliance training programs, whistleblower policies, ≠≠business continuity and escalation processes, enterprise risk management initiatives and other key corporate initiatives.  Monitor corporate governance best practices and regulatory and legislative developments and advise on compliance with applicable standards and updates to policies and training materials.  Partner with Finance, Treasury, Corporate Development, Tax, HR and across other Legal and Business teams on a variety of projects and compliance processes.  Experience working directly with HR team members on matters a plus.  Support M&A, corporate transactions, and complex strategic initiatives and acquisitions.  Work closely with the broader legal team on general corporate and legal operations, including drafting and reviewing real estate contracts, agreements, marketing review, government and agency inquiries and other corporate-wide policies.   Assist in the development and implementation of corporate policies and procedures and appropriate training materials for client groups.  Develop strong working relationships and trust by actively collaborating with others in Legal and Compliance teams and across multiple functions within the Company.    Providing high quality legal advice and counsel in a timely fashion to senior management, the legal team and non-attorney staff in the business teams.  Handling other projects and matters as may be assigned from time to time.  

  Juris doctorate degree from an accredited law school and active state bar membership in good standing.  15+ years of relevant experience practicing with national law firm, with at least 8 years in-house experience at public-traded technology companies, preferably during the growth-to-great phase of its lifecycle.   Strong securities and corporate governance experience (along with an understanding of financial statements and equity plans) to support all periodic reporting and equity plan compliance of a U.S. public company with an internal finance team.  Strong knowledge of corporate law principles, regulations, and best practices.    High level of business acumen and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks and help make strategic business decisions aligned with legal parameters quickly and effectively in the face of ambiguity and uncertainty.  Ability to drive your own results and “roll up sleeves” to take on any project (from admin to strategy) in a small in-house legal team environment to get stuff done. title: Principal Engineer - Machine Learning
description:
About the Role:  Freshworks is building next-generation AI-driven customer and employee engagement platforms. As a Principal Engineer - Machine Learning on our AI/ML Engineering team, you will drive the architecture and technical strategy for core backend services powering our Agentic AI Platform. You will lead the development of reasoning-driven agents, multi-agent orchestration, and outcome-based workflows that directly power autonomous AI capability across our suite of enterprise products. This role is pivotal in establishing engineering standards, scaling backend infrastructure, and mentoring senior engineers as we expand our agentic capabilities at enterprise scale.   What You'll Do     Drive Platform & Runtime Architecture: Lead the architectural design and execution of agent runtime orchestration services, focusing on reasoning, planning, tool invocation, and low-latency execution.    Define API & SDK Standards: Design and establish robust, developer-friendly APIs and SDKs that enable internal engineering teams and external ecosystem partners to build, deploy, and manage complex agent workflows.    Architect Stateful & Memory Systems: Build and optimize stateful dialog management, shared context systems, and memory services for multi-turn, context-aware autonomous agents.    Implement Multi-Agent Communication Protocols: Establish scalable agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, coordination patterns, and shared memory spaces for distributed multi-agent workflows.    Lead Cloud-Native Microservices Migration: Drive the transition toward cloud-native, event-driven backend services using modern microservices, service mesh, and event-streaming architectures.    Optimize LLM Performance & Cost Efficiency: Design and implement LLM orchestration optimizations—including semantic caching, dynamic batching, token monitoring, and intelligent model routing—to ensure high performance and cost governance.    Own Integrations & Observability: Direct the implementation of enterprise RAG pipelines, vector database integrations (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS), and deep LangSmith/OpenTelemetry tracing for end-to-end evaluation and visibility.    Drive Technical Excellence & Mentorship: Establish rigorous standards for automated testing (unit, integration, load), tenant isolation (RBAC, multi-tenancy), and provide technical mentorship to elevate engineering capabilities across the team.   

  Must Have:     Experience: 12–18 years of progressive software engineering and machine learning system development experience, with a track record of architecting scalable enterprise backend systems.    Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in Java and Python, with hands-on expertise building production systems using agentic orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith) and workflow engines (e.g., Temporal, Airflow).    Distributed Systems Expertise: Advanced understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, AWS cloud infrastructure, and mixed database paradigms (PostgreSQL, Vector DBs).    Execute with Excellence: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex architectural bottlenecks, anticipate technical risks, and connect cross-functional dependencies to deliver high-impact engineering initiatives at scale.    Lead with Vision & Strategy: Demonstrated capability in translating complex business and AI goals into actionable long-term platform roadmaps while influencing technical decisions across cross-functional engineering partners.    Cultivate a Growth Mindset: A track record of identifying innovative tools, challenging assumptions, and driving technical continuous improvement across the broader engineering organization.     Nice to Have     Experience with AI-driven planning systems, dialog state tracking, or reinforcement learning feedback loops in production environments.    Hands-on experience with enterprise security frameworks, including SSO, OAuth2, RBAC, and multi-tenant data isolation.    Active involvement in open-source AI/ML projects or contributions to major LLM/orchestration libraries.   

  Please note this is a hybrid role that requires an in-office presence 3 days / week (Tue-Thu). title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.  This is a high-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.  You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.  The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.   What You'll Do   • Own high-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution. 
• Tackle ambiguous company-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them. 
• Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments. 
• Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions. 
• Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment. 
• Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust. 
• Develop executive and Board-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations. 
• Bring an outside-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next. 

  What We're Looking For   • 4-6+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in-house strategy experience;  experience from a top-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred  
• Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems 
• Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred 
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations 
• Executive-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority 
• Comfortable moving between high-level strategy and hands-on analysis 
• Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity 
• Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation   Why This Role   Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.  For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.  You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.  This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.

title: Principal Engineer - Systems
description:
Role Overview   We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead the design and evolution of the enterprise-scale platform architecture that powers Freshworks’ multi-tier SaaS products. This role will define the architecture strategy for a major platform domain, drive modernization initiatives, and establish best practices across service design, reliability, engineering quality, and cost.  The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, microservices, event-driven design, and large-scale production operations with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities — and remains genuinely hands-on, writing production code and leading deep debugging when it matters.   Key Responsibilities    Architecture & Strategy     Define and own the platform architecture roadmap for your domain, including the target state and a realistic path to it.    Design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures supporting high-throughput, low-latency, multi-tenant workloads.    Establish architecture standards, design principles, decision records, and review practices.    Evaluate emerging technologies and own build-versus-buy decisions with measurable outcomes.     Platform Engineering     Architect and build cloud-native services and APIs that scale with global growth.    Design service decomposition, API contracts, messaging and event-driven flows, caching strategies, and database-layer design.    Treat multi-tenancy as a first-class design concern: isolation models, noisy-neighbour control, per-tenant limits, and cost attribution.    Lead platform modernization — monolith decomposition, migrations, and deprecations carried through to completion.     Reliability, Performance & Operations     Drive platform reliability, availability, performance optimization, and observability.    Take ownership of complex production issues in distributed SaaS environments, leading deep root-cause analysis and implementing permanent preventive safeguards.    Define SLOs, failure modes, resilience patterns, and capacity planning for the systems you own.     Engineering Excellence & Quality     Write clean, maintainable, high-performance production code and build proof-of-concepts that settle architectural questions.    Establish rigorous engineering standards through code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD integration.    Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical debt, and drive practical, iterative refactoring without compromising business delivery.     Security, Privacy & Compliance     Ensure platform designs and team practices align with information security standards and regulatory requirements.    Design for tenant isolation, access control, auditability, and data residency from the outset.     Technical Leadership     Provide architectural guidance across multiple engineering teams.    Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.    Mentor senior and staff engineers, raising the bar through reference implementations and sponsorship rather than authority.    Influence engineering strategy and long-term technology investments; articulate complex trade-offs to both technical panels and executive stakeholders.   

  Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience.    14+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or systems architecture within modern distributed SaaS environments.    Expert-level backend engineering in Java, Python, Go, or equivalent — currently hands-on.    Proven experience designing and operating enterprise-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, with real numbers for throughput, latency, availability, and behaviour under failure.    Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency and idempotency, retries and backpressure, concurrency, caching, and database design and optimization.    Demonstrated ownership of large-scale migrations or modernization initiatives with measurable outcomes.    Advanced production debugging skills — Linux internals, profiling, log analysis, and telemetry in distributed cloud environments.    Experience leading cross-functional architecture initiatives in SaaS or product organizations.     Good to Have    Data Platform & Analytics     Batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, and serving architectures; streaming and CDC (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium).    Lakehouse and modern data platform technologies such as Delta Lake, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud-native data services.    Reusable data models, semantic layers, and curated data products enabling self-service analytics.    Data governance practice — metadata management, cataloging, lineage, and data quality frameworks.    Feature and training data architectures supporting AI/ML initiatives.     Adjacent Experience     ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or similar analytical and search engines.    AI-native product capabilities — RAG, agentic workflows, and LLM integration in production.    FinOps practice: cost attribution, showback, and efficiency guardrails at platform scale.

title: Technical Curriculum Developer
description:
Freshworks is looking for a Technical Curriculum Developer to join our growing Revenue Enablement team.   In this role, you'll create engaging technical learning experiences for Partners, Solution Engineers, Professional Services teams, and other customer-facing technical roles. You'll combine learning design, multimedia content creation, and technical proficiency to help learners confidently understand, demonstrate, and implement Freshworks solutions.   You'll work closely with technical subject matter experts and cross-functional partners to understand complex product concepts and translate them into clear, practical, and scalable digital learning experiences.   From technical certifications and eLearning courses to videos, interactive learning activities, assessments, and job aids, your work will directly improve technical readiness and customer outcomes.    What You'll Do    Design and develop technical learning experiences including eLearning, certifications, assessments, simulations, videos, job aids, and learning paths for Partners, Solution Engineers, Professional Services, and other technical audiences.   Create polished, professional-quality multimedia learning content using text, video, audio, animations, interactions, and tools such as Articulate 360 (Storyline & Rise).   Partner with Solution Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Product Marketing, and technical SMEs to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical learning experiences.   Assess learning needs and define appropriate course scope, learning objectives, content structure, and assessments based on learner and stakeholder requirements.   Work with technical SMEs to identify the most important concepts learners need to know and help keep learning experiences focused, practical, and appropriately scoped.   Build and maintain technical certifications and readiness programs that prepare learners to confidently understand, demonstrate, and implement Freshworks solutions.   Measure learning effectiveness through assessments, learner feedback, and business outcomes, and continuously improve content based on what you learn.   

  5-8 years of experience designing technical curriculum, digital learning experiences, or enablement programs in a SaaS or technology environment  Demonstrated ability to create polished, professional-quality multimedia learning content, including eLearning, video, audio, and interactive experiences  Strong learning design skills, including the ability to define course scope, develop learning objectives, structure content, and build assessments that effectively measure learner progress   Experience creating learning for technical audiences such as Solution Engineering, Professional Services, Partner Enablement, Customer Education, Customer Success, or similar customer-facing technical teams   Solid technical foundation in computer science, SaaS, enterprise software, or related technologies, with the ability to understand technical concepts and translate them into clear, concise learning content  Experience developing eLearning using Articulate 360 (Storyline & Rise) or similar authoring tools   Strong technical writing and communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills   Ability to collaborate effectively with technical SMEs and help distinguish essential learning content from "nice-to-have" information   Experience designing technical certifications or assessments is a plus   Experience with AI-powered learning tools or content creation is a plus   

 This is a hybrid role with in-office expectations of 3 days/week (Tuesday - Thursday) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.   The annual base salary range for this position is $115,000 - $150,000 USD. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.  Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available. Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability and life insurances. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits. title: Creative Director
description:
Freshworks is seeking a Creative Director to lead and scale our in-house creative team. This role owns the strategy, operations, and output of Freshworks' internal creative function — from brand campaigns, to sales enablement, events, and digital experiences — ensuring every creative touchpoint reflects the quality, clarity, and character of the Freshworks brand. title: Senior Director, Sales – North America Verticals
description:
Freshworks is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Sales, North America (US and Canada) Verticals to lead our go-to-market execution across three strategic vertical markets: Manufacturing, State, Local & Education (SLED), and Federal/Government as well as Canada.   Reporting directly to the SVP & GM of America’s Sales, this leader will oversee three sales teams and their respective leaders, with responsibility for building and executing the strategy required to accelerate Freshworks' growth within these highly specialized markets.  This is a senior, second- or third-line sales leadership position requiring someone who has successfully led leaders, scaled enterprise SaaS sales organizations, and brings deep experience navigating the unique buying environments, procurement processes, and customer needs within the public sector and other complex vertical markets.  The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with strong operating discipline. They can set the direction for the business, develop high-performing sales leaders, navigate complex enterprise opportunities, and partner across the organization to turn vertical specialization into a competitive advantage for Freshworks.      What You'll Do    Lead Freshworks' North America vertical sales organization, with responsibility for teams focused on Manufacturing, SLED, and Federal/Government markets.  Lead, coach, and develop the sales leaders responsible for each vertical, establishing a high bar for performance, accountability, talent development, and execution.  Develop and execute a comprehensive vertical sales strategy aligned with Freshworks' broader North America and enterprise growth objectives.  Own revenue performance across the verticals organization, including pipeline generation, forecasting, deal execution, productivity, and attainment.  Build a scalable operating model across the three vertical teams while recognizing the distinct customer, regulatory, procurement, and go-to-market requirements of each market.  Drive Freshworks' continued expansion into larger, more complex enterprise SaaS opportunities and help teams navigate sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.  Serve as an executive sponsor on strategic opportunities, helping teams engage senior customer stakeholders, overcome obstacles, and successfully close transformational deals.  Establish strong inspection and forecasting discipline across the organization, providing clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, opportunities, and business performance.  Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional sales leadership and sales talent as the vertical organization scales.  Partner closely with Marketing, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Channels & Alliances, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, and other functions to develop integrated vertical go-to-market strategies.  Build strong relationships with channel, technology, and ecosystem partners that can accelerate Freshworks' presence within strategic vertical markets.  Bring market intelligence back into Freshworks, helping Product and GTM leadership understand the evolving needs of Manufacturing, SLED, and Federal/Government customers.  Represent the verticals organization within the North America sales leadership team and contribute to broader GTM strategy, planning, and execution.  

  15+ years of progressive sales experience, ideally within enterprise software or SaaS organizations.  8+ years of sales leadership experience, including 5+ years leading managers and operating at a second- or third-line leadership level.  Demonstrated success building, scaling, and leading high-performing enterprise sales organizations through multiple layers of leadership.  Significant experience selling into and leading sales organizations focused on SLED and/or Federal/Government markets is required, with a strong understanding of public-sector buying cycles, procurement processes, contracting requirements, and go-to-market dynamics.  Experience within Manufacturing or other complex enterprise vertical markets is strongly preferred.  Deep understanding of complex enterprise SaaS sales cycles, including executive engagement, multi-threaded decision processes, procurement, security, legal, implementation, and commercial negotiations.  Proven track record of consistently delivering against ambitious revenue targets and driving predictable, sustainable growth.  Experience developing and executing vertical-specific GTM strategies rather than relying solely on traditional geographic or territory-based sales models.  Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting, territory planning, account strategy, and sales productivity.  Demonstrated ability to coach and develop experienced sales leaders while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and high performance.  Strong executive presence with the ability to engage credibly with C-suite customers, senior government and public-sector stakeholders, internal executives, partners, and other senior decision-makers.  Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment and balance long-term strategic thinking with hands-on leadership and execution.  Strong cross-functional leadership skills and a track record of influencing across complex organizations.  Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment and/or helping an organization successfully move upmarket is highly desirable.    What Success Looks Like   Success in this role means building a high-performing, predictable, and scalable North America vertical sales organization that establishes Freshworks as a stronger enterprise partner across Manufacturing, SLED, and Federal/Government.  You will develop leaders who can independently run strong businesses, create greater consistency in pipeline and forecasting, improve enterprise execution, and build repeatable vertical-specific sales motions that can scale with Freshworks' growth.  Most importantly, you will help turn vertical expertise into a meaningful competitive advantage — ensuring our teams understand not only how to sell Freshworks, but how to solve the specific business challenges of the industries and customers we serve.

Let's building something refreshing together.   The annual  base salary range  for this position is $255,000 - $315,000 Base Salary. title: Principal - Solution Engineering
description:
As a GSI Solution Architect, you will be the technical and solution engine behind our Global Systems Integrator ecosystem, with a dedicated focus on Employee Experience and Freshservice.  You will help GSI partners find, shape, and progress new business and expansion opportunities — bringing solution credibility to early conversations, turning employee service challenges into structured opportunities, and building the assets and capability that let partners eventually run these motions themselves.  You will work day-to-day with two Business Development colleagues and our GSI Partner Managers, and partner closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Professional Services. This is a commercially aligned role — you will be measured on partner-sourced ARR — but it is not a pure sales role. Solution leadership, partner enablement, and technical credibility are the core of the job.   Key Responsibilities     Work with GSI partners to identify and shape new Freshservice opportunities linked to employee service transformation.    Support early-stage discovery with partner teams and end customers, translating service challenges into structured solution opportunities.    Build solution narratives across ITSM modernisation, employee self-service, workflow automation, knowledge management, and legacy ITSM migration.    Identify where existing EX or ITSM footprints can expand into broader Enterprise Service Management — HR, Finance, Facilities, Legal, Procurement, Security, and Operations.    Position AI as a practical accelerator: self-service, ticket deflection, agent assist, knowledge discovery, and automation.    Equip our two Business Development colleagues with messaging, discovery questions, and qualification guides, and join calls where solution credibility is needed.    Deliver enablement sessions for GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams, and support their certification and readiness.    Create reusable assets — demo flows, reference architectures, discovery guides, and partner playbooks — that scale beyond any single deal.    Support partner account planning and contribute to the quality and conversion of partner-sourced pipeline.   

  Required     Experience in solution architecture, presales, consulting, or partner solution engineering.    Strong understanding of Employee Experience, ITSM, ESM, service desk modernisation, and internal service delivery.    Experience working with GSIs, systems integrators, consulting firms, or other partner-led business models.    Ability to build EX, ESM, and AI solution narratives, and to support both new business and expansion motions.    Understanding of AI use cases in service management — self-service, agent assist, automation, knowledge, and ticket deflection.    Experience creating demos, discovery guides, enablement content, and reference architectures.    Comfortable being commercially aligned to partner-sourced ARR.    Strong stakeholder management across partner, sales, product, and technical teams, with excellent communication and presentation skills.     Preferred     Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC, Ivanti, ManageEngine, or similar ITSM/ESM platforms.    Experience supporting partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue motions, or GSI-led transformation programmes.    Experience working with Indian or global GSI partners.    Familiarity with ITIL, workflow automation, and internal service operations.    Ability to build business cases, value propositions, and repeatable go-to-market plays.    Experience supporting migrations from legacy ITSM platforms.

title: Account Executive - Mid Market
description:
At Freshworks, we believe great employee experiences start with great people - and that includes you. title: Director - Global Talent Management
description:
Freshworks is rethinking how we develop, evaluate, and listen to our people — and this role is at the center of that transformation. As Director of Performance Management & Employee Listening, you will lead two of our most strategically important people practices: a comprehensive redesign of how we approach performance management, and a shift to a modern, continuous approach to employee listening.   This is a role for someone who thinks systemically, designs with the business in mind, and cares about execution as much as strategy. Ultimately, you are helping us build something lasting: a sustainable culture of high performance and an employee experience that is genuinely differentiated. You will work as part of a small, senior Workforce Strategy & Org Development team — owning your domain with a high degree of autonomy and leading through influence across a matrixed organization. You will not manage a large team, but you will need to move a lot of work through people who don't report to you.  Based at our San Mateo headquarters, you will work alongside senior leaders and represent the People team in high-visibility conversations at the VP and executive level. We need someone who commands a room, earns trust quickly, and brings both creative thinking and rigorous follow-through to everything they own. Critically, you know that even the best-designed programs fail without deliberate change management — and you build enablement, communication, and adoption into your work from the start.   What You’ll Do    Performance Management Transformation    Lead a meaningful transformation of how Freshworks approaches performance management — moving from a process-heavy, subjective model to a streamlined, AI-assisted approach that is easier for managers, more consistent in its outputs, and more tightly connected to business outcomes.  Design and own the end-to-end performance system: the methodology, the tools, the calibration approach, and the employee and manager experience.   Coordinate across HR, Total Rewards, HR Technology, and business partners to deliver an integrated solution that actually works in practice.   Build and maintain executive alignment. This work is visible to senior leadership, and you will present, defend, and iterate on it in real time.   Lead the change management and enablement strategy for the performance transformation — developing communications, training, and leader readiness plans that drive understanding and adoption across the organization.  Hold the bar on quality and detail at every stage.     Employee Listening    Own our employee listening strategy and programs, including our continuous listening platform, pulse approach, and how we translate signals into leadership action.  Drive the shift from periodic survey cycles to an always-on listening culture — designing and executing the change management strategy that moves leaders from passive recipients of survey results to active owners of the employee feedback loop.  Build leader-facing tools, frameworks, and communications that make listening data accessible and useful, not just reportable.   Track program health, participation trends, and sentiment over time; surface risks and opportunities and bring forward clear recommendations.   Stand up and lead a cross-functional employee experience working group — bringing together leaders from People Analytics, Employee Experience, and the HRBP community to build a cohesive, multi-lens view of the state of the employee experience. This group will be responsible for maturing how we aggregate and interpret employee signals, and for delivering a regular, centralized view of organizational health to senior leadership.   Continuously improve our approach as AI capabilities and listening methodologies evolve    Change Management & Enablement    Own the change management and enablement strategy across both performance and listening — from how we communicate program shifts to how we build leader capability and drive adoption at scale. The goal is not compliance with new programs; it is durable behavior change that builds a culture of high performance and an employee experience people can feel.  Apply behavioral science principles to the design of change interventions — using what we know about habit formation, social norms, loss aversion, and motivation to design programs that shift behavior, not just awareness.  Design and deliver leader enablement programs that translate program changes into concrete behaviors: what leaders need to know, do, and model differently as a result of each transformation.  Build a communication and engagement framework that keeps employees, managers, and senior leaders informed, aligned, and bought in throughout multi-year transformation cycles.  Serve as the connective tissue between program design and organizational readiness — ensuring that what we build in the design room actually lands in the field.  Measure adoption and enablement effectiveness; use data to identify where uptake is lagging and adjust approach accordingly.  

  8–12 years of progressive experience in HR, people strategy, organizational effectiveness, or a related field.   Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives from design through execution in a fast-paced environment. • Deep expertise in performance management design — you’ve built or significantly redesigned performance systems before and understand how to make them fair, scalable, and defensible.   Meaningful experience in organizational design and development — you can help leaders think through structure and effectiveness, and you know how to turn those conversations into action.   Strong change management and enablement skills — you know how to bring people along through transformation, build leader capability, and design adoption strategies that actually stick. • Familiarity with continuous listening platforms and methodology; experience driving leader adoption of listening tools is a strong plus.   An AI-first mindset — you’re curious about what AI makes possible in people practices and you bring that perspective to how you design programs and solve problems.   Exceptional executive presence — you’re comfortable presenting to C-suite leaders, you communicate with clarity and confidence, and you can hold your own in high-stakes rooms.   High attention to detail — you care deeply about getting things right and you’ll get into the weeds to make sure they are. • Strong cross-functional instincts — you build trust with Finance, Strategy, and Operations partners and you design solutions that work for the business, not just for HR. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can translate complexity into clarity for any audience.  

  Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.    The annual base salary range for this position is  $199,750 - $246,750.  This role is also eligible for a target bonus.   Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level.   Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. title: Senior Manager - Events
description:

Partner with Creative Services to execute the event look and feel across stage, environmental, signage, digital, and other attendee touchpoints. Proven ability to own events end-to-end, from strategy and experience development through production, onsite execution, and post-event evaluation.  Experience managing complex events across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, vendors, budgets, and tight timelines.  Strong event production, vendor, and financial management skills, including contracts, procurement, AV, Run-of-Show, stage management, and onsite operations.  Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business and brand objectives into differentiated attendee experiences and confidently partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. Experience managing India-based vendors and cross-functional teams, including the ability to navigate time zones, communication styles, and complex workstreams across geographies.  Proficiency with event technology and platforms, including Cvent or similar event management and registration platforms.  Experience with experiential marketing or innovative event formats, with a demonstrated ability to bring creative concepts and brand narratives to life in unexpected ways.

The role will define the strategy, operating model and governance for the function, delivering workforce insights that enable strategic business decisions, organizational effectiveness and long-term workforce planning. The Senior Director will build and lead a high-performing team responsible for analytics, workforce planning and strategic decision support.      Key Responsibilities    People Analytics    Lead the People Analytics function, establishing its strategy, operating model and roadmap.  Develop enterprise workforce analytics, executive dashboards, AI-driven insights and strategic reporting to support business and talent decisions.  Advance the function from operational reporting to predictive analytics, AI-enabled decision support and strategic workforce intelligence.  Establish governance, standards and enterprise workforce metrics to ensure consistent, accurate reporting across the organization. title: Technical Product Marketing Manager, AI
description:
Freshworks is looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager to bring the next generation of AI-powered IT service management to market.   The conversation around enterprise AI has gotten technical. Buyers and prospects are asking about model quality and evaluation, agent-to-agent coordination, MCP and tool-calling, retrieval and data grounding, inference economics, and where automation ends and autonomy begins. Marketing that can't engage at that level gets discounted.   You'll be the technical voice of Freshservice AI by authoring the content that stands up to scrutiny and making sure our external narrative matches what the product genuinely does. While you won't be asked to build or maintain demo infrastructure, you will be expected to get into the product yourself, run the workflows, and form your own view before you write about them.    What You'll Do:     Own the technical narrative for AI across Freshservice —how our agents work, how they're grounded in the right context, how quality is measured, and why our architectural choices matter.   Author technical content that holds up under scrutiny: architecture explainers, deep-dive blogs, whitepapers, model and evaluation narratives, and integration guides for platform teams.   Enable the technical field. Build the material that Solution Engineers, Solution Architects, and Customer Success need to win technical evaluations, POCs, and security or architecture reviews.   Support customer and prospect conversations directly when technical depth is the deciding factor, such as evaluations, advisory boards, analyst briefings, and customer interviews.   Partner with Product Management and Engineering across the lifecycle, translating technical decisions into customer value and carrying technical buyer feedback back into the roadmap.   Represent Freshworks externally at webinars, industry events, and in bylined technical writing.   Track the AI landscape, including models, agent frameworks, emerging protocols, competitive moves as well as how these trends will impact ITSM use cases.   

  What We're Looking For:     5+ years in product marketing, technical marketing, solutions engineering, or another technical customer-facing role in B2B SaaS   Real fluency in modern AI systems: agent frameworks and orchestration, tool-calling and MCP, retrieval and grounding, evaluation and quality measurement, fine-tuning, and the practical trade-offs among cost, latency, and accuracy   Comfort working hands-on in product and demo environments. You configure the workflows, run the prompts, and probe the edges yourself rather than waiting for a briefing. You don't need to be the person who builds the environment  A bias toward investigating. When you don't understand how something works, your first move is to go try it. Published writing, talks, repos, or shipped side projects tell us more than a slide library  Proven ability to write clearly and specifically for technical readers without hiding behind abstraction   Credibility with engineers. You can sit in an architecture review, follow it, and ask the question that changes the answer  A point of view. You arrive at discussions with a take, not a status update   Excellent written and verbal communication skills     Nice to Have:     Experience marketing ITSM, IT Operations, DevOps, observability, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure products   Familiarity with enterprise AI adoption patterns and the governance, security, and data-residency questions that gate it   Experience marketing to IT administrators, platform teams, and enterprise technology evaluators  Hands-on experience with agent development, evaluation frameworks, or automation and workflow platforms   A public footprint (e.g., writing, talks, demos, or repos) that shows how you think  

  Please note: This is a hybrid role that will be based in San Mateo, CA and requires an in-office presence three days per week (Tuesday - Thursday).    The annual base salary range for this position is $160,000 - $200,000. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.  Compensation is based on a variety of factors including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level. Bonus/equity may be available. Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability and life insurances. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits. title: Enterprise Sales Director UKI
description:
Role: Regional Sales Director, Enterprise Sales (UK & Ireland)  Company: Freshworks (NASDAQ: FRSH)  Location: London, UK (Hybrid – 3 days/week in office)  The Vibe  Freshworks is disrupting legacy software giants by making enterprise tech fast, intuitive, and genuinely delightful to use. We are scaling fast across the UK and Ireland, and we’re looking for a heavy-hitting Regional Sales Director based in London to lead from the front, build an elite sales engine, and take our ITSM and CX footprint to the next level.  About the Role  Reporting directly to our Country Leader (UK & Northern Europe), you’ll be the strategic engine powering a team of top-tier Enterprise Account Executives. Operating from our flagship London hub, this isn't a sit-back-and-delegate role—it’s high-visibility, high-impact leadership. You’ll spend your time coaching sellers, co-selling in the field with executive buyers, closing six-figure deals, and turning raw UKI market potential into predictable, high-velocity ARR.  What You’ll Be Doing    Rule the Territory: Author and run the ultimate GTM blueprint to systematically land, expand, and dominate Tier-1 enterprise accounts across the UKI region.    Lead the Pack: Coach, elevate, and scale a team of 7–9 Enterprise AEs to smash a collective $4M–$6M+ ARR target.    Master the Playbook: Enforce MEDDPICC like a science to maintain razor-sharp forecasting, eliminate deal friction, and keep pipeline health bulletproof.    Co-Sell at the C-Suite: Jump into the trenches with your AEs—partnering with Solution Engineers and CS leads to negotiate and close multi-year, strategic agreements. title: Senior Director, Engineering - AI Studio (CX & EX)
description:
At Freshworks, we are building the future of customer and employee engagement - and AI agents are at the center of it. The AI Agent Platform is the foundation on which our next generation of autonomous and assistive experiences are built. AI Studio is the product surface that brings that platform to life: the place where builders design, test, deploy, observe, and continuously optimize AI agents that ship inside our CX and EX products. 
We are looking for a visionary engineering leader to own AI Studio end to end. As the Senior Director of Engineering for AI Studio, you will lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization that builds the front-end experience and the Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer for the AI Agent Platform, and embeds these capabilities natively within our CX and EX product lines. This is a pivotal, high-visibility role with the opportunity to shape how thousands of businesses build and operate AI agents - setting the bar for craftsmanship, developer experience, reliability, and scale.   Key Responsibilities    Lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization of engineers and engineering managers spanning front-end, BFF/services, and platform integration.  Own the vision and technical execution for AI Studio - the end-to-end experience to build, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents on the AI Agent Platform.  Deliver a best-in-class front end and a robust Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer that expose the AI Agent Platform’s capabilities to builders with speed, trust, and clarity.  Embed AI Studio natively within both CX and EX product lines, ensuring a seamless, consistent builder and end-user experience across surfaces.  Establish the agent lifecycle as a first-class product: authoring and configuration, testing and evaluation, safe deployment, live observability, and data-driven optimization.  Partner deeply with the AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, and Data Science teams to surface state-of-the-art models, tools, and orchestration capabilities through intuitive workflows.  Define and track impact: agent build velocity, time-to-deploy, adoption, agent quality and containment/deflection, reliability, and measurable ROI for CX and EX customers.  Establish governance and trust: access controls, guardrails, data classification, privacy/PII handling, auditability, and compliance-ready practices for agent workflows.    What You’ll Do     Set the AI Studio vision:  Define the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for a unified studio experience that lets builders create, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents across CX and EX.   Own the full builder journey:  Ship the front-end and BFF that make agent authoring, configuration, and iteration fast, intuitive, and reliable - from first prototype to production at scale.   Deliver testing & evaluation:  Build the tooling for agent testing, simulation, and evaluation (quality, safety, regression) so teams ship agents with confidence and measurable quality bars.   Enable safe, scalable deployment:  Provide deployment, versioning, and rollout controls that let teams promote agents across environments with strong guardrails and zero-downtime expectations.   Build observability & optimization:  Deliver real-time monitoring, tracing, and analytics for live agents - surfacing quality, latency, cost, and outcome signals - and close the loop so insights drive continuous optimization.   Embed across CX & EX:  Ensure AI Studio integrates natively into Freshworks CX and EX products, delivering a consistent experience while respecting the needs of each product line.   Lead & inspire:  Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive culture across a multi-tiered organization of engineers and managers. Mentor the next generation of technical leaders and build a team known for technical excellence and execution velocity.   Execute with excellence:  Master the full development lifecycle, from strategic planning and roadmap management to deployment and operations. Champion agile, iterative delivery to ship exceptional products under ambitious deadlines and evolving priorities.   Drive technical & architectural strategy:  Act as the technical authority for AI Studio. Guide teams in building large-scale, distributed cloud systems, performant front-end architectures, and resilient BFF/API layers, adopting best practices and emerging AI technologies.   Collaborate to win:  Build powerful partnerships with AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, Product, Design, and GTM leaders so the AI Studio roadmap is aligned with platform capabilities, business needs, and customer expectations. Foster a “one team” mindset.   Champion innovation & quality:  Foster continuous improvement and out-of-the-box thinking. Establish and track KPIs that measure AI Studio health, reliability, builder productivity, and business impact. 
   

  What You’ll Bring    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director or above) leading product-facing platform, developer-tooling, or application engineering teams.  Demonstrable experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing product and engineering organizations in an enterprise SaaS environment.  Strong technical foundation in building and operating large-scale, distributed systems on public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including modern front-end architectures and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)/API design.  Hands-on understanding of the AI/agent landscape: LLMs, agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation and observability for AI systems, and the practical realities of shipping AI features into production.  Track record of delivering builder- or developer-facing products (studios, low-code/no-code tooling, or platform consoles) with excellent UX and reliability at scale.    Skills Inventory:    Leadership & Talent Management    Inspirational leadership & mentorship  Talent acquisition & retention  Organizational design & scaling  Performance management & career development    Technical & Architectural Acumen    Front-end architecture & Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) design  Cloud computing, microservices & large-scale distributed systems  AI agent platforms: LLMs, orchestration, evaluation & AI observability  DevOps, CI/CD, and SRE principles  Data security, guardrails & compliance frameworks    Strategic & Business Acumen    Long-term strategic planning & vision setting  Roadmap development & prioritization  Budget & resource management  Data-driven decision making & KPI management    Execution & Collaboration    Agile & iterative development methodologies  Cross-functional influence & stakeholder management  Exceptional communication & interpersonal skills  Problem-solving & crisis management 
   

  Please note this is a hybrid role that requires an in-office presence 3 days / week (Tue-Thu). title: Vice President - Corporate Communications
description:
We're looking for a Sr/Vice President of Corporate Communications to own and evolve Freshworks' narrative in the market globally, across every channel, and at every altitude. This is a rare seat: one where you're expected to think in long-term story arcs and get in the weeds on a Reddit thread or a niche IT newsletter. You'll partner directly with the C-suite, run a high-performing global team, and set the omnichannel communications strategy that fuels our growth among agile enterprises and IT leaders worldwide.  This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. We want someone who takes big swings to land the Wall Street Journal and knows which Subreddits your buyers actually trust.    What You'll Own:     Communications Strategy & Narrative    Define and scale the Freshworks corporate narrative across earned media, executive communications, social channels, influencer programming, content, and emerging LLM/AI search surfaces  Build a clear, differentiated market position that drives Freshworks' perception as the leader in midmarket IT service management and a force multiplier of AI-powered service  Translate complex product and business stories into sharp, accessible narratives that resonate with IT decision-makers, CX leaders, and enterprise buyers  Own the company news calendar and global PR drumbeat that balances quarterly rhythms with the agility to capitalize on breaking news and cultural moments    Omnichannel Execution    Lead a modern press office program that earns coverage in Tier 1 business and trade outlets while also driving engagement in niche communities including industry newsletters, podcasts, and LinkedIn groups  Build and execute an influencer strategy that extends Freshworks' reach into credible, community-driven channels  Develop an executive communications engine (including CEO, CPO, CIO, CTO, CMO) that produces consistent, high-quality thought leadership at scale, including social content, bylines, speaking engagements, and earned media moments  Ensure all executive platforms connect to corporate strategy and reinforce Freshworks' core narrative pillars    AI & Modern Communications    Bring a forward-looking perspective on how communications is evolving — particularly the growing role of LLMs as a discovery and search layer for B2B buyers  Build a track record of actively shaping how Freshworks appears in AI-generated responses, summaries, and recommendations (i.e., LLM optimization, not just SEO)  Champion the use of AI tools and workflows within the comms function to increase speed, quality, and reach of storytelling    Issues Management & Crisis Communications    Serve as the communications lead on Freshworks' Escalation Response Team, proactively identifying risk, setting strategy, and driving execution on reactive moments  Monitor global signals (social, press, analyst community) to stay ahead of issues before they escalate    Measurement & Reporting    Build a sophisticated measurement framework that tracks not just coverage volume, but message pull-through, audience awareness shifts, and contribution to pipeline and LLM influence  Deliver executive-facing reporting (MBR, QBR) with insights that translate communications activity into business impact  Use data to make real-time pivots in strategy and resource allocation    Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment    Lead, develop, and inspire a global team of communications professionals across earned media, executive comms, and social that spans US, APAC, and EMEA  Partner closely with the VP of Brand, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Investor Relations, and Legal to ensure narrative consistency and coordinated news moments  Build strong relationships with the C-suite to earn trust, gain alignment, and move quickly when it matters  

  Experience    15+ years in corporate communications, with 5+ years leading a global function at a B2B technology company  Deep experience with challenger brands and category-defining moments where you've been part of a communications transformation and can point to the work  Proven track record managing communications at a publicly traded company or during high-stakes moments (IPO, M&A, earnings, product pivots)    Skills & Perspective    You’re fluent in omnichannel storytelling. You think naturally across press, social, exec comms, content, and emerging channels, and you know how they reinforce each other  You are media savvy with real relationships. You know which reporters matter and how to earn coverage that moves the needle, not just fill a clip report.  You have social channel expertise. You know the difference between a LinkedIn strategy and an X strategy, you're watching TikTok and YouTube with the same attention, and you bring a learning mindset that keeps you ahead of platform shifts.  You know AI-native communications. You're already actively experimenting with how to influence LLM outputs, and you have a point of view on what the AI-era comms stack looks like.  You use sophisticated measurement methodology. You know how to tie earned awareness to pipeline influence, and you can build that case with data.  You have a strong executive presence. You're comfortable in the boardroom, you earn trust quickly, and you know how to get buy-in without losing speed.  You have a bias toward creative, unconventional thinking. You’re more interested in disrupting the playbook than following it.    Values Alignment:    You thrive in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment  You're as comfortable in a sprint as in a strategy session  You're energized by a challenger brand mindset and you want to win market share from giants and you know how to build the narrative that makes that possible  You bring good vibes and a collaborative spirit to a growing team
