title: Lead - Solution Engineer
description:
Freshservice is expanding what “AI-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.  This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post-sale. You'll be the AI subject-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.  You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.   What You'll Do    Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.  Design and deliver tailored AI proofs-of-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.  Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.  Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.  Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.  Support deal-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof-of-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).  Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.  Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business-case models that the wider SE team can self-serve.  Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one-sided.  Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.  Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go-to expert.  

  What You'll Bring    8+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.  Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.  Hands-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM-based solutions in a customer-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.  Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.  A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP  Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one-size-fits-all pitches.  Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof-of-value and into implementation handoff.  Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX-leader audience or down to a hands-on admin audience in the same week.  Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.    Nice to Have    Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.  Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42) and how it feeds AI-driven automation.  Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.  A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.

title: GTM Engineer, Revenue Operations
description:
At Freshworks, we're introducing AI across our GTM organization to accelerate how we understand buyers and act on revenue signals.   As a key member of the Web & Revenue Marketing team, you will build the agents, automations, and intelligence systems that help our frontline teams operate more effectively.   We're looking for a GTM operator who is also a hands-on builder—someone who deeply understands how revenue teams work and can turn those problems into AI-powered workflows and systems.   Our buyer signals currently live across Salesforce, Marketo, Outreach, product usage data, intent platforms, and other systems. You'll connect those signals, add context and intelligence, and build workflows that help revenue teams determine who to engage, why, when, and what action to take.   You may come from Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, Revenue Technology, Marketing Operations, or a similar technical GTM function. You don't need to be a traditional software engineer, but you do need to be someone who has personally built solutions, not just managed the tools or processes around them.   You'll have executive sponsorship, high-impact problems to solve, and a blank canvas to help shape how AI is applied across the Freshworks GTM organization.  
 
 What You'll Do:      Build AI-powered GTM Workflows:  Design and deploy agents and automations across lead management, account research, routing, scoring, prioritization, personalization, seller briefings, and follow-up    Turn Buyer Signals into Action:  Connect and enrich signals across web activity, intent, product usage, CRM history, engagement data, and third-party sources to identify high-value accounts and recommend actions   Automate the GTM Stack:  Build integrations and workflows across systems like Salesforce, Clay, Marketo, sales engagement platforms, enrichment provides, internal data sources, and AI tools   Build Agents and Internal Tools:  Use LLMs, APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, and scripting to create tools that make sellers and revenue teams faster and more effective    Solve Frontline GTM Problems:  Partner directly with Sales, SDR/BDR, Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, RevOps, and Demand Gen teams to understand workflow friction and translate business needs into working solutions    Prototype and Iterate Quickly:  Build solutions, get them into users' hands, measure their effectiveness, and iterate based on real-world feedback    Make AI Workflows Reliable:  Implement validation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, monitoring, error handling, and other mechanisms needed to move successful prototypes into production  

  What We're Looking For     Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, GTM Systems, Revenue Technology, Marketing Operations, or a similar GTM function   Strong understanding of B2B revenue workflows including lead management, routing, enrichment, qualification, account prioritization, prospecting, and pipeline generation  A hands-on builder who has personally created automations, integrations, internal tools, or data workflows—not just managed the systems or processes around them   Experience working with GTM platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, or similar  Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered workflows or agents using Claude, OpenAI, Relevance, MCP, n8n, Workato, or similar tools   Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, data integrations, automation platforms, or scripting to connect systems and bring ideas to life   Ability to partner directly with Sales, Marketing, SDR/BDR, and RevOps teams and translate business problems into working technical solutions    Nice to Have    Experience with SQL, Python, JavaScript, or data warehouses  Experience building account intelligence, enrichment, scoring, routing, or signal-based GTM workflows  Experience taking AI or automation workflow from prototype through production and adoption   

  Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.    The annual base salary range for this position is  $202,000 - $250,000.  This role is also eligible for a target bonus.   Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level.   Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits are also offered. title: Lead - Solution Engineer
description:
We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled  Solution Engineer  to be part of our SMBC Sales Support team for Freshservice. You will be instrumental in solving complex customer problems, designing tailored solutions — including AI-driven use cases built on Freddy AI and Agent Studio — and delivering impactful demonstrations of the Freshworks platform. This role suits individuals with strong pre-sales experience who thrive on customer interaction, solutioning, and collaborating with internal teams to drive business outcomes, and who are genuinely curious about applying AI to real customer problems rather than just talking about it.   Pre-Sales Engagement & Customer Solutions:    Engage with SMB, mid-market customers to understand their business and technical challenges.  Conduct discovery sessions, architect solutions, and deliver tailored product demonstrations and Proofs of Concept (POCs).  Address technical objections and ensure alignment with customer needs.    AI Solutioning & Positioning:    Understand and clearly explain core AI/LLM concepts (prompting, agents, model context/tooling) to both technical and business audiences without over-selling or over-simplifying.  Position Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, and Agent Studio within customer discovery, tying AI capabilities to concrete outcomes (ticket deflection, resolution time, agent productivity) rather than generic AI messaging.  Build and configure simple AI agents and automated workflows in Agent Studio (or comparable agent-builder tools) to bring AI use cases to life in demos and POCs.  Field technical AI questions on integration, data handling, and governance, looping in specialists for deeper architecture discussions when needed.    Solution Design & Documentation:    Participate in gathering requirements and scoping complex engagements.  Create technical documentation including solution proposals, SoWs, and RFP/RFI responses.  Evaluate opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint and proactively mitigate risks.    Collaboration & Execution:    Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams.  Align technical strategies with sales initiatives to accelerate deal closures.  Continuously improve pre-sales tools, processes, and enablement assets.    Customer Advocacy & Product Evangelism:    Articulate the value and capabilities of the Freshworks platform to both technical and business audiences.  Represent Freshworks at customer meetings, events, and forums as a trusted technical advisor.  Keep abreast of product developments and industry trends to provide relevant, up-to-date guidance.  

   5–8 years  of experience in pre-sales/solution engineering, technical consulting, or a similar customer-facing technical role.  Strong background in SaaS, cloud technologies, APIs, and enterprise software environments.  Proven experience designing and delivering technical demonstrations and POCs. title: Deal Desk Strategy Manager
description:
Freshworks is looking for an experienced Deal Desk Strategy Manager to play a critical role in shaping and accelerating some of our largest and most strategic deals. Reporting to the Senior Director of Deal Desk, this senior individual contributor will partner directly with Account Executives and regional sales leaders to develop deal strategy early, navigate complex commercial decisions, and drive transactions from initial opportunity through close. This is more than a traditional Deal Desk role — you’ll operate as a trusted advisor to Sales, bring together the right partners across Legal, Finance, and Operations, and help remove the friction that can stand between a great opportunity and a closed deal. title: Senior Analyst - Cybersecurity
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE   Freshworks is looking for a Senior Analyst- Cybersecurity to join our GTM (Go-To-Market) Cybersecurity team. You'll sit at the intersection of Cybersecurity, customer trust, and go-to-market — acting as a subject matter expert who gives prospective and existing customers confidence and assurance in Freshworks' security posture.  Reporting to the Manager, Cybersecurity, you'll be a hands-on technical security advisor: fielding customer questions, responding to RFPs and security questionnaires, and partnering with Security Engineering and Product Engineering to translate technical security detail into clear, customer-ready answers. This is an execution-focused role within a growing team — you'll work inside the playbooks, templates, and systems the team builds, sharpening them through direct customer contact.   WHAT YOU'LL DO     Be a trusted technical security advisor.  Serve as a subject matter expert on cloud security, AWS architecture, and product security posture for prospective and existing customers.   Own the customer security dialogue.  Respond to cybersecurity questionnaires, RFIs/RFPs, and other due diligence documents, and join customer calls jointly with Sales, Pre-Sales, Channel Sales, Customer Success, and Deals Desk teams.   Be the single point of contact for cloud security asks.  Work closely with Security Engineering and Product Engineering as the primary liaison for cloud security and AWS architecture-related customer questions.   Create reusable security collateral.  Partner with Security Engineering and Product Engineering to build customer-shareable technical security content based on recurring customer asks.   Review contracts with a security lens.  Perform contract reviews (MSA, DPA, BAA, and related agreements) for cybersecurity obligations relevant to the role.   Coach and upskill the team.  Support existing team members in strengthening their technical security knowledge.   Work across time zones.  Align to different regions/shifts as needed, given the breadth of time zones Freshworks' customers span.  

  4–7 years of experience in Cybersecurity, with depth in Application Security Architecture, Security Pre-Sales, or Solutioning.  Experience with cloud services/technology (AWS) as it relates to cybersecurity.  Good understanding of web frameworks and architecture.  Any experience in Pre-Sales or Solution Engineering within a SaaS setup is a plus.  Strong verbal and written communication skills — able to communicate concisely and unambiguously with both technical and non-technical audiences.  Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-growing environment, with the discipline to respond to customers contextually and on time.  Self-sufficient and able to work with minimal direct supervision.  Flexibility to work different shifts/regions — this is a mandatory requirement of the role.    Technical Skills    Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals on AWS (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub).  Familiarity with web application security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC basics, API security, and encryption standards (TLS, AES-256, key management).  General understanding of SaaS security models, multi-tenant architecture, and shared responsibility frameworks.  Exposure to security questionnaire and trust center platforms (e.g., Loopio, Responsive, SafeBase) and GRC tools (e.g., Drata, Vanta) is a plus.  Ability to read and interpret security documentation, SOC 2 audit reports, and architecture diagrams.  Good with automation — comfortable using scripting, workflow builders, or no-code/low-code tools to speed up repetitive tasks.  Working understanding of AI/GenAI concepts and how they intersect with data security and privacy, to speak confidently to customer questions in this area.    Certifications (Nice to have)    CompTIA Security+ or equivalent foundational certification  AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect – Associate  ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)  Certified Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK)    Soft Skills    Clear communication: able to distill security topics for technical and non-technical audiences alike.  Cross-functional collaboration: comfortable working with Security Engineering, Legal, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.  Customer empathy: understands that behind every questionnaire is a customer trying to make a trust decision.  Reliability under pressure: able to triage competing customer requests across time zones and deliver consistently.  Coachability and a growth mindset, with willingness to mentor others as experience grows.    NICE TO HAVE    Prior experience in Pre-Sales or Solution Engineering at a SaaS company.  Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or HIPAA.  Exposure to trust center platforms (e.g., SafeBase) or security questionnaire tools (e.g., Loopio, Responsive).    WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS   Enterprise customers don't just buy products — they buy trust. At Freshworks, the Cybersecurity GTM function is the front line of that trust, and this role puts you directly in front of the customers who depend on it. Every questionnaire you close, every call you join, and every piece of collateral you help build moves deals forward and strengthens the confidence customers place in Freshworks. If you want hands-on ownership of real customer security conversations at a fast-growing company, this is the role.

title: Channel Sales Manager - UK
description:
About this role:   This is a pivotal individual contributor role at the heart of Freshworks’ UK channel growth strategy. As a Channel Sales Manager, you will own the full lifecycle of our Systems Integrator business in the UK — from prospecting and signing new mid-tier SI partners through to driving active pipeline and revenue through those relationships.  The UK SI opportunity is significant. Freshworks is building a strategic motion to displace incumbent ITSM and CX platforms through SI-led delivery, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. You will work closely with field sales, pre-sales, and marketing, as well as directly with SI practice leads, to build a partner ecosystem that generates meaningful, repeatable revenue.  The right person for this role combines a hunter’s instinct for identifying and signing the right partners with the commercial discipline to hold those partners accountable to joint business plans and pipeline commitments. You know how SIs operate, how they build practices, and how to get from first conversation to active GTM motion.   Responsibilities:    SI Recruitment & Onboarding    Identify, target, and sign mid-tier SI partners (e.g., Capgemini, CGI, Unisys) aligned to Freshworks’ UK ITSM and CX growth priorities  Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective SI partners, drawing on market mapping, ex-ServiceNow and ex-incumbent networks, and competitive intelligence  Lead the end-to-end partner recruitment process — from initial outreach and business case development through to contract execution and onboarding  Design and execute structured onboarding programmes that bring new SIs to first-deal-ready status quickly: product knowledge, commercial terms, deal registration, pre-sales support model    Partner Enablement & Acceleration    Build and maintain SI partner capability across sales, pre-sales, and delivery —ensuring partners can self-sufficiently position, scope, and close Freshworks-based solutions  Develop joint go-to-market plans with each SI partner, including target verticals, solution plays, and co-sell motions with Freshworks field teams  Drive participation in Freshworks enablement programmes, including accreditation, demo certification, and deal support resources  Act as the primary relationship owner into SI practice leads and partner alliances teams, building multi-threaded engagement across sales, delivery, and leadership    Pipeline & Revenue    Own and actively manage a partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, working with CAMs and field AEs to progress and close SI-originated opportunities  Set and hold partners to joint pipeline targets and revenue commitments through structured QBR and business planning rhythms  Co-sell alongside SI partners on key opportunities, providing commercial, technical, and executive support as required  Track and report on SI pipeline health, deal velocity, and revenue contribution through Salesforce, ensuring accurate and up-to-date forecasting    Strategy & Ecosystem Development    Contribute to the UK SI partner strategy, including partner selection criteria, tiering, and investment allocation  Identify SI partners with existing ServiceNow or legacy ITSM practices as priority displacement targets and develop engagement plans accordingly  Work cross-functionally with marketing, product, and pre-sales to develop SI-specific content, solution briefs, and campaign assets  Feed market and competitive intelligence back into channel leadership, including partner sentiment, competitor partner programmes, and whitespace opportunity  

  Required    7+ years’ experience in channel, alliances, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software environment  Demonstrable track record of recruiting and activating SI partners, not just managing existing relationships  Strong understanding of how mid-tier SIs operate: practice structures, P&L dynamics, delivery models, and how they make partner investment decisions  Experience working in or adjacent to ITSM, EX, or CX categories — familiarity with the ServiceNow ecosystem is a strong advantage  Commercially rigorous: comfortable building joint business plans, setting pipeline targets, and holding partners accountable to commitments  Ability to build and maintain senior relationships within SI organisations — practice leads, alliance directors, and C-level stakeholders  Strong pipeline management discipline — fluent in Salesforce or equivalent CRM for partner opportunity tracking and forecasting  Effective at working cross-functionally: comfortable aligning field sales, pre-sales, and marketing behind partner-led motions    Preferred    Prior experience at a vendor in a channel or alliance role targeting ServiceNow displacement or competing against legacy ITSM platforms  Existing network within UK mid-tier SI community (Capgemini, CGI, Unisys, Computacenter, or equivalent)  Experience building net-new SI practices around a vendor platform from early stage  Familiarity with co-sell and marketplace dynamics as a complement to SI-led GTM  Background in solution or pre-sales that gives you credibility in technical and delivery conversations with SI partners  Fluent in Dutch &/or any Nordic language is an advantage.    Personal Attributes    Hunter mentality: energised by finding and opening new relationships, not just managing the existing book  High commercial IQ — able to quickly assess partner fit, investment appetite, and revenue potential  Direct and confident communicator — able to influence without authority across both internal and partner organisations  Disciplined operator: tracks commitments, follows through, and manages a structured pipeline without prompting  Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage programme building — this is a role that will shape the SI motion, not inherit a mature one

title: Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.  FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.   Your role and responsibilities:     During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.    During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.    In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.     Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:     Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.    Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop custom Freshworks product solutions in line with business goals and industry standards. Create architecture diagrams for proposed designs and deliver presentations.    Technical Implementation: Configure, customize, and deploy Freshworks products, encompassing workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting.    AI and Automation Solutioning: Identify opportunities for prospects and customers to leverage AI, automation, and agentic capabilities to achieve measurable business outcomes. Advise customers on the data readiness, governance, security, accuracy, adoption, and operational ownership required to successfully deploy and manage AI-enabled solutions.    Process Optimization: Identify areas for enhancement, proposing efficient solutions to improve operational efficiency.    Training and Support: Provide training to customers’ support agents, administrators, and relevant teams, ensuring the proficient use of Freshworks products during deployments.    Issue Resolution: Liaise with the Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges and implementation issues related to Freshworks products.    Integrations Design: Create and integrate Freshworks products with other systems and third-party applications to streamline 3rd-party integrations and facilitate data flow.    Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical and architectural documentation, covering system configurations, integrations, and customizations.    Stay Informed: Stay updated on industry trends, Freshworks product updates, and best practices to continually enhance the capabilities of the customer support ecosystem.     What success in this role looks like:   Success in this role means opportunities are accurately scoped, proposed solutions are technically feasible and supportable, delivery teams receive clear and actionable designs, architecture decisions are made quickly, risks are surfaced early, and customers have confidence in you and that the solution will meet their intended business outcomes. 

   10+ years of professional experience in ITSM, ESM, ITOM, ITAM    Strong technical background with custom script development and presales experience    Ability to read complex situations with several competing constraints and identify solutions that benefit both the customers and Freshworks    Excellent listening and presentation skills    5+ years working directly with Functional and organizational leaders internally and externally    Proficient in handling ambiguity and objections    Skilled in negotiation and objection handling    Experience with guiding customers in organization change management (OCM) to improve technology adoption is highly desirable.     Experience navigating difficult technical decisions and communicating tradeoffs to executives, architects, administrators, and delivery teams.     Required skills:     7+ years of Professional Services experience in software industry in SaaS platforms    Previous roles in Solution Architect or Domain Architect within ITIL oriented / ITSM systems are advantageous    A problem-solving innovator with a knack for thinking outside the box    Proficient at creating architecture diagrams, process maps, data-flow diagrams, and clear design documentation.    Extensive expertise in Enterprise landscapes across various domains, including ERP systems, Accounting Systems, HRMS, IDAM, and more    Demonstrated experience in designing customer experience process flows    Strong understanding of the Cloud Stack and SaaS products    Proficiency in developing custom apps and REST API-based integrations    Preferred, though not mandatory, background in Javascript and NodeJS        Preferred skills:     ITIL Certification    Knowledge of Project Management principals

title: FP&A Manager, Product & Engineering
description:
We are seeking an FP&A Manager to join our Finance team as a dedicated business partner to our global Product & Engineering organization.   This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an experienced FP&A professional who enjoys working closely with business leaders, understanding what drives their organization, and turning financial data into insights that support better decisions.   Reporting to the Sr. Manager, FP&A, you'll partner with Product and Engineering leaders on planning, forecasting, investment decisions, and performance management. You'll help leaders understand the financial impact of their decisions, challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and bring a thoughtful financial perspective to how we allocate resources.   You don't need to be a Product & Engineering finance expert on day one. We're looking for someone with strong FP&A fundamentals, excellent business-partnering instincts, and the curiosity to learn the operational and technical drivers behind our Product & Engineering organization.    What You'll Do     Serve as a trusted FP&A business partner to Product & Engineering leaders, helping them understand financial performance and make informed business decisions.   Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning for your areas of the Product & Engineering organization, connecting headcount, investments, and other operational drivers to our financial plan.  Build financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate investments, resource allocation decisions, and other business opportunities.   Analyze financial and operational performance, identify key trends, risks, and opportunities, and translate your findings into actionable recommendations.   Partner with leaders on headcount and expense planning, helping teams understand tradeoffs and make thoughtful investment decisions.   Develop reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility into budgets, forecasts, and key business drivers.   Partner with Accounting during the monthly close process to ensure accurate results and provide meaningful variance analysis.   Develop a deeper understanding of Product & Engineering cost drivers, including cloud infrastructure and other technical investments, and help identify opportunities to improve efficiency.   Create clear financial narratives and presentations that make complex information easy for Finance and business leaders to understand.   Identify opportunities to improve and automate FP&A processes, reporting, and workflows so the team can spend more time on analysis and business partnership.   

  5+ years of experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, or a related role   Strong experience as a finance business partner, with the ability to build relationships with business leaders, understand their priorities, and provide financial insights that support better decision-making  Solid FP&A fundamentals, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling  Strong analytical skills with the ability to work through complex data, identify what matters, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations   Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills and experience building financial and operational models   Strong communication skills and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and bring a thoughtful financial point of view to business discussions  A proactive, collaborative approach with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Participate in security awareness initiatives by providing guidance on cybersecurity policies, secure development practices, and responsible AI usage.    3–6 years of experience in Cybersecurity Risk & Compliance, Information Security, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), or related domains.    Experience conducting cybersecurity risk assessments, security reviews, compliance assessments, or control validation activities.    Working knowledge of cloud security concepts, preferably AWS, and common cloud security controls.    Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, PCI DSS, HIPAA, NIST 800-171, or similar frameworks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience working across cross-functional teams. title: Senior Manager - Employee Relations
description:
The Freshworks People team shapes experiences that maximize the potential of our people. Based in San Mateo (HQ), this Senior Manager, Employee Relations role is a key member of our global ER leadership team, owning the employee relations agenda across the United States and Europe.   You will co-create ER strategy alongside our global ER leadership, bringing a unique lens and deep cross-cultural fluency to how we build a high-trust, high-performance culture.  We are re-imagining Employee Relations for today’s world — how we handle workplace conflicts, how we take a more proactive, data-driven approach to organisational health, and how we teach employees to share diverse points of view with respect. At Freshworks, we believe we are stronger together.      What You’ll Bring    BS/BA degree required; JD or advanced HR qualification a plus. 7+ years of relevant experience in employee relations, workplace conflict, and performance management, with meaningful exposure to both European and US employment environments.  Proven experience operating as an ER practitioner at a senior level, with the ability to execute independently while contributing to broader global strategy.  Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and inspire talent; experience managing or mentoring ER team members or HR colleagues.  Fresh, innovative, and data-driven thinking applied to complex, long-standing ER challenges — with a growth mindset and a track record of high-impact outcomes.  Strong business and people acumen, with excellent consulting, conflict resolution, and facilitation skills across diverse cultural contexts.  In-depth understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion issues and their application to employee relations practice.  Knowledge of UK and European employment law (including but not limited to GDPR, works council obligations, and country-specific labour laws across the EU) highly desired.   Proficient in US employment law (ADA, ADEA, FMLA). Collaborative, influential, and decisive — able to lead and partner at all levels of the organisation while keeping stakeholders informed.  Comfort with HR technology and case management tools (e.g. Salesforce, ServiceNow, Smartsheet); operational rigour in everything you do.       How You Will Lead    Co-create ER strategy with the global ER leadership team, ensuring alignment and consistency across the US and other regions.  Own the day-to-day ER agenda for Europe and the United States — from complex case management to coaching managers and HR Business Partners on handling workplace issues with confidence and consistency.  Build capability across the broader People organization on conflict resolution, mediation, restorative justice, and bias-aware decision-making.  Partner with the global ER team to re-imagine how we address performance concerns, involuntary exits, and organisational changes — grounded in principle, designed for people, and executed with operational excellence.  Serve as a trusted expert on organizational health issues: gaps in belonging and trust, manager-employee conflicts, and behaviours that do not align to Freshworks’ values or DEI commitments.  Ensure governance and compliance with employment policies and practices across the US and Europe, including interpretation and application of relevant laws, regulations, and corporate policy.  Work closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Development, Total Rewards, and Legal to deliver coordinated, seamless support on ER matters.  Drive accountability through strong case management practices, meaningful metrics, and a continuous improvement mindset.  Partner with Legal to navigate works councils, trade unions, and local consultation requirements in European markets.  

  Education & Experience    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field required; JD, Master’s in HR/Labor Relations, or advanced HR certifications (e.g., SPHR, SHRM-SCP) desired.  Relevant Experience: 8+ years of progressive, direct experience in Employee Relations, Workplace Investigations, and Performance Management, including at least 3+ years in a senior/lead capacity within a fast-paced, matrixed tech company or enterprise software environment.  Cross-Border Expertise: Hands-on operational experience managing ER matters across both US and European jurisdictions (specifically UK, Germany, France, or Netherlands).    Legal & Compliance Mastery    US Employment Law: Deep expertise in US federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations (including FMLA, ADA/ADAAA, ADEA, Title VII, FLSA, FEHA, and state-specific leave/separation mandates).  European Labor Relations: Working knowledge of European employment legislation, GDPR compliance as applied to workplace investigations, and practical experience navigating European Works Councils (EWCs), trade unions, and local statutory consultation processes.    Execution & Strategic Leadership    Investigation Expertise: Proven track record of independently conducting, managing, and documenting complex, high-risk workplace investigations (e.g., harassment, discrimination, executive-level misconduct, retaliation) with discretion and objectivity. title: Principal Engineer — Product & Application Security
description:
We are looking for a Principal Engineer — Product & Application Security to be the top technical authority for how Freshworks builds secure software. As an IC6 Principal, you set the multi-year security technical vision for our products and platform, make the calls on our hardest security-architecture problems, and are the person the company relies on when the stakes are highest — across a multi-tenant SaaS estate serving 72,000+ customer accounts and hundreds of integrations.  As Freshworks evolves from a suite of service products into an AI-first system of business intelligence — with autonomous agents, a Knowledge and Context Graph, and a growing agentic surface — the security bar must rise with it. This role goes beyond leading individual reviews and remediations: you define the secure-by-design paradigms, reference architectures, and organization-wide standards that determine how thousands of engineers ship, and you drive the strategic bets (AI/agent security, supply-chain integrity, zero-trust data protection) that keep Freshworks ahead of the threat curve.  You will operate as a company-wide force multiplier — writing code and reference implementations, setting technical direction that outlives any single project, mentoring Staff and Senior Staff security engineers, and partnering directly with VP Engineering, the CISO organization, and product leadership to make security a durable competitive advantage.   Key Responsibilities    Security Technical Vision & Strategy    Own the multi-year technical vision and architecture strategy for product and application security across all Freshworks products (Freshdesk, Freshservice, and the shared Platform), and drive alignment on it across engineering and the CISO organization  Define the secure-by-design reference architectures, paradigms, and organization-wide standards (authN/authZ, tenant isolation, data protection, secrets, API security) that thousands of engineers build against  Set the strategic security agenda for the AI-first platform — securing the AI Agent Platform, Knowledge/Context Graph, and agentic workflows — anticipating threat classes before they reach production  Act as the final technical decision-maker and tie-breaker on the hardest, highest-risk security-architecture trade-offs    Product & Application Security Engineering    Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for the most critical, cross-cutting, and highest-risk systems — including identity and access, the integrations/connector framework (300+ apps), and the agent runtime  Set the standard for secure code review, manual and AI-assisted penetration testing, and vulnerability analysis; drive root-cause remediation strategies that eliminate whole vulnerability classes across the estate, not one bug at a time  Architect and harden multi-tenant security controls: strict tenant isolation, authentication/authorization models, secrets management, data protection, and API gateway security  Own the security design for AI/agentic features — prompt injection defense, tool-invocation authorization, non-human identity, and permission-scoped context access    Left-Shift & Secure SDLC at Scale    Define the organization-wide, AI-assisted left-shift strategy: how SAST, DAST (e.g., Snyk), SCA/dependency scanning, secret detection, and IaC scanning are embedded across every CI/CD pipeline to catch issues before production  Set the direction for security tooling, automation, and paved-road frameworks and libraries that make the secure path the default path — including code-component asset inventory (API/SBOM/RBAC/secrets/integrations) and secure-by-default product hardening  Own the software supply-chain security strategy: centralized software artifact repository management (e.g., Sonatype Nexus), code artifact repository guardrails, and CI/CD pipeline hardening  Establish secure coding standards, golden patterns, and guardrails; operationalize threat modeling and maturity models (SAMM) across the product portfolio; and define the security quality gates the whole org is measured against    Vulnerability Management & Incident Response    Serve as the top technical escalation point for the most severe security incidents — leading investigation, containment strategy, and post-incident architectural hardening  Set the risk-based prioritization framework for findings from internal testing, bug bounty, third-party pen tests, and researcher disclosures, and drive systemic fixes  Shape the strategy for the bug bounty and responsible-disclosure program    Technical Leadership & Influence    Act as the recognized top IC authority for product security — mentoring and multiplying Staff and Senior Staff engineers and security champions, and raising the security bar across the entire engineering organization  Influence company-level strategy: advise VP Engineering, the CISO organization, and product leadership; represent Freshworks' product-security posture to enterprise customers, auditors, and (where appropriate) the external security community  Drive cross-organizational security initiatives to completion through technical credibility and clarity — building As a Account Executive based in Singapore, you will drive growth and consistently exceed revenue goals within PH territory. You will win new strategic and enterprise accounts, build lasting customer relationships, and apply your SaaS expertise to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders across diverse industries.    What You Will Do         Engage, Discover & Drive Results: Execute territory strategies to win enterprise business, expand Freshworks’ footprint in the the PH market, and exceed sales targets.      Own the Sales Process: Manage the full sales cycle—from prospecting to negotiation and closure—ensuring predictable outcomes and strong performance across key accounts.      Articulate Value: Build trusted relationships with senior executives, identify complex business challenges, and position Freshworks as a strategic partner that delivers ROI and growth.      Collaborate & Learn: Work closely with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and Product) to deliver outstanding customer experiences and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.      Hunt & Prospect: Develop and maintain a strong, data-backed pipeline with accurate forecasting. Conduct in-person meetings and presentations, representing Freshworks in customer engagements and industry events across Singapore.      Build the Market Presence: Play a pivotal role in establishing Freshworks’ local presence—shaping go-to-market strategy, nurturing key partnerships, and contributing to the foundation of our long-term success in the PH region.    

    Experience that counts: 7+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in mid-market or enterprise segments, with a proven record of exceeding revenue goals.      Strategic mindset: Skilled at managing complex sales cycles and engaging multiple stakeholders, including enterprise IT and business decision-makers.      Revenue focused: Strong prospecting and pipeline management capabilities, backed by structured forecasting and disciplined execution.      Domain knowledge: Proficiency in solution selling of software platforms (e.g., ITSM, IT infrastructure, EX/CRM/Customer engagement solutions) that drive operational efficiency and business impact.      Strong collaborator: Customer-centric approach with the ability to build cross-functional partnerships and deliver results in a matrixed organization.      Language proficiency: Fluency in English (verbal and written) is required to collaborate effectively with regional and global teams.      Territory -     You will be responsible for driving growth and managing enterprise relationships primarily in the PH territory based in Singapore, while collaborating with regional teams across Asia-Pacific for shared strategic accounts.

title: Staff Engineer - Full Stack
description:
At Freshworks, we don’t just ship software—we shape it to be fast, reliable, and refreshingly simple. As a  Staff Full Stack Engineer (IC4) , you will architect the end-to-end systems that drive our global SaaS products, balancing complex distributed backend infrastructure with highly responsive, scalable frontend applications. You will lead cross-functional technical strategies, champion engineering excellence across teams, and mentor engineers to level up our entire platform ecosystem.  If you obsess over time and space complexity, love breaking down tough, multi-tier architectural problems, and take pride in leading technical execution without losing touch with the code—you’ll feel right at home.   Impact You Can Create      E2E Platform Evolution:  Own and scale foundational full-stack architectures capable of handling millions of transactions while delivering seamless, high-performance web experiences globally.     Technical Guidance (IC4):  Act as a technical compass across multiple engineering tracks, translating ambiguous product visions into resilient, modular high-level and low-level designs.     Engineering Multiplier:  Foster a culture of excellence by leading deep-dive code reviews, mentoring junior/mid-level systems engineers, and introducing modern architectural patterns.     AI-Powered Efficiency:  Pioneer the integration of modern AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) into the daily full-stack development workflow to accelerate delivery without sacrificing technical depth.     Roles & Responsibilities (R&R)      Full-Stack Architecture:  Architect, build, and maintain scalable backend microservices and extensible REST APIs paired with intuitive, modular frontend application layers.     Full Lifecycle Ownership:  Own the entire software development lifecycle—from gathering functional/non-functional requirements and data modeling to deployment, automation, and production support.     Code & Design Optimization:  Write clean, modular, and testable code optimized for browser rendering efficiency, database execution performance, and space/time complexity.     Production Governance:  Ensure backend and frontend systems are tuned for high availability (99.99%+), multi-tenant fault tolerance, security compliance, and deep observability.     Cross-Functional Partnership:  Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX designers, and Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to ship highly localized, value-driven capabilities fast.     Root-Cause Analysis:  Troubleshoot complex full-stack performance bottlenecks in production, from slow database queries to state-management memory leaks.     Mentorship & Best Practices:  Lead architectural reviews, establish development roadmaps, mentor 2–4 engineers, and actively drive OOPS and SOLID design principles across the org.   

  Skills      Computer Science Foundations:  Expert-level grasp of Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade-offs, and Object-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles.     System Design (HLD & LLD):  Proven capability to design scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant end-to-end multi-tenant systems, including APIs, web architectures, schemas, and data models.     Distributed Infrastructure Stack:  Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems.     Modern Web Ecosystems:  Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client-side performance optimization.     Cloud & DevOps Practice:  Hands-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP).     AI Tool Fluency:  Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day-to-day coding efficiency and technical exploration.     Technical Communication:  Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives.     Qualifications      Professional Timeline:  10+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and scaling full-stack applications in high-growth product teams.     Iterative Sourcing History:  A proven track record of building complex systems from scratch and steering them through multiple scale iterations in production.     Pragmatic Delivery:  Skilled at balancing rapid feature delivery with long-term code maintainability, clean documentation, and scalability.     Collaborative Leadership:  Experience managing technical initiatives, coordinating cross-functional engineering loops, and mentoring other engineers.     Education Baseline:  Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative technical field.

title: Assistant Manager - Internal Audit
description:
About Groww:
We are a passionate group of people focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian through a multi-product platform. Each day, we help millions of customers take charge of their financial journey. Customer obsession is in our DNA. Every product, every design, every algorithm down to the tiniest detail is executed keeping the customers’ needs and convenience in mind. Our people are our greatest strength. Everyone at Groww is driven by ownership, customer-centricity, integrity and the passion to constantly challenge the status quo.
 
Are you as passionate about defying conventions and creating something extraordinary as we are? Let’s chat.
 
Our Vision
Every individual deserves the knowledge, tools, and confidence to make informed financial decisions. At Groww, we are making sure every Indian feels empowered to do so through a cutting-edge multi-product platform offering a variety of financial services. Our long-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians.
 
Our Values
Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves.
The values that form our foundation are:
  • Radical customer centricity
  • Ownership-driven culture
  • Keeping everything simple
  • Long-term thinking
  • Complete transparency
Reimagine Internal Audit with us | What You'll Do

Internal Audit at Groww is not just about checking controls. It’s about understanding the business deeply, asking the right questions, spotting what others may miss, and helping build a stronger, safer and more resilient organisation.

  • Know the business inside out
    Understand Groww’s businesses, products, systems and processes, with exposure across Digital Lending, Broking, Wealth Management and other evolving areas.
  • Spot what others may miss
    Use data, analytics and professional scepticism to identify anomalies, emerging risks and early warning signals—and turn them into meaningful insights.
  • Go beyond the rulebook
    Build expertise across RBI, SEBI, stock exchange and other regulations, translating requirements into impactful audit procedures.
  • Own audits end-to-end
    Plan and execute risk-based audits, identify root causes, and work with stakeholders to drive practical, sustainable remediation.
  • Reimagine how audits are done
    Leverage Gen AI, Agentic AI, data analytics and automation to make Internal Audit smarter, faster and more continuous.
  • Influence, don't just report
    Build trusted stakeholder relationships, challenge constructively and help turn audit findings into meaningful business improvements.
  • Make insights matter
    Communicate key risks and themes clearly to senior leadership and the Audit Committee, while building institutional knowledge for the team.
  • Keep raising the bar
    Stay ahead of emerging risks, technology, regulations and evolving audit practices. Bring an outside-in perspective and continuously challenge the status quo.
What Makes You a Great Fit
  • CA, preferably on the first attempt, with up to ~2 years post-qualification experience in Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, Finance, Risk or related areas.
  • Experience in startups, fintech, BFSI or technology-driven environments is preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with an ability to work with data and connect the dots.
  • Interest in Internal Audit, Risk, Fraud, Regulatory Compliance and Controls.
  • Curiosity about AI, Data Analytics and automation, including AI agents and tools such as n8n, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf or similar 
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and constructive challenge skills.
  • High ownership, resilience and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Willingness to travel on a need basis.

If you’re excited about rethinking what Internal Audit can be, come build it with us.

About the Role

We seek an experienced, results-driven purchasing manager to join our team at Groww. As a purchase manager, you will be responsible for handling the procurement process, sourcing suppliers and managing vendor relationships to ensure a seamless supply chain and optimise costs. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams, make strategic decisions and implement best practices within our procurement function.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to our company's success and be part of a dynamic team in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement procurement strategies and policies for cost optimization and supply chain efficiency
  • Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers based on quality, cost-effectiveness, and ethical standards
  • Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers to ensure favorable pricing and mutually beneficial agreements
  • Manage supplier relationships, including performance evaluation, issue resolution, and long-term partnership building
  • Conduct market research and analysis to stay updated on industry trends and pricing fluctuations
  • Monitor inventory levels, analyze demand patterns, and implement inventory management strategies
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand requirements and align procurement with organizational goals
  • Implement procurement systems and tools to streamline processes and enhance efficiency
  • Analyze and present procurement reports, performance metrics, and cost-saving opportunities to management
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and promote ethical and sustainable sourcing practices
  • Develop procurement metrics to track performance and identify areas for improvement
  • Manage Admin, HR, IT, and Marketing spends

Preferred skills and qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or a related field.
  • 2+ years in procurement/purchasing in a fast-paced, competitive environment in the Indian market.
  • In-depth knowledge of procurement principles, strategies and best practices.
  • Strong skills in budgeting, cost optimisation and negotiation techniques.
  • Knowledge of vendor management and inventory management systems.
  • An analytical mind with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in using procurement software and systems.
  • Knowledge of local and national laws and regulations related to procurement.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced and competitive environment.
  • Knowledge of Admin , HR, IT , Marketing Spends.
